Through simulation, it is verified that the high voltage power supply designed in this paper meets the requirements.

Author Keywords: high frequency and high voltage power supply

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of aerospace relays based on belief rule base
abstract: The fault diagnosis of aerospace relays plays a key role in the service of aircraft by virtue of essentiality of them. The requirement of transparency is paramount to a fault diagnosis model. Belief rule base (BRB) is introduced to establish the fault diagnosis model for relays in an easy-to-understand way in this paper. To fully embed the expert knowledge, the fault mechanism of relay is analyzed to generate the failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA). Fault features, fault modes and belief rules are extracted from FMEA by experts to generate belief rules of BRB. The projection covariance matrix adaption evolution strategy (P-CMA-ES) algorithm is employed to reduce the model error caused by the subjectivity of experts. The fault diagnosis of JZX-22F relay is carried out to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method based on BRB and fault mechanism.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Implementation of Motor Closed-Loop System with Gap Metric
abstract: To overcome the existing fault detection methods that rely on the external expression of system characteristics, and the difficulty in detecting and estimating faults in closed-loop systems, this paper takes a new perspective on the system gap metric in robust control theory, the coprime decomposition technology is adopted to establish the nominal and fault models of the motor closed-loop system containing uncertainties and disturbances, then gives the fault detection method. The results of fault detection with the method in closed-loop systems of motors are obtained through experiments, and the effectiveness of the gap metric method for fault detection of closed-loop systems is verified.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Analysis of Small Handling Robot based on 3D Printing Technology
abstract: Small robots are used more and more widely in real life and work, and the related robot research is of great significance. This paper uses 3D printing technology to design a small mechanical mechanism of handling robot. Its mechanical structure is made of 3D printing materials. It has strong universality and innovation, and can be used in robot teaching, robot competition, robot research basic platform, etc. Through the experimental test and analysis, the robot designed in this paper has simple structure and flexible action. It can complete the movement of forward, backward, left turn and right turn. It can also realize the function of goods handling according to the fixed point. It has good stability and practicality.

articleTitle: Prediction of battery manufacturing capacity based on reinforcement learning network combination model
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the battery manufacturing capacity prediction, this paper presents a prediction method based on reinforcement learning network combination model. First, the combined model expression for the battery manufacturing capacity prediction is designed. Then, reinforcement learning is used to construct the hidden layer learning environment of recurrent neural network and long-short-termmemory network model, to obtain the optimal number of hidden layers, and then to construct the weight learning environment of the battery manufacturing capacity combination prediction model and a combined forecasting model of battery manufacturing capacity after iterative training. Finally, a case simulation on actual battery workshop data shows the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed algorithm on solving the battery manufacturing capacity prediction problem.

articleTitle: LaneJoint: Simultaneous Lane Detection and Classification Algorithm
abstract: In the field of intelligent vehicle, many algorithms have been proposed to detect lanes. However, to the best of our knowledge, there is little literature dealing with joint lane detection and classification. In the paper, a novel LaneJoint, which simultaneously detects and classifies lanes, is proposed. In LaneJoint, to accurately detect lanes, we use an attention mechanism to fuse local and global information. And we connect the attention mechanism with multiple fully connected layers to simultaneously predict the location of lane pixels and the type of lane. Experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis and application of deep learning polyp detection in colonoscopy
abstract: Colonoscopy is the most common method for early diagnosis of colorectal cancer. The traditional detection method mainly relies on manual detection by doctors, and the detection efficiency is low. By contrast, the deep learning method has high detection precision and accuracy, which is an ideal tool for the disease detection of colonoscopy. Based on this, this paper compares the six models of YOLOv5s, YOLOv5m, YOLOv5l, YOLOv5x, Faster RCNN with and without "fpn" structure, and finds out the most effective colonoscopy polyp detection among the six models. Comparing and integrating various factors, it is found that the YOLOv5l model has the best comprehensive detection effect, and its mAP value is generally higher than 98.5%, which is the largest mAP value among the above six models, and the detection time is relatively short, about 0.018s per image. The balance of accuracy and rapidity in colonoscopy can be achieved.

articleTitle: Robust Tracking Control of Flexible-Joint Robot Subject to Time-Varying Disturbances
abstract: In this brief, a robust perturbance suppression control strategy is put forward to solve the trajectory tracking issue for the flexible-joint robot (FJR). It is well known that a variety of disturbances, including parametric perturbations, unmodeled dynamics, and model errors, consistently impair the FJR’s ability to maintain stability. To reject the adverse impacts of disturbances and obtain high-precision tracking performance, an effective method for disturbance suppression based on an output feedback controller and a generalized proportional integral observer (GPIO) is applied. The output feedback controller is constructed based on the observed values made by the GPIO, which is designed to observe unmeasurable states and the unknown lumped perturbance. The outcomes demonstrate that the suggested control scheme outperforms the traditional linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) scheme in respect of tracking and anti-disturbance performances.

articleTitle: Finite-time synchronization of delayed directed networks via periodically intermittent pinning control*
abstract: The finite-time synchronous problem of complex networks with delays by way of periodicity and intermittency pinning control is investigated in this thesis. The finite-time synchronization conditions of directed networks are gotten in terms of finite-time stability theory, the differential inequality and the matrix theory. In addition, by combining periodically intermittent and pinning control methods, a periodically intermittent pinning controller is designed. Ultimately numerical modeling is presented to illustrate the effectiveness and validity of the consequences.

articleTitle: Extended dissipative filtering for delayed Markov jump neural networks via adaptive event-triggered mechanism
abstract: This paper concentrates the extended dissipative filtering problem for Markov jump neural networks with time delays. For resource-saving purpose, one effective way is to adopt an adaptive event-triggered mechanism. On the basis of Lyapunov method and matrix inequalities, an adequate condition, which ensuring the filtering error systems with the extended dissiaptivity, is developed. Then, by tackling a bunch of linear matrix inequalities, the design method of the desired filter parameters are established. Eventually, the filter design method is verified by an numerical example.

articleTitle: A Sequential Pattern Mining-Based Cache Strategy for Industrial Edge Networks
abstract: Considering the dynamic characteristics of user interest in an industrial scenario and the limited cache capacity of edge servers, a simplified frequent sequence mining algorithm with a cutting window (SMW) is proposed to analyze the correlation of historical content request records. Then a cache strategy based on SMW is proposed to make better edge caching decisions by effectively predicting the time-varying user requests. The simulation results show that, compared with the baseline algorithm, the proposed cache strategy improves the cache hit rate and average transmission delay in different network scales.

articleTitle: Real Time Aerospace Control Fault Diagnosis System Based on Testability Model
abstract: Along with growing complexity of aerospace control system, the method of extracting fault symptoms at realtime and making accurate warning during the test and launch process is very important to improve space system reliability and security. Via FMEA Analysis, the relationship between potential failure modes and test points of aerospace control system is achieved, which forms the testability model. In this paper, a real-time fault diagnosis system based on testability model is proposed, which discretizes the real-time data stream, captures the test points state of the model and uses the optimized algorithm to trace the failure modes, completes fault diagnosis reasoning while locating the failure isolation units. This system greatly improves the reliability and security of the aerospace system.

articleTitle: Extrinsic Calibration of LiDAR-Camera Based on Deep Convolutional Network
abstract: LiDAR and stereo cameras are increasingly being used for intelligent perceptual tasks in autonomous vehicles and robotic platforms. However, before the sensors can be used, they usually need to be precisely calibrated both internally and externally considering the calibration affection of the sensor parameters. With the increasing popularity of deep learning (DL), some recent studies have proved the advantages of DL in feature extraction, feature matching and global regression in extrinsic calibration. To improve the accuracy and reduce calibration time, we propose a method for automatic extrinsic calibration of LiDAR and stereo camera based on deep convolutional network. It has the nonlinear mapping ability of neural network to establish the mapping relationship between the target in the LiDAR coordinate system and its image pixel coordinate system. Moreover, the proposed method does not require the resort to any extra calibrator, which reduces some manual steps and compensates some shortcomings of traditional methods. The method can be used for the extrinsic calibration of LiDAR and camera online, which is meaningful for further fusing the sensor data.

articleTitle: Group Consensus of Multi-agent Systems with Additive Noises and Multiplicative Noises
abstract: In this paper, we study the group consensus problem of multi-agent systems with additive noises and multiplicative noises. The multi-agent systems are composed of two sub networks affected by additive noises and multiplicative noises, respectively. A consensus protocol is designed to guarantee the group consensus. Based on this protocol, the mean square weak consensus condition and mean square strong consensus condition are obtained by algebraic graph theory and stochastic stability theory. Finally, the numerical simulations show the effectiveness of the group consensus protocol in this paper.

articleTitle: Hierarchy-based extended CBBA for multi-robot task assignment
abstract: This paper studies the task assignment problem of a multi-robot system with complex constraints including the robot speed limit, the task execution time window constraints, the arrival time, the trip cost, and different priorities of the tasks. A new bidding function is then designed for each robot. Based on the k-means algorithm, a hierarchy-based extended consensus-based bundle algorithm (CBBA) is proposed to find the optimal solution for the task allocation problem. Finally, simulation examples are presented to show the feasibility of the proposed algorithm and comparisons with existing algorithms show that the proposed algorithm can reduce the task assignment time with guaranteed reward values.

articleTitle: TextFourierNet: Arbitrary-shaped Scene Text Detection Based on Fourier Contour Modeling
abstract: Arbitrary-shaped scene text detection is a challenging task as the network can’t accurately learn the geometric layout of the texts such as curve shapes, various scales and random rotations. Most of the advanced methods address this problem through pixel-level classification. However, the classification-based approaches might lead to costly post-processing and fail to separate adjacent scene text instances. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel arbitrary-shaped scene text detector named TextFourierNet, which is a regression-based method. We model arbitrary-shaped scene text instances in polar coordinates and encode the complex geometric layouts into simple Fourier coefficients. TextFourierNet reconstructs text boundaries via an Inverse Fourier Transformation (IFT) and one NMS post-processing. To effectively separate adjacent texts and learn boundary information, we represent a text region as four sub-regions, which greatly improves the overall performance. Extensive experiments on two public datasets show that TextFourierNet is effective for arbitrary-shaped scene text detection.

articleTitle: Dynamic Event-triggered Time-varying Formation Control for Discrete-time Multi-agent Systems
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of time-varying formation control for the second-order discrete-time multi-agent systems based on dynamic event-triggered strategy. Firstly, a novel dynamic event-triggered strategy is proposed to decide whether the current sampled data is transmitted to the neighbour network. In this case, the triggering threshold is constantly adjusted by using the dynamic rules. Secondly, the time-varying formation problem is converted to a consensus problem. It has been shown that with the designed protocol, the desired form can be achieved. Finally, The system stability is proved by using the Lyapunov second method.

articleTitle: Transformer zero-sample fault diagnosis based on multimodal data fusion
abstract: As the core equipment of power systems, the accurate diagnosis and location of faults in transformers has become a pressing problem in the transformer field. In this paper, the concept of multimodality and zero-sample is integrated into transformer fault diagnosis, and a multimodal zero-sample transformer fault diagnosis model is developed to address the high coupling between transformer faults, the difficulty of collecting some faults and the lack of sample data. The model is based on the semantic embedding of multidimensional information into the attribute feature space to achieve multimodal fusion, which in turn enables a flexible global online supervision mechanism for transformer fault diagnosis system; secondly, considering the problem of missing data and fault location deviation for specific types of faults in transformers, a transformer knowledge map is constructed and a fault attribute matrix is deduced based on expert experience, with the help of its attribute features and fault instance The model is generalised to learn from its attribute features and fault instance classification. The proposed method enables the identification of zero-sample faults and fault-specific localisation in the context of multimodal fusion, with high system flexibility, wide fault coverage and good diagnostic results.

articleTitle: The edge detection optimization considering existing problems of Canny algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem of serious manual intervention, poor adaptive ability, and gradient calculation’s low accuracy of Canny algorithm in filtering and threshold detection. An improved edge detection algorithm is put forward based on Canny. Firstly, adaptive smoothing filtering method is used to reduce sensitivity to noise. Secondly, accuracy of edge detection is improved by calculating gradient amplitude in eight directional templates. And non-maximum suppression is used to eliminate invalid pixels. Finally, an improved threshold detection algorithm is adopted to improve the uncertainty of manual threshold selection and improve the accuracy of edge detection. In terms of detection, three parameters including Structural Similarity Index Metric (SSIM), Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Peak Signal to Noise Ration (PSNR) are used to evaluate the similarity of classic images, then the wheelset tread damage problem of high speed trains is analyzed as practical engineering application. The experimental results show that under the condition of 15% salt and pepper noise, after denoising, SSIM of the image is improved by 5.3192%, MSE is improved by 4.6887%, and PSNR is improved by 0.6216%. The following conclusions are drawn: the algorithm proposed this study is optimized based on Canny algorithm, which can effectively suppress salt and pepper noise, reduce the appearance of false edges, and the image edge details are more completed after processing.

articleTitle: Uncertainty and Disturbance Estimator Based Terminal Sliding Mode Control for PMSM Speed Regulation System
abstract: In order to enhance control precision of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), a uncertainty and disturbance estimator (UDE) based terminal sliding mode control (TSMC) is brought up. First, TSMC is adopted in the speed loop, leading to the assurance of finite time convergent property and a fast transient response of the system state. Meanwhile, UDE is devised to estimate the system disturbance with no requirement for a reference model in contrast to earlier UDE-based SMC control systems. Besides, the design of TSMC does not need to attain the upper limit of the disturbances when combined with the designed UDE. The Lyapunov theory ensures that the proposed scheme is stable. Finally, simulations are used to demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms the conventional TSMC technique against disturbances.

articleTitle: Smart Stair Cleaning Robot
abstract: At present, the cleaning of stairs is manual labor cleaning, which is time-consuming, labor-intensive, low-efficiency and high-cost. In addition, the cleaning action of stairs is complicated, and there will be some safety hazards during manual cleaning. This paper proposes a new type of intelligent stair cleaning robot that can clean the stairs, realize the integration of dragging, sweeping, and disinfection, effectively clean dead corners, and automatically complete the path planning with special stair climbing congtrol module. It is field-proven, stable and efficient, energy saving and environmental protection. It has long service life and reliable performance.

articleTitle: Design of pipeline operation and maintenance Platform based on underwater robot
abstract: In order to solve the problems in monitoring and maintaining underwater pipelines and exploring free waters, this paper designed a pipeline operation and maintenance platform based on underwater robots, aiming to solve the problems of poor real-time performance, low freedom and high human participation of existing underwater pipeline operation and maintenance products. The pipeline operational platform we designed adopted the sensor array method, combining with the fusion of visual, IoT cloud platform, data visualization, test triad protection scheme. It’s designed from three parts, that is perception layer, transport layer and application layer. The results of tests both in laboratory and the field of water environment achieved the desired effects.

articleTitle: Robust time-varying Kalman predictor for descriptor system with random one-step measurement delay and packet dropout
abstract: This paper investigates a Kalman predictor with robustness is applied to descriptor systems with uncertainty of noises variances, random packet loss and measurement delay within one-step is addressed. First of all, taking singular value decomposition (SVD) method to reduce the original descriptor system, then the information which has been lost due to the poor network is compensated by enlarging the states and leading in fictitious noises, and then the system with a singular matrix is transformed into a standard system. With the use of robust minimax estimation principle, a robust predictor under the case of poor communication network is proposed. Under the condition that noise variances is unknown, the actual filtering error variance could be guaranteed within a minimal scope, and take Lyapunov equation to prove the robustness. To verify the conclusion presented in this paper, a simulation example has been shown at the end.

articleTitle: Fast Dense Mapping Based on Signed Distance Function Submaps
abstract: In order to decrease computational complexity of dense mapping in large-scale environment based on Euclidean Signed Distance Function(ESDF) submap model, a registration algorithm based on octree sampling and sliding window structure is designed. By introducing the octree structure, the surface points on ESDF model with larger weights are evenly selected uniformly to reduce the number of residuals. The sliding window structure keeps the number of optimization variables constant, keeping the optimization time within the controllable range. We integrate these algorithms into the Voxgraph framework to build a new fast mapping system. The experimental results show that the octree sampling algorithm can decrease registration speed by 50% and the sliding window structure can decrease mapping speed by 33%.

articleTitle: Online Stackelberg learning solution for non-zero-sum games with infinite horizon cost*
abstract: In this paper, we consider online integral RL to derive the optimal solution of mixed H<inf>2</inf>/H<inf>∞</inf> problem. In mixed H<inf>2</inf>/H<inf>∞</inf> control, both control input and deterministic disturbance shaped the Stackelberg game. In this model, the dynamic information is incomplete due to the complexity uncertain environment. The multi-players in this system with hierarchical structure is cooperative, moreover, an extra Lagrange multiplier is required to construct the dynamic relationship of leader and follower. The learning algorithm obtain the solutions of coupled Riccati and Hamilton-Jacobi equations online which derives the adaptive control method approximates the optimal cost function and the Stackelberg form equilibrium. The existence of incentive condition also makes the convergence of the estimation to the realistic date. Moreover, the closed-loop dynamical is guaranteed stability by using Lyapunov stability analysis.

articleTitle: The predator-prey dynamics in stochastic environments with defensive and offensive effects
abstract: This paper investigates the effects of defense and offense in a random predator-prey model. We give the uniqueness of the global positive solution in detail, the ergodicity of the unique stationary distribution, and the extinction of organisms, and also give some numerical simulations to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Controlling Pressure of Gas Pipeline Network Based on Mixed Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: The gas pipeline network plays a significant role in transportation due to its low cost and safe operation. However, the traditional gas pipeline network control scheme has been criticized for its inefficiency. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides an emerging model-free alternative, but its poor generalization performance becomes a practical obstacle in diverse equipment scenarios. In this paper, a Mixed Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) approach, Mixed-PPO, is proposed to simultaneously control the continuous and discrete equipment. Compared with the original PPO, the proposed method exhibits better performance in the following aspects: (i) the ability to realize the control of both continuous and discrete equipment, making gas pipeline network pressure more stable; (ii) quicker convergence while obtaining higher profits. The effectiveness of our method is illustrated by a case study. The results show that Mixed-PPO outperforms the original PPO in terms of both profit increase and pressure fluctuation decrease, by 76.86% and 38.65%, respectively.

articleTitle: Anti-candid Camera Detection System Based on Deep Learning
abstract: Whether for the commercial secrets of large enterprises or the military secrets, it is vital to keep the relevant confidential documents properly. We propose this anti-candid camera detection system to prevent secret documents from being photographed secretly. We design our system based on deep learning object detection networks to achieve an efficient system for anti-candid camera detection and proper document protection. Our system contains three essential parts: the Mobilenetv2-SSD neural network for object detection, the Hybrid quantization method to get a lightweight network for mobile devices, and model porting to the embedded devices. In the object detection part, the Mobilenetv2-SSD neural network includes the Mobilenetv2 backbone and SSD detection part. Our system achieves 92.4 mAP (mean Average Precision) and 72 fps on mobile device RK3399pro for the Anti-candid Camera Detection task.

articleTitle: Robust Tracking Control of UAV Formation with Directed Network Time Delay
abstract: A robust tracking control problem that existed in the UAV formation and effectively proposes coordination tracking control strategy to resolve the underlying problem under the directed network time delay in UAV formation is examined in this study. First, a directed network topology-based formation model for the UAV with disturbance and network time delay is developed. The UAV formation coordination control method is subsequently created to address the time delay issue. Simultaneously, the H, performance index has been employed to enhance the formation robustness while accomplishing the purpose of coordination tracking control. Finally, the efficiency of the control strategy has been proven by simulation in this paper.

articleTitle: Infrared Small-Sample Target Recognition With Content-focused Domain Adaption Network
abstract: The domain adaptation learning paradigm provides an approach for the small-sample infrared image recognition task by introducing a source domain with sufficient visible optical samples. It aims to learn domain-shared features from the source samples and transfer them to the infrared image domain. However, the performance will suffer from the domain shift problem which is in part caused by the inductive preference of the learning model on image style instead of its content. To address the above issues, this paper develops a novel content-focused domain adaption network. We propose two novel inductive biases from both intra-domain and cross-domain perspectives to make the learning model more focused on the content. First, an infrared intra-domain content-focused sub-network based on retinex theory is designed so that the style accounting for the image noise will not influence the intra-domain induction. Next, we construct a cross-domain content-focused sub-network to alleviate the attention on the image style. Thanks to these two networks, the overall domain adaptation model will pay more attention to the robust discriminative feature of image content rather than domain styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. In particular, the recognition accuracy of our method can exceed the baseline method by up to 8%.

articleTitle: Transformer Based Multi-modal Fusion For Place Recognition with Self-attention Mechanism
abstract: Autonomous driving still leaves a challenging task that how to apply the complementary information captured from different sensors, i.e. cameras and LiDAR, to handle place recognition task. In this paper, a brand new pipeline was designed to tackle the retrieval problem with a multi-modal late fusion. The light-weighted convolutional blocks is applied to encode features from images, followed by converting them into pseudo point clouds. Inspired by the progress of the Transformer, the network employs a residual point transformer module to extract feature vectors for 3D points and pseudo point clouds respectively. Finally, the two corresponding local descriptors are fused to get a robust fused global descriptor, which is capable of place recognition task after end-to-end training. Experimental results collected from sequence 00, 02, 05, 06 of KITTI dataset validate that fusing information from two modalities is able to enhance performance.

articleTitle: Anchor-oriented strategy for construction vehicles detection in the woodland scene
abstract: Currently, woodland resources are becoming scarce, but there are still many destructive behaviors which need construction vehicles. Therefore, the supervision of these vehicles is necessary, and is beneficial to the protection of woodland resources and sustainable development. In order to detect the target vehicles in the complex woodland scene in real-time, an anchor-oriented strategy for construction vehicles detection is proposed. Firstly, we modify the feature fusion in the FPN (Feature Pyramid Network) structure by the our AFF (Attention Feature fusion) modules, getting informative feature maps to match positive anchors better. Secondly, according to the ratio of heights and the ratio of widths of the two bounding boxes, we suggest the Four-anchors label assignment strategy to alleviate the imbalance between positive and negative anchors and to make the network converge faster. Thirdly, inspired by the Tan trigonometric function, the α-TIoU Loss is proposed. It takes the absolute distance like the difference of the widths of two bounding boxes into consideration and can raise the mAR by about 1% because of the added punishment to the aspect ratios making the high-quality anchors payed more attention. Additionally, extensive ablation experiments demonstrate that the Four-anchors label assignment strategy can improve the mAP by 4.3% which is the highest in these components. Finally, equipped with our anchor-oriented strategy, the result of the detector whose backbone is Mobilenetv3 can reach 52.2% mAP.

articleTitle: Research on improved current droop control scheme of energy storage converter
abstract: The droop control scheme is adopted in the energy storage converter to improve the voltage and frequency support capability of the energy storage converter to the regional power grid. The droop control strategy of active current frequency and reactive current voltage is specifically adopted. Aiming at the problem that the traditional current droop control can not suppress the grid side fluctuation, which leads to the poor transient characteristics of the output voltage of the energy storage converter, a method to characterize the droop coefficient according to the change rate of the effective value of the output voltage of the energy storage converter is proposed, and the droop coefficient is adaptively adjusted according to the voltage regulation to provide virtual inertial support for the system. Simulation is used to verify the proposed scheme. The results show that the new current droop control strategy can effectively improve the transient voltage performance of the energy storage converter.

articleTitle: SSCPC-Net: Classification of carotid plaques in ultrasound images using a self-supervised convolutional neural network
abstract: Rupture of carotid plaque is clinically important to identify patients at risk for ischemic stroke. Recently, supervised deep learning methods have been successfully applied to classify carotid plaques, but their performance depends on the number of labeled images. However, the number of carotid plaque labeling images in clinical practice is small. To alleviate the problem of few labeled images, we propose a self-supervised carotid plaque classification network algorithm named SSCPC-Net. First, we design an image block shuffling strategy to predict shuffled and ordered images based on the spatial structure of carotid plaques, which aims to pre-train a CNN to obtain the representation of plaque features. Next, the pretrained model is transferred as parameter initialization into the carotid plaque classification network to improve the performance of the CNN when the number of labeled training images is small. It can be seen from the results that SSCPC-Net can effectively improve the classification accuracy of basic ResNet under different proportions of labeled training images. Furthermore, the results show that SSCPC-Net can effectively alleviate the problem of insufficient labeling of training images, effectively improve the plaque classification accuracy, which is helpful for clinical carotid plaque identification and stroke warning.

articleTitle: A Winograd-based CNN Accelerator for Cloud Detection on FPGA
abstract: Cloud detection with a convolutional neural network is an effective method for improving the accuracy of remote sensing image processing, but it takes a large number of convolutions with repeated floating-point multiplications which is difficult for high-speed onboard processing. Winograd is always used for accelerating convolution. However, the efficiency of Winograd implemented on the general-purpose processors is low, which requires FPGA to provide parallel computing capabilities for the Winograd optimized cloud detection network. This paper proposes a Winograd-based CNN accelerator for cloud detection on FPGA. Firstly, a cloud detection network is proposed based on the improved U-Net, which provides the capability of high accuracy of cloud detection with low computing complexity. Then, the convolution in the cloud detection network is improved by the Winograd algorithm to reduce the number of floating-point multiplications. And a novel cloud detection accelerator based on FPGA is proposed. The accelerator performs a sufficient parallel operation on the convolution improved by Winograd, which further improves the processing efficiency. Experimental results indicate that based on ensuring that the average pixel accuracy is greater than 95%, the processing time for a 256×256 image can reach 996ms, which is 35 times faster than the ARM deployment only.

articleTitle: Two Channel Event-triggered Communication Schemes for Networked Switched Affine Systems with Asynchronous Switching
abstract: The event-triggered control of networked switched affine systems with asynchronous switching and time delays is studied in this paper. For purpose of save transmission and computation resources, this paper adopts two channel event-triggered communication mechanisms. The transmission of the control signal and switching signal are both determined by the event-triggered generator, which inevitably causes the asynchronous switching. Besides, time-delays and affine terms cause difficulties to the system analysis. Two event-triggered mechanisms with triggering upper bound are proposed to limit the asynchronous switching duration. Then, we joint design the two channel triggering mechanisms, switching rule and controller to obtain practical stability.

articleTitle: An Inverse Proportional Operator-Based D-Type Iterative Learning Control for Initial State Error
abstract: This paper studies the influence of incipient status deviation in iterative learning control(ILC) systems and comes up with a fresh D-type iterative learning control algorithm for i incipient status error. Then, it is shown that, when the proposed algorithm is the same with nonlinear systems, the effect of incipient status deviation is up to be cut down with the amount of iterations little by little and the proposed algorithm improves the convergence speed. Compared with traditional algorithms, the proposed algorithm is more flexible because of combining learning gain and correction function with the number of iterations. To demonstrate the availability of the posed arithmetic, a simulation experiment is provided.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Broad Learning Scheme for Short-Term Load Forecasting
abstract: The management of electricity systems benefits considerably from short-term load forecasting. Although various superior short-term prediction algorithms have been investigated, some problems are still encountered in practical applications: (1) When dealing with data containing noise, there are unpredictable effects on short-term load forecasting. (2) Current deep learning models are time-consuming. In this study, we suggest an ensemble kernel broad learning system based on residuals to resolve the aforementioned issues. Specifically, we merge the broad learning system with kernel learning, which helps obtain stable features to improve the performance and avoid getting into the non-optimal problem. In addition, to further improve the prediction accuracy, we fuse multiple base learners to obtain an optimal prediction model from the residuals of the loss function. The experimental findings exhibit the efficacy and efficiency of our suggested technique.

articleTitle: Hand-eye Calibration of Industrial Robots with 3D Cameras based on Dual Quaternions
abstract: In this paper, a hand-eye calibration method with the 3D depth camera is proposed. A set of 3D cube-shaped calibrators are designed, which facilitates the obtainment of the coordinates of the calibration points of these calibrators. Using the point-to-point correspondence between, a registration method is employed to calculate the pose transformation matrix of the object relative to the camera coordinate system under different camera. Constraint equations are formulated based on the positional transformation matrix, and then the hand-eye relation is solving by using dual quaternions and singular value decomposition. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves higher accuracy, and the calibration process is more convenient for practical application.

articleTitle: An Aircraft Towing and Taxiing System Based on Pilot Control Mode
abstract: The evolving aviation industry places higher demands on the aircraft towing and taxiing process, which relies heavily on the cooperation between the pilot and the tractor driver traditionally because there is no information exchange between the aircraft and the tractor. An aircraft towing and taxiing system based on pilot control mode is proposed aiming at the inefficiency and complexity of the above-mentioned work mode. An angle sensor is installed between the nose landing gear and the tractor, the tractor can perceive the direction that the pilot wants to go when the pilot is steering the steering wheel, and tow the aircraft forward along its heading angle automatically. According to the simulation and experiments, it is verified that the proposed pilot can complete the aircraft towing and taxiing operation through the active perception and autonomous control of the tractor, which solves the problem of no information interaction between the aircraft and the tractor.

articleTitle: DC-CNN-Based Quantum State Estimation
abstract: In recent years, special attention has been paid to deep learning-based quantum state estimation (QSE). In this paper, we apply deep complex convolutional neural networks (DC-CNNs) to the field of QSE and optimize the network architecture by employing the attention mechanism. The DCCNN-based estimator is trained to fit the mapping from Pauli measurements to each target density matrix, and then each output density matrix is projected onto the nearest subspace that satisfies quantum state constraints. A major advantage of the proposed scheme is that it is capable of extracting sufficient features from incomplete measurements, which contributes to its ability to overcome the absence of partial measurement values. Finally, the superiority of the proposed scheme is highlighted in comparison with the QSE schemes based on the conventional least squares estimation (LSE) and maximum likelihood estimation (MLE).

articleTitle: Sequential Convex Optimization Based Spacecraft Formation Reconfiguration with Collision Avoidance
abstract: Aiming at the problem of cooperative formation reconfiguration of multiple spacecraft under the constraints of collision avoidance and controller saturation, a formation reconfiguration strategy based on sequential convex optimization is proposed. Based on the CW equation, a multi-spacecraft formation reconfiguration model is constructed, and the formation reconfiguration problem is transformed into a nonlinear programming problem; the dynamic equations are linearized and discretized, and the collision avoidance constraints are decoupled and convexized which transforming the non-convex optimization problem into a convex optimization problem; a formation reconstruction strategy based on sequential convex optimization is proposed. Finally, numerical simulations effectively verify the effectiveness of the aforementioned strategy.

articleTitle: Apply of Multi-scale Model Method for State Detection
abstract: With the increasing functions of modern industrial systems, the invention and application of many new equipment has greatly improved the level of productivity, but it has also made the structure of industrial systems increasingly complex, and the requirements for control accuracy and operation optimization are getting higher and higher. High-precision models are the cornerstone of control and optimization. A multi-scale modeling method based on state detection is proposed to build models suitable for complex product processes. Use state detection to decompose parameters into different scales, and then build multiple models. The form of the model can be either mechanism-based or data-based. The outputs of all models are then summed to get a more accurate prediction. The simulation results of coal mill modeling show that the multi-scale modeling method has better performance than the traditional signal-scale modeling method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Assignment Strategy for Multi-Target Adversarial Interception
abstract: The multi-missile confront multi-target is a classic target allocation issue in the combat scenario of multiple missiles intercepting multiple maneuvering targets. Traditional algorithms lack environmental assessment model, train quality, and indicator function in the adversarial environment. To this end, this paper aims to propose an intelligent assignment strategy which contains indicator function and evaluation model. Then, an indicator function and an evaluation model considering the miss distance, threat situation, and the number of specified interception targets are introduced into the reinforcement learning algorithm. The local and global reward functions are introduced to improve the training convergence and efficiency in the multi-missile multi-target confrontation scenario. Finally, simulation results are designed to check on advantage of intelligent allocation strategy.

articleTitle: Approximation-based Adaptive Tracking Control for 6-DoF Tailless Flying-Wing UAV with Coefficient Uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the adaptive tracking control problem for tailless flying-wing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) subject to the coefficient uncertainties and external disturbance. It’s worth noting that the six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) model of flying-wing UAV is established for the first time. Different from most existing results, both the velocity and attitude control under state coupling are considered simultaneously in this work. With the help of neural network approximators, an adaptive neural controller is developed to handle the coefficient uncertainty and external disturbance problem. It is proved that all the signals in the closed-loop system are semiglobal uniformly ultimately bounded (SGUUB). The simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed method.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Bionic Deformable Hexapod Robot
abstract: In this paper, we imitate the action mode of the Moroccan backflip spider living in the desert on the basis of bionic principles and design a bionic deformable hexapod robot that combine the advantages of the wheeled and legged robots. The structural design of the robot was completed in Solidworks and then imported into CoppeliaSim to complete the simulation experiments by remote-API with Python. The simulation results show that the robot can complete the switching of two modes and has the ability of all-terrain passing, which achieves the expected goal.

articleTitle: Using Data Augmentation to Improve EEG-Based Prediction of Emergency Braking Intention
abstract: Accurate recognition of the driver's emergency braking intention can make the vehicle’ emergency braking system work automatically in advance, thus avoiding some serious traffic accidents. In this paper, we investigated the driver’s emergency braking intention detection based on EEG with data augmentation (DA). We used two electroencephalography (EEG) datasets of the driver’s emergency braking intention detection and performed DA on each of them. Five representative algorithms were used to detect the intention of emergency braking. The results showed that DA significantly improved the prediction accuracy of three convolutional neural networks (ShallowNet, DeepNet and EEGNet) based on deep learning, and slightly improved the prediction performance of the minimum distance to mean based on Riemannian geometry (RMDM) algorithm, but had little impact on the classical common spatial pattern filter combined with linear discriminant analysis (CSP+LDA) algorithm. With DA, EEGNet predicted the impending emergency braking behavior 200ms in advance with an accuracy of over 80% on both datasets. This study provides a framework for detecting drivers’ emergency braking intention based on EEG, which can improve the prediction accuracy by augmenting the EEG data with a small number of samples.

articleTitle: Research on cloud control platform architecture based on industrial Internet combined with cloud control technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of system performance degradation caused by the difficulty of communication between heterogeneous devices and the large scale of devices under the traditional industrial Internet, this paper proposes a cloud control platform architecture based on the industrial Internet combined with cloud control technology, and uses this architecture to build a cloud control platform. The data engine technology is used to parse different protocols, thus solving the problems of mutual communication and data synchronization between heterogeneous devices. In addition, the cloud control technology is used to dynamically adjust the computing power of the platform to avoid the degradation of platform performance due to the increase in the number of devices. Finally, based on the platform design and construction of an unmanned factory for intelligent manufacturing, the experiments show that the cloud control system architecture proposed in this paper is scientific and effective.

articleTitle: An offset-boostable 3-D memristive system and its attractor self-repruducing
abstract: A new 3D memristor system is constructed based on VB17 system. The basic dynamics of the system are analyzed by means of bifurcation analysis, phase orbit diagram and Lie index. Based on the idea of bias and the introduction of trigonometric functions, the attractor self-propagation phenomenon is generated in the system, which proves that the newly proposed memristor system has super many steady states. In addition, the system has the phenomenon of bias lift. Finally, the realization of the theory is proved by designing the circuit of 3D memory chaotic system. Multisim simulation verifies the validity the validity of the numerical analysis.

articleTitle: An Repairing Algorithm for Infrared Video Brightness Mutation Based on Information Entropy
abstract: Images with abnormal brightness changes in videos pose a serious obstacle to video analysis tasks. In this paper, an information entropy-based brightness variation repair algorithm for infrared video images is proposed. In this paper, image average pixel value and image information entropy are used to find image frames with abnormal brightness changes. The adaptive Gamma transform determined by the information entropy value is used to repair the video image with brightness variation, and the "dead zone" pixels are replaced with the image pixels at the moment before the brightness change. The experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively repair the sudden change of video brightness caused by moving objects approaching the camera, and provides more reliable data for subsequent video analysis tasks.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Optimal Tracking Control Design With DHP Formulation for Discrete-Time Nonlinear Nonzero-Sum Games
abstract: In this paper, for discrete-time nonlinear systems, an event-based intelligent critic algorithm is researched to deal with two-player nonzero-sum game optimal tracking control problems (OTCPs). The OTCP of unknown nonlinear nonzero-sum games is transformed into the optimal regulation problem of corresponding error dynamics. According to the triggered requirement, we develop a reasonable triggering condition to cut down the number of updates for two controllers, which achieves the goal of improving resource utilization. Then, based on the dual heuristic programming (DHP) technique, the approximate optimal costate function and the tracking control pair are output through training neural networks (NNs). Finally, an example is wield to demonstrate the rationality of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A new method based on YOLOv5 for remote sensing object detection
abstract: Objects on remote sensing images usually have the characteristics of complex background and extremely large scale changes. This makes most general object detection algorithms designed to cross-scale datasets unable to achieve ideal results in remote sensing images. In this article, we propose a new method based on improved YOLO network to solve the difficulties mentioned above. We introduce a new module to extract multi-scale information to enhance the ability of the network to detect objects with different scales in complex background and a new FPN named AG-PAN which use two top-down pathways to compensate for semantic information loss and attention mechanism to focus on the distinctive features of the objects. Soft-CIoU-NMS be used to replace the commonly used NMS to generate better detection result. Extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the COCO, RSOD (Remote Sensing Object Detection) dataset. The results show that our method outperforms original YOLOv5 by 3.1% AP<inf>50</inf> and other state-of-the-art methods in RSOD. In COCO dataset, our method has 2.6% improvement in AP and 2.9% improvement in AP<inf>50</inf>. The experimental results show that our method significantly improves the performance of the object detection algorithm in remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Fractional Kalman filter algorithm with observation delay
abstract: Because the state space model of observation delay fractional order system is different from that of traditional integer order system, the classical traditional Kalman filter algorithm cannot be applied to this system. Therefore, a fractional Kalman filter is designed for the non integer order systems with observation delay in this article. Firstly, one or more observation time-delay systems are transformed into non time-delay augmented systems by state augmentation method. Based on the new system, through the definition of Grünwald-Letnikov (GL) fractional calculus, the delay fractional state space expression is derived, and the filtering algorithm of non-integral order system with observation delay is derived by using projection theorem. The simulation images show that the proposed algorithms has good estimation level.

articleTitle: Open-circuit Fault Diagnosis Method of NPC Inverter Based on Extended Observer
abstract: In order to reduce the influence of external interference and uncertain factors on the fault diagnosis of the inverter system, this thesis proposes an open-circuit fault diagnosis method for the NPC inverter based on the extended observer. The Mixed Logic Dynamic is established by analyzing the relationship between current flow and working state of inverter under normal and fault conditions. An extended observer is designed with current as the detection quantity. Fault diagnosis is carried out according to the negative double residual relation obtained from the estimated current value of the extended observer and the true current value of the physical system. The current expansion observer not only effectively reduces the influence of unknown interference and other factors on the fault diagnosis of the inverter, but also improves the accuracy and robustness of the fault diagnosis system when the load changes suddenly. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the method are verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Maximum Range Trajectories for Hypersonic Reentry Vehicle
abstract: Trajectory optimization is usually an important work in the flight vehicle’s conceptual design and mission planning, while sensitivity analysis of the optimized trajectory could provide a deep insight of the potential influencing factors. Concentrating on the sensitivity analysis of maximum range trajectories for hypersonic reentry vehicle, this paper presents a hybrid solution framework combing trajectory optimization and orthogonal experiment techniques. The global effects of the reentry vehicle’s initial states, aerodynamic parameters, and physical parameters on the maximum range trajectories are quantitatively analyzed. The feasibility and validity are demonstrated by numerical simulations. The sensitivity analysis framework herein may provide a beneficial reference for the optimal mission design and analysis of the other flight vehicles.

articleTitle: Improved Echo State Network With Multiple Activation Functions
abstract: Echo state network (ESN) is a computational model based on reservoir computing framework, but regulation of activation function within the reservoir cannot be done, which affects its nonlinear mapping capability. In this paper, in view of design problem of activation function, we put forward a new activation function design method combining the original function and its derivative functions linearly. In reservoirs, different nodes have different activation functions, which improves the Nonlinear mapping capability of the ESN. Then the outputs of reservoirs are determined by the combined activation functions and the weight of the output layer is obtained by the least square estimation (LSE) method. Finally, simulation results in NARMA and Lorenz systems demonstrate the good effect of the new design method.

articleTitle: LaneFormer: An Efficient Transformer-based Network for Fast Lane Detection
abstract: Lane detection, the process of identifying lane markings, is of great importance for self-driving vehicles, and CNN-based methods have shown outstanding effects in complex real-world scenarios. Nevertheless, due to the restricted computing resources, most previous methods are too heavy to be deployed on mobile devices. To solve this problem, we present a lightweight lane detection method, called LaneFormer, which consists of anchor proposals and a transformer encoder. The skip blocks are integrated to improve high-level features, while the transformer block can model non-local interactions and capture global context. Experiments on two benchmark datasets show that compared with state-of-the-art methods, our approach is more efficient and achieves even better accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel CVA Fault Detection Method Based on Abnormal Data Elimination
abstract: Canonical variate analysis (CVA) is a traditional data-based fault diagnosis method that is widely used in chemical processes. In most cases, all the training data under normal working conditions is used by the algorithm to train a model. However, due to the environmental disturbance and sensor measurement error, some of the collected data under normal working conditions may have noise and interference, leading to big errors in training models and inaccurate fault diagnosis results. Therefore, a novel abnormal-data-elimination method based on a new T<sup>2</sup> statistic is proposed in this paper, which can effectively detect and eliminate the abnormal samples in the training set. And only the remaining data is used to build the model in order to improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis results. At last, the Tennessee Eastman process is applied to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. The simulation result shows that the proposed novel CVA method can reduce the false alarm rate without affecting the fault detection performance, which improve the fault detection ability obviously.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Fixed-Wing Aircraft’s Takeoff and Landing Performance Under Inaccurate Information
abstract: Aiming at the problems of inaccurate and non-objective information in the analysis of takeoff and landing performance for fixed-wing aircraft, a comprehensive evaluation method of aircraft’s takeoff and landing performance based on improved analytic hierarchy process(AHP) and gray theory is given. Firstly, a weight calculation method based on multi-matrix AHP is proposed by increasing the number of weight judgment matrices, so that the influence of a single expert's score on the weight judgment results can be weakened, and the subjectivity in the weight coefficient vector is reduced. Then, a gray evaluation matrix is calculated based on gray theory; finally, the evaluation value of takeoff and landing performance of fixed-wing aircraft is obtained by combining the multi-expert weight coefficient vector and gray evaluation matrix. The analysis result shows that the method can realize the comprehensive evaluation of takeoff and landing performance and has certain uncertainty information processing ability.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Tracking Algorithm Based on IRB-JDE
abstract: There are several problems in the existed pedestrian tracking algorithms, such as missing detection and false detection of small-size pedestrians and occluded pedestrians, frequent pedestrian identity jumps, and track loss. In this paper, an improved pedestrian tracking algorithm called IRB-JDE (Joint Detection and Embedding Improved by Res2NeXt50 and BYTE) is proposed. In specific, an improved backbone network, namely Res2NeXt50 (I_Res2NeXt50), is proposed by improving the residual network structure of ResNet50. The improved backbone network has developed the tracking accuracy of occluded pedestrians and reduced the number of pedestrian identity jumps. Secondly, a multi-scale fusion network is presented to get the location ability of small-size pedestrians better by integrating the PAN structure on the FPN structure. Finally, a data association algorithm named BYTE is introduced to improve the reliability of data association and decrease the quantity of track loss. Ablation experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the abovementioned improvements in increasing the accuracy of pedestrian tracking. In comparison with the existed algorithms, the IRB-JDE performs better on the MOT16 dataset according to the commonly-used evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Strong stabilization of two-link underactuated planar robots
abstract: Strong stabilization refers to designing stable feedback controllers that stabilize a given plant. The second-order stable stabilizing controller design of two-link underactuated planar robots around their UEP (Upright Equilibrium Point) is concerned in this paper. The proposed method can obtain explicit transfer function of the controller by solving a set of inequalities, which is relatively more concise and the final set of stable controllers is larger than the existing results. Simulation results of both the Acrobot and the Pendubot are presented to verify the effectiveness and robustness of proposed stabilizing controllers.

articleTitle: Research on Maritime Multi-center Emergency Resource Scheduling Based on Improved NSGA-II
abstract: In order to provide effective support for maritime accidents, it is significant to study the maritime emergency resource scheduling. In this paper, considering that the existing scheduling model is difficult to apply to the maritime background, or the existing model considers insufficient factors, we propose a maritime multi-center emergency resource scheduling model. The model takes time penalty and total replenishment cost as targets, and introduces the influence of various environmental factors. Then, an improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) is designed to optimize the model. In the algorithm, the population diversity is ensured by the improvement of population initialization and mutation operator, and an adaptive parameter adjustment strategy is adopted to improve the search efficiency. Simulation experiments show that the improved NSGA-II algorithm has better convergence and distribution, and the solution results also verify the correctness of the model.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Pulmonary Nodules Based on IAD-VNet
abstract: Pulmonary nodules are lung cancer's early manifestations. In order to judge benign and malignant diagnoses, it is necessary to manually mark the nodule position on CT slices, which is time-consuming and unstable. In order to accurately segment pulmonary nodules in CT images, an IAD-VNet network is proposed to automatic segmentation of pulmonary nodules and to assist doctors in diagnosis. In IAD-VNet, a deep aggregation structure is introduced, and the IAD-VNet network iteratively aggregates feature maps of different scales to perform deep fusion of shallow and deep features, which strengthens the transfer of features at different depths and refines shallow features fully. A deep supervision strategy is introduced to ensure that the network is fully trained. At the same time, the weight learning module is utilized to obtain the weights of different depth features, and a weighted summation is performed to obtain the final segmentation result. Then the segmentation accuracy is improved. Furthermore, the IAD-VNet network introduces dense connections in some deep encoding/decoding modules, which improves the utilization of the feature map by the network and alleviates the gradient disappearance of the network. The results on the LUNA16 dataset show that the dice similarity coefficient, precision, and recall achieved by the segmentation model are 0.835, 0.846, and 0.837, respectively. Compared with other segmentation methods, the IAD-VNet network has good robustness and can obtain good segmentation results for lung nodules of different shapes and sizes, providing a good basis for further diagnosis.

articleTitle: 3D Deployment of UAVs Based on An Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are useful tools for providing communication services nowadays, while the strategy of deploying UAVs varies depending on environments. In this paper, communication services assisted by UAVs in a dynamic urban environment is considered, and the problem is focused on how to deploy UAVs in a way that minimizes energy consumption taking into account path loss, signal-to-noise ratio, and users’ movement. In particular, a segmentation strategy for user movements is proposed. Based on this strategy, the user’s motion trajectory can be segmented, and the energy consumption can be optimized in real time under the premise of satisfying the average channel capacity. A genetic algorithm improved in the initialization and mutation crossover stages is proposed, where the reverse numerical method and adaptive probability factor to the dynamic UAV deployment problem are combined and adapted in an innovative way to solve the problem. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved genetic algorithm for achieving a lower energy cost and reasonable average channel capacity.

articleTitle: DSC-based Parallel Control for Consensus Maneuvering of Multi-agent Systems subject to Unmatched Uncertainties based on Distributed Nash Equilibrium Seeking
abstract: We consider parameterized virtual leader-guided distributed consensus maneuvering of uncertain multi-agent systems herein. The model of the agent is in the strict-feedback form and subject to unmatched uncertainties. In comparison with existing results, we try to research distributed consensus maneuvering from a distributed game perspective. Inspired by distributed Nash equilibrium seeking approach and cooperative learning strategy, a parallel control method is developed for consensus maneuvering, including cooperative learning-based neural predictors, dynamic surface control(DSC)-based parallel control law, and parameter update law for virtual leader. It is proved that the total closed-loop system is input-to-state stable, and the outputs of all agents converge to the Nash equilibrium as far as possible. The main results are demonstrated by theoretical analysis and a simulation example.

articleTitle: On Optimization Algorithms for Multi-UAVs Search Task
abstract: Since Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarm emerged with the merit of high efficiency, flexibility and robustness in search tasks, related research has sprung up in recent years. However, unknown target locations make swarm search a complex mission. In view of this, many optimization algorithms based on UAV swarm have been proposed and improved, which are reviewed and partitioned into non-intelligent algorithms and intelligent ones in this paper. Furthermore, the latter is subdivided into algorithm improvement and algorithm fusion, both of which are set forth at length. At the end of this paper, we analyse the existing challenges and give some insight into the future.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Model of Omnidirectional Mobile Robot Considering Slip Angle
abstract: The driving mode of the wheeled mobile robot and the cornering phenomenon of the elastic tire under the action of the cornering force are analyzed in this paper. A dynamic model of the omnidirectional mobile robot based on the sideslip angle is proposed. The analysis of the model is conducted by Webots which is a free and open-source 3D robot simulator widely used in industry, education, and research. In the simulation, the running situation of an omnidirectional mobile robot considering the slip angle model with different running speeds is used to verify the proposed model. The results show that this model effectively improves the steering reliability and stability of the omnidirectional mobile robot within its reliable operating speed range.

articleTitle: A Sample Selection Method Based on Deep Bayesian Active Learning
abstract: The production process of iron and steel enterprises has accumulated a large number of historical data. Because of the continuity of production conditions, these data have a large number of redundancy, which severely affects the training time and generalization capability of the model. Therefore, this study proposes a fast sample selection method based on deep Bayesian active learning. The method uses Bayesian neural network (BNN) as a priori modelling, and adopts Gaussian process to infer the posterior distribution of the network prediction, and achieves the selection of redundant samples based on maximizing the probability of the posterior distribution. To address the problem of excessive computational complexity of the Gaussian process as a sampling function, a sparse Gaussian method is used to improve the traditional Gaussian process and achieve faster sampling. In order to verify the effectiveness of the method in this paper, experiments were conducted using historical coke oven data from a domestic iron and steel enterprise. The results indicate that the proposed method can not only effectively reduce the number of samples, but also has better prediction accuracy and has obvious advantages in terms of algorithm running time.

articleTitle: Neural Adaptive Dynamic Surface Control of PMSMs with Input Saturation and output constraint
abstract: This paper discusses an adaptive neural tracking control of permanent magnet synchronous motors subject to input saturation and output constraint. The difficulty is to consider output constraints and input saturation. Firstly, the adaptive dynamic surface control design process is systematized by embedding many existing tools into the classical backstepping framework. Then, a nonlinear transformation function is proposed to transform the output constrained system into an unconstrained system. Furthermore, using radial basis function neural networks to Process the unknown terms, the Gaussian error function is utilized to describe the continuously differentiable asymmetric saturation nonlinearity. It turns out that all signals in the proposed scheme are bounded. The simulation results are provided to further show the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Variable impedance control method for robot contact force based on TD3 algorithm
abstract: As a common method of traditional force control, impedance control has been widely used in robot machining field. However, impedance control with fixed parameters cannot dynamically adapt to the manufacturing environment. This paper presents a variable impedance control method for contact forces based on the TD3 (Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient) algorithm. The method builds on the original impedance model to obtain the optimal impedance parameters for each stage by stochastic exploration of the continuous action space, reducing the reliance on human experience and multiple attempts in the selection of traditional impedance parameters. In this paper, gantry robot is taken as the research object. The simulation results show that the variable impedance control method has faster adjustment time and more stable, and the average position tracking error is about 0.11cm and the force tracking error is about 0.01N.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation for the position of a defect based on Lamb wave by using Faster R-CNN
abstract: A deep convolutional neural network method based on Faster R-CNN was proposed to achieve a quantitative evaluation of the position of a defect within a plate-like structure. In this study, a defective plate-like structure was detected using a lamb wave. To reduce the complexity of the Lamb wave response, only the A0 mode was excited and received, and the defect image was obtained by extracting the defect echo signal combined with the total focusing method (TFM). Then the defect non-destructive evaluation within a plate-like structure is transformed into an image target detection problem by using machine learning, and the images of the defect in a plate-like structure are augmented with Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) to complete the construction of the dataset and solve the problem of insufficient data samples. Subsequently, sufficient data samples were trained by the Faster R-CNN model for quantitative evaluation of the position of the defect. The results show that the Faster R-CNN model can achieve a more precise location and size message of the defect within a plate-like structure. The proposed method has the potential to broaden the application prospects of defect detection.

articleTitle: Platoon Control of Vehicles on Curved Roads
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of the platoon control on curved roads via the unreliable inter-vehicle communication. First, we obtain the vehicle dynamics on the curved road. Second, we derive a switching delay tracking error system for vehicle platoon by considering the effect of packet dropouts and actuator delay. Then, combined with the theory of switching system and Lyapunov stability, the sufficient conditions are obtained to design the controller, which can guarantee both the robust stability and string stability. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Safe Exploration of Reinforcement Learning with Data-Driven Control Barrier Function
abstract: Reinforcement learning relies on exploration and exploitation to find optimal policies. However, unconstrained exploration might lead to unsafe actions that jeopardize the system safety. To address this issue, this work presents a RL-based framework that integrates model-based CBF to ensure safe exploration during learning. Rather than synthesizing CBF by hand for complex dynamic systems, we exploit data-driven methods to learn CBFs from collected demonstrations of safe and desirable behavior. Unlike prior works that restrict on off-line collected expert demonstrations to train CBF, the CBF in this work is learned not only from preliminary expert demonstrations, but also from the on-line generated data at runtime, resulting in improved adaptation to complex environments. Numerical simulations and physical experiments using Crazyflie quadrotors are carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the developed safe RL framework. The experiment video is available at https://youtu.be/uscl-BQsLRo.

articleTitle: Predictive Modelling of Traffic Delay in Arterial Road Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
abstract: Traffic delay in arterial road is an important criterion in the judgment of service level of transportation. At present, there exist a certain degree of congestion problems in most road intersections, especially in the holidays. In order to assess and predict the degree of congestion in road intersection, the traffic simulation research of a chosen area in Jinshan road was undertaken. PTV VISSIM was used to generate the simulated traffic flow data. Linear Regression model, SoftMax and machine learning were combined to process the simulated data generated from VISSIM micro simulation. This is in the aim of building a proper model that can be used for data generation like predicted transport traffic delay as well as predicted degree of congestion under ranged traffic volumes. This research may act as a guidance and reference for city designers and transportation engineers in their further research about Jinshan Road as well as others.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Transmission Scheme with Dynamic Clustering Based on Splitting and Reorganization for Event-Driven WSNs
abstract: Continuous event monitoring for large-scale wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is one of the important applications. In these applications, clusters should be efficiently and dynamically organized and of appropriate size. This paper proposes a cooperative transmission scheme with dynamic clustering based on splitting and reorganization for monitoring applications. When no event occurs, a static network model with a hierarchical clustering tree for large-scale WSNs is proposed. Once the event was triggered, a dynamic clustering scheme based on splitting and reorganization according to the characteristics of event diffusion is proposed. Moreover, selection cooperation is introduced into the data transmission of cluster head(CH) and a cooperative transmission protocol by utilizing a feedback mechanism is designed to enhance the transmission reliability of the event area. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the transmission reliability for wireless sensor networks driven by diffuse events.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Control Network Security Measurement Method Based on GRU-SVM
abstract: Since the industrial Internet entered people's field of vision, industrial control network security has gradually received attention. Traditional network security measurement methods rely on the accuracy of situation sequences and historical situation values, and various factors in the network have a great influence on the results. However, compared with industrial control networks, the number and types of affected factors are less than those of the modern Internet. Therefore, based on the research on network security situational awareness, this paper proposes an industrial control network security measurement method model based on GRU-SVM. First, the data sets with threat type labels are classified, and then the similarity scoring mechanism and softmax function are introduced, to process the classification results. For the GRU-SVM classification module, the analysis of the simulation results shows that the convergence is better and the robustness is stronger. For the safety prediction measurement part, by comparing with different models, the mean absolute error and root mean square error are smaller and the reliability is higher.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Embedded Model Predictive Controller for Aero-engines
abstract: In this paper, an online computing model predictive controller is designed for aero-engines and implemented in a microprocessor. Due to the heavy burden of online optimization of model predictive control (MPC) and the high real-time requirements of aero-engines, it is very difficult to embed the MPC algorithm. In this paper, the MPC algorithm is implemented on low-end hardware devices. And this result is mainly achieved by implementing OSQP solver on low-frequency single-chip microcomputers. In order to verify the effectiveness of the controller, a hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test platform is built for testing. When the controller program is running, the optimization solution can be completed online in a very short time, because the solution iteration process can always converge quickly. And the controller has a good control effect on the nonlinear aero-engine model. It is confirmed that the MPC algorithm can be embedded in the application field with complex model and high real-time performance such as aero-engines.

articleTitle: Response Time Analysis of Parallel Tasks under Global Fixed-priority on Heterogeneous Multi-cores
abstract: Heterogeneous multi-core platforms can provide diverse computing power. By using different cores to perform specific workloads, the advantages of heterogeneous multi-cores can be fully utilized to achieve high performance and low power consumption. In this paper, we study the problem of schedulability analysis of parallel directed acyclic graph (DAG) tasks on heterogeneous platforms. The DAG task studied in this paper has particularities. A vertex of a DAG task is only allowed to execute on a specific set of cores. In this paper, we study each DAG task’s worst-case response time(WCRT) analysis problem and propose an analyzed method for this particular task model. The new method profoundly looks at the higher priority tasks and combines them with the task graph structure information. Searching for the graph structure is time-consuming, so we propose an efficient analysis method that can be performed in polynomial time. We use simulation experiments to verify the accuracy and time consumption of the proposed algorithm. And the results show that our proposed method can significantly improve the existing method.

articleTitle: Neural Network Extended State-Observer
