In recent years, it has been applied to automatic train regulation (ATR) as well for its advantages in large-scale complex system control. ATR plays an important role in rail transportation as it can improve efficiency and ensure the service quality of train operations. There is a need for an in-depth understanding of MPC-based ATR methods. This paper aims to summarize the recent works on applications of MPC to ATR and to explore the possible research directions in the future. In particular, we review representative methods based on centralized model predictive control (CMPC) and distributed model predictive control (DMPC).

articleTitle: Design Compact YOLO based Network for Small Target Detection on Infrared Image
abstract: most YOLO object detection neural networks prefer to focus on traditional RGB image, but previous studies rarely consider special YOLO network with compact architecture for infrared image. In this paper, we analyze original YOLO network architecture, and we propose a compact YOLO based network by using different blocks from previous work for small target detection on infrared image. We use small target detection layer, GhostConv convolution, Focus structure, Focal EIOU Loss and soft NMS modules to improve original YOLO network structure, which improves the accuracy and speed of target detection for infrared image. The experimental results show that the accuracy of target detection of original model can be effectively improved by adding the small target detection layer, the Focus structure and the BI-FPN structure. By replacing the GhostConv convolution, the calculation speed is significantly improved. At last, after the model is quantized and deployed with NCNN framework, the object detection speed can reached to 35ms per infrared image.

articleTitle: Switching GMM-HMM for Complex Human Activity Modeling and Recognition
abstract: Complex human activities can be decomposed into primitive activities (PAs) that happen sequentially but may vary in order or frequency among different observation sequences. The Gaussian mixture model based hidden Markov model (GMM-HMM) is widely used for activity modeling but is only capable of modeling activities with fixed pattern trajectories. To overcome the drawback of GMM-HMM, a hierarchical structure is introduced to form the Switching Gaussian mixture model based hidden Markov model (S-GMMHMM), where PAs are treated as upper layer states and the continuous observation sequence emitted by each PA is modeled by a GMM-HMM. To ensure that the upper layer states correspond to real activities, a supervised algorithm is proposed for S-GMMHMM parameter estimation. For the purpose of less time complexity, a real-time activity recognition algorithm is proposed by computing activity posteriors recursively. Experiment results show that the proposed model outperforms GMM-HMM in activity recognition, while brings a notable reduction in time complexity.

articleTitle: Leader-follower formation control for multiple mobile robots with velocity constraints *
abstract: This paper deals with leader-follower formation control of mobile robots, including a leader robot trajectory tracking strategy and a follower robot formation maintaining strategy. Robots' control inputs are limited to satisfy practical constraints that restrict the range of feasible leader paths and possible positions of the follower with respect to the leader. First, a backstepping control method is used to develop a trajectory tracking controller that enables the leader robot to track the desired formation trajectory quickly. Then, a Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) technique is employed to transform the formation dynamics of the follower robots into a quadratic programming(QP) optimization problem with velocity constraints. In order to effectively tackle the optimization problem, a Primal-Dual Neural Network (PDNN) solver is implemented to obtain the optimal solution. Finally, numerical simulations are demonstrated to validate the effectiveness of the proposed formation control method.

articleTitle: Modified Ant Colony Optimization with an Application in Sustainable Last-Mile Delivery Routing Problem
abstract: Sustainable last-mile delivery is a critical part of urban logistics, especially in the context of normalization of epidemic prevention and control. The key of the last-mile delivery problem is to design an optimal set of delivery routes with multi-task logistics unmanned ground vehicles. This paper proposes an improved route planning algorithm that takes the recharging cost and total travel time into account. Specifically, based on the ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm, the pheromone concentration of each path is updated by using particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms, which enhances the global exploring ability of the ACO algorithm. In addition, adaptive factors are introduced to balance the flexibility and stability of the considered algorithm. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that the modified ACO algorithm has a better performance and can be suited to the sustainable last-mile delivery routing problem.

articleTitle: Research on Phase Shift Full Bridge Converter Based on Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Technology
abstract: In order to solve the problem of slow dynamic response and poor anti-interference performance of traditional phase shift full bridge converter in double closed-loop proportional integral(PI) control. In this paper, a phase shift full bridge converter based on nonsingular terminal sliding mode technology is proposed. The voltage loop uses a non singular terminal sliding mode controller, and the current loop uses a traditional proportional integral controller. Finally, the simulation is used to compare the nonsingular terminal sliding mode double closed-loop control strategy with the traditional double closed-loop control scheme. The results show that the proposed control strategy has good robustness when the load changes, suppresses high-frequency chattering, shortens the transition time, and meets the requirements of high-quality power.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Inversion of Chlorophyll Content in Maize Leaves Based on Image and Spectrum Fusion
abstract: Chlorophyll content is an important indicator for evaluating the growth status of maize crops. To make full use of hyperspectral information for the prediction of chlorophyll content in maize leaves, this study analyzed the correlation between Gray-level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) features and chlorophyll content, and used Competitive Adaptive Reweighted Sampling (CARS) and Random Frog (RF) to select the sensitive wavelengths of the spectra, and establish a partial least squares regression (PLSR) model for predicting chlorophyll content in maize leaves after fusion of spectral features and image texture features. The results show that the PLSR model constructed by combining the GLCM features with the spectral features selected by CARS has the best effect, and the prediction accuracy is effectively improved compared with that before the fusion of GLCM features, the coefficient of determination R2 is improved from 0.8802 to 0.9104, and the relative analysis error RPD is improved from 3.1938 to 3.6166. Therefore, the PLSR regression model based on GLCM and spectral features can effectively predict the chlorophyll content of maize leaves.

articleTitle: A lightweight algorithm for woven fabric defect detection
abstract: At present, most fabric defect detection algorithms are modified based on the mainstream deep learning network architecture. However, few optimize the depth learning network model according to the fabrics' characteristics; few consider the parameter size of the model. In this paper, we propose a lightweight module for the fabric characteristics— Fabric module (FM). We use YOLOX-Nano as the basic network and replace the SPP module with FM. We tested the network model on the public data of Tianchi and compared it with the best result of the preliminary contest Tianchi. The experimental results show that our method can improve the accuracy and speed, and is more suitable for the automatic detection of fabric defects.

articleTitle: Research and Evaluation Analysis of Power Internet of Things Standard Evaluation System Based on Structure Entropy - Factor Analysis
abstract: With the continuous development of the Power Internet of Things, the imperfection of its standard architecture and standard content is becoming increasingly significant, and there is a lack of a unified Power Internet of Things standard evaluation system. Based on this, a fuzzy comprehensive standard evaluation model based on structural entropy-factor analysis is constructed. First of all, the paper constructs the first-level indicators of the standard evaluation index system from the three dimensions of state, quality and economy, and then uses the structural entropy-factor analysis optimization method to screen out the 12 second-level indicators of the standard evaluation index system to form a standard evaluation system for power Internet of Things; Based on this evaluation system, the evaluation model is constructed by using the comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method. Finally, a case study is conducted, and the results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the standard evaluation model constructed.

articleTitle: UAV/USV Cooperative Trajectory Optimization Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: With the development of unmanned technology, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned surface vehicle (USV) cooperative system is becoming more and more important in offshore operations. This paper consider the target search task on the sea, which requires USV to search target quickly, and UAV to track the USV in order to improve the observation accuracy and complete the task cooperatively. Based on target probability map model, a deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on proximal policy optimization (PPO) is adopted to optimize the search trajectory of USV. The PPO is also used to solve the UAV standoff tracking problem. The simulation results show that the deep reinforcement learning method can plan a reasonable search trajectory for USV, and UAV can achieve more accurate standoff tracking.

articleTitle: An improved WiFi fingerprint location method for indoor positioning
abstract: Following the growth of wireless communication technology, indoor positioning is increasingly evolving and the location fingerprint positioning based on WiFi has gradually become a hot spot in the field of positioning technology. However, interferences for instance multi-path, shadow and noise effect in indoor area will cause WiFi signal fluctuation, which leads to deviation of fingerprint data. WiFi signal attenuation with distance is nonlinear so the traditional signal distance cannot accurately represent the physical distance. In order to handle the aboves, this paper proposes an improved WiFi fingerprint location method. A hybrid filtering algorithm based on Grubbs test is designed to reduce the noise of sampled RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indication) in the offline part. A weighted Euclidean distance is designed to improve the WKNN in the online part. The results show that the proposed filtering algorithm eliminates the gross errors and accidental errors. The improved WKNN could observably reduce the location error. The localization accuracy can reach 1.87m, which is 17.3% better than 2.26m of KNN and 3.1% better than 1.93m of WKNN.

articleTitle: Spatial Temporal Block Transformer Network for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
abstract: Recently, skeleton-based action recognition has be-come very popular in areas such as autonomous driving and environmental awareness due to its small data size and high ac-curacy. Graph convolutional networks (GCN) can model skeleton data well by adapting to the graph structure of the skeleton. However, GCN lacks the ability to extract global spatial and temporal dependencies. Moreover, an action is not only formed by one single skeleton point or frame but several skeleton points and frames. In this paper, a novel spatial-temporal block transformer network based on the self-attention mechanism is proposed, which efficiently models global spatial-temporal dependencies. The model uses spatial-temporal blocks as input, and spatial-temporal feature aggregation modules are applied to enhance the information exchange between blocks. Extensive experiments on the two skeleton-based action recognition datasets show the remarkable performance of our model, which outperforms most GCN-based methods and all transformer-based methods.

articleTitle: An Immersive Learning System with Multimodal Cognitive Processes Inference
abstract: Using multimodal technology to infer learners’ cognitive processes is an important means to support personalized learning. Previous cognitive process analysis is more about subjective reasoning, and less about combining physiological signals. With the rapid development of virtual reality technology, new requirements and more immersive schemes for learner’s cognitive process inferring have been proposed. Based on this, this paper proposes an immersive learning system with multimodal cognitive processes inference, which is composed of macro, mesoscopic and micro environments. The system analyzes learner’s actions, emotions and attention to infer learner’s cognitive process through more comprehensive and objective multimodal data. The system also combines eye movement, brainwaves and other data, and proposes a multimodal data acquisition and analysis scheme using HMD-based VR. This paper also provides an immersive learning cognitive processes inference scheme for individual online learning, offline classroom learning scenarios.

articleTitle: Adaptive Faster Fixed-Time Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Manipulator Systems
abstract: In this paper, a controller which can achieve fixed-time convergence is studied for manipulator systems. Firstly, an adaptive neural network (ANN) is used to estimate the unknown parts and external disturbances of the system. Secondly, a piecewise sliding mode variable is used to realize the nonsingular control of the terminal sliding mode. Then, in order to improve the tracking speed of the manipulator system, a faster fixed-time control algorithm is designed, and the tracking error can converge within a faster fixed-time. Finally, the practicability of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Formation control for second-order nonlinear multi-agent systems with external disturbances via adaptive method
abstract: This study examines the leader-following formation control problem for a particular class of nonlinear multi-agent systems with external disturbances. First of all, the system’s external disturbance is compensated for by the disturbance observer. Second, the adaptive technique is used to provide a completely distributed control protocol. It is demonstrated that the distributed control protocol is capable of achieving system formation control by choosing the suitable parameters. Then the validity of the protocol is verified using a simulated example.

articleTitle: RGB-D SLAM Based on Semantic and Geometry for Indoor Dynamic Environments
abstract: A large portion of existing visual SLAM algorithms are proposed for a static environment, and this static assumption can largely limit the use of SLAM systems in most scenes. For dynamic objects in certain scenes, the accuracy of most SLAM systems degrades or even stops working. To solve this problem, we propose an RGB-D SLAM system for dynamic environments, which avoids the negative impact of dynamic objects in the environment by identifying them for rejection. To reduce the computational cost and improve the running time of the system, we use a lightweight neural network to perform semantic segmentation of dynamic objects. In addition, we use a geometric module that combines multi-view geometry with depth information to detect unknown moving objects to ensure the robustness of the system. We evaluate our system under the TUM public dataset and the results show that our proposed system reduces the computational cost and increases the system operation speed while still ensuring the robustness.

articleTitle: Predictive Current Control of PMSM Based on Parameter Identification of Combat Vehicles
abstract: In order to make a good change to the system dynamic response, cut down the steady-state error of the follower control system on a type of combat vehicles, model predictive control (MPC) is employed to propose a novel current controller to replace the traditional vector control system by PI controller. To solve the problem of degradation of performance due to mismatch of parameters between model and actual motor during the actual operation of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), a control method by using model predictive current on account of least squares method (LSM) including forgetting factor is submitted in the paper. The design establishes an online identification system for the resistance in the stator winding, inductance in the stator and magnetic chain in this PMSM, and applies the identified parameters as input variables adding predictive current control to the aim model to come to realize the effective online updating of the parameters of the real-time change of the control model. The simulation and analysis of conclusion made it evident that the proposed approaches improves the performance and the efficiency of the control methods by predictive current under the change of parameters in the motor.

articleTitle: Improved A-star Algorithm for Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Sixteen-direction Search
abstract: An A-star algorithm is realized by changing the dynamic weights of heuristic functions when path planning in sixteen search directions, improving the problems present in traditional A-star algorithm at some aspects. Firstly, the search direction of the mobile robot is increased and changed from the ordinal eight-direction search to sixteen-direction search against long planning path. Secondly, the dynamic weight adjustment method is given to adjust the weight coefficients of the estimated cost h(n) in the A-star algorithm in real time to address redundant search nodes. Finally, the path is optimized using the turn-angle strategy aim for fewer turning times. Simulation experiments are carried out by MATLAB under a given map and regular maps. The experimental results show that the A-star algorithm studied in this paper has fewer search nodes, higher planning efficiency, shorter path length and fewer turns compared with the traditional A-star algorithm, which verifies the feasibility of the above algorithm.

articleTitle: Computer vision-based quantity detection of goods in vending cabinets
abstract: Vending cabinets have always attracted much attention due to the convenient and comfortable shopping experience they have brought to users. However, higher commodity recognition accuracy and counting accuracy pose great challenges to the research on smart vending cabinets. This paper presents a method of goods recognition and counting for creative cultural products sales cabinet based on computer vision. The self-made data set is enhanced by field acquisition and image preprocessing algorithm, so that the training resources are the closest to the real sale scene. The YOLOv4 deep learning network model is used for transfer training, and the bounding box-based counting algorithm is introduced to accomplish a task of the products’ type and quantity detection. It helps administrators monitor the real scene in the on-site container, timely replenish goods and master the first-hand sales quantity information. In addition to overcoming the risk of loss caused by the lack of timely and real feedback of the commodity information in the traditional container, this method also solves the problems faced by the weighing container in the market, such as the disorder and destruction of goods by customers, and the inventory count error caused by the deformation of the weighing sensor. Experiments show that the average training accuracy of system product recognition is 98.4 %, and the average accuracy of functional test of recognizing and counting is 97.79 %.

articleTitle: SLAM/Calibration of Multiple LiDARs Using Nonlinear Observers: Algorithm and Simulation
abstract: This paper considers a nonlinear observer method for robust SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping) with online calibration parameter estimation. Our design contains the design of a continuous-time pose/landmark observer in a cascaded interconnection with a robust discrete-time calibration parameter estimator. Both the nonlinear observers are potential to possess certain stability as well as appealing robustness in a sense of input-to-state stability (ISS) like characterizations. The proposed results are also illustrated by extensive numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Two-Wheeled Self-Balancing Vehicle
abstract: The ability of two-wheeled self-balancing vehicles to reject disturbances actively is decisive for the applicability to practical activities. Bearing this view in mind, we study active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) of two-wheeled self-balancing vehicles and its implementation. Based on the dynamics of the vehicle, the ADRC control framework is developed in terms of online estimation and compensation of the modelling error and disturbances. The effectiveness of the ADRC with different combinations of control modules are presented via numerical simulations to achieve good transient performance and guide the selection of design parameters. Compared with the PID control in the same parameter setting, the experiments performed on an actual two-wheeled self-balancing vehicle demonstrate that the developed ADRC scheme enables the vehicle to operate more reliably and efficiently in the presence of sudden disturbances.

articleTitle: Deep Vision-Based Intelligent Measuring Method for Two Liquid Levels of Aluminum Electrolysis
abstract: The two liquid levels of aluminum electrolysis refer to aluminum liquid level and electrolyte level, which are important control parameters for the aluminum electrolytic production. The traditional measurement of the two liquid levels is time-consuming, labor-intensive and dangerous. In this paper, we propose an intelligent measuring method applied to inspection robots, which overcomes the drawbacks of the traditional measurement. This method uses an RGB-D camera to capture images of the brazing rod to be measured. Then, the coordinates of the full-length endpoints of the two liquid levels are located by the threshold segmentation algorithm based on HSV color space. Due to the difficulty in locating the boundary between the two liquid levels through image processing algorithms, this paper applies deep learning to industrial production. We train a semantic segmentation model to segment the characteristic electrolyte region. Then the edge of the segmentation region is used to locate the coordinates of the boundary, which improves the robustness. Finally, we project the obtained coordinates into three-dimensional space and calculate the Euclidean distance. The tests show that the error between the algorithm-calculated values and the truth values is within 1cm, which meets the industrial requirements. The proposed method has the advantages of safety, stability and accuracy, which promotes the automation of the aluminum electrolysis production.

articleTitle: Generalized Zero-shot Learning Fault Diagnosis Framework Based on Anomaly Detection and Contractive Stacked Autoencoder
abstract: Recently, data-driven fault diagnosis approaches have shown competitive results. However, some fault samples never occur or are difficult to be obtained, which are called zero-sample. Since a training data set containing zero-sample fault cannot be created, traditional deep learning methods can not realize fault diagnosis of zero-sample. To settle this issue, a fault diagnosis framework based on anomaly detection and contractive stacked autoencoder (CSA) is proposed to achieve zero-shot learning, which consists of a zero-sample fault discriminator, a feature extractor and a fault classifier. After training CSA by using the samples of seen fault classes, the extracted features and the error between the reconstruction and the input of CSA are utilized to construct a novel zero-sample fault discriminator. When the dataset consists of seen classes and unseen classes, the designed discriminator can distinguish whether the test samples belong to the unseen classes. If the test samples belong to the unseen classes, it can be further identified by the designed discriminator; If the test samples belong to the seen classes, it is classified by supervised learning. By using the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) dataset, the effect of our proposed framework is verified.

articleTitle: Intermittent fault detection for linear discrete-time stochastic systems with unknown disturbance under Round-Robin protocol
abstract: The problem of intermittent fault (IF) detection is studied for a class of linear discrete-time stochastic systems with unknown disturbance under the influence of a class of networked phenomena by using the moving horizon estimation (MHE). Aiming to normalise the transmission of data in network systems, the Round-Robin (RR) protocol is introduced for linear discrete-time stochastic systems, so the system is converted to a linear periodic system. By using the lifting technique and superposition principle, the linear periodic discrete-time system is transformed into a linear discrete time-invariant system. An MHE strategy is developed to cope with unknown disturbance by introducing provisional estimates of external unknown disturbances. By utilizing the moving horizon estimator, a scalar residual decoupled from the unknown disturbance is designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Distributed Dual Objective Sampled-data Control of Energy Storage Systems
abstract: In this work, we take into account the dual objective control issue for an energy storage system (ESS). For one thing, the total ESS’s power output ought to meet a certain reference value. For another, all energy storage units (ESUs) must have a balanced state-of-energy (SOE) in order to preserve the system power capacity at its highest level. To this end, a sampled-data distributed control scheme is proposed so as to achieve both state-ofenergy balancing and power tracking subject to the reliable and fixed communication network, where the range of sampling period is obtained by the standard procedure. An illustrative example is offered to support the efficacy of the provided control approach.

articleTitle: An improved RNA genetic algorithm without mutation operation in the later stage
abstract: In the late stage of the population evolution of the RNA genetic algorithm, mutation may destroy the individual genes with higher fitness, resulting in slower convergence or no optimal solution. Therefore, this paper proposes an RNA genetic algorithm that does not add mutation operations in the late stage of evolution (Referred to as nmlsRNA-GA), in the early stage of evolution, the goal is to find the approximate location of the optimal solution. The two-point crossover and fixed-probability mutation operations are performed in the crossover pool composed of individuals with high fitness and individuals with low fitness to increase the diversity of the population. In order to improve the global search ability of the algorithm. In the later stage of the evolution, the goal is to improve the local search ability to determine the optimal solution, and use individuals with high adaptability to cross over individuals with high adaptability to generate individuals with higher adaptability, thereby improving search Accuracy, no mutation operation is added at this stage to prevent mutation from destroying excellent genes. By optimizing five typical high-dimensional test functions, and comparing them with the RNA genetic algorithm that uses mutation throughout the process, the analysis results show that the algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: A Randomized Variable Neighborhood Search Algorithm for solving the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
abstract: With the rapid development of market economy and the evolution of modern technology, logistics industry has also achieved great development. In logistics distribution, the optimization of distribution path plays a vital role in improving service quality, reducing logistics costs and improving economic benefits for enterprises. Because of the low efficiency of the single heuristic algorithm in solving Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), this paper proposes a new hybrid algorithm. This hybrid algorithm uses the greedy algorithm to get initial solution, and takes random variable neighborhood search(VNS) as the local search method, and combined with the Metropolis acceptance criteria. The proposed algorithm tests many instances which are widely used and compares with the other heuristic algorithm. In particular, it is capable of finding the optimal solution for all tested instances and it is much faster than the well-known Lin-Kernighan-Helsgaun (LKH) algorithm in terms of computational speed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Formation Framework with Obstacle Avoidance Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Multi-robot formation control is a control technology that enables robots to maintain a specific formation and adapt to environmental constraints during task execution. In practical application, it is important to maintain structure and adaptively avoid obstacles. Therefore, a multi-robot adaptive formation obstacle avoidance framework is proposed in this paper. There are two pieces to this framework. An obstacle avoidance navigation algorithm built on reinforcement learning makes up the first section. Additionally, we optimize the system’s reward function using the artificial potential field method (APF). In the second part, we design a new formation control strategy based on the leader-follower model and propose the virtual obstacle avoidance point (VOAP) to solve the overlapping problem between virtual target points and obstacles in the leader-follower model. The results of the simulations demonstrate that the proposed formation obstacle avoidance framework can make unmanned ground vehicles (UGV) carry out formation keeping and adaptive obstacle avoidance independently.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition Method Fused with Attention Mechanism
abstract: For the problems of the traditional methods in the process of small target detection of traffic signs, such as being susceptible to environmental factors, poor real-time performance and weak generalization ability, this paper proposes an improved road traffic sign detection and recognition method based on YOLOv5 target detection model. Firstly, the original target box in YOLOv5 network which was not suitable for this detection task is improved, and the clustering method of target box obtained from the original network was optimized to K-Means++ clustering method to generate new anchor coordinates. Secondly, the CSP structure of YOLOv5 network was replaced by the CSPGhost structure composed of Ghost module. The CBAM attention mechanism module is added behind the backbone network to improve the image feature extraction ability of the network model. Finally, the detection layer structure of the model is improved, and the detection scale of the target is increased to improve the detection accuracy of the model for small targets. In order to verify the effectiveness of the improved network, a model comparison experiment is designed in this paper. It shows that 45 types of traffic signs are detected on TT100K traffic sign dataset. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved network is improved by 7.26% compared with YOLOv5 network.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Speed Forecasting Based on Singular Spectrum Analysis, Fuzzy C-Means Clustering, and Improved POABP
abstract: To enhance the wind speed prediction precision, we propose a hybrid prediction model based on singular spectrum analysis (SSA), fuzzy c-mean clustering (FCM), and an improved pelican optimization algorithm (IPOA-BP). First, the original wind speed signal is denoised by SSA; second, classifying BP input data using FCM, and the classification counts of two different data sets are obtained by multiple experiments; third, the improved pelican optimization algorithm (IPOA) is used to optimize the weights and thresholds. The final experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper has higher prediction accuracy compared with the other five models.

articleTitle: A positioning method of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor based on fuzzy iterative learning control
abstract: In this article, to guarantee the positioning performance of the precise electromechanical servo system, a fuzzy iterative learning control method is proposed for the repeated execution of the same task. The permanent magnet linear synchronous motors (PMLSM) is foreced to follow a time-impact optimal 5-th order polynomial trajectory under PID controller to reach the target point fast and smoothly. Furthermore, an iterative learning control (ILC) method is added as a feedforward controller to compensate the error caused by repetitive disturbances. In order to improve the convergence speed and robustness of the iteration, a zero-phase-error filter and a fuzzy term are attached to ILC. Comparative experiments are carried out on the PMLSM of an H-type gantry stage. Various results consistently indicate that the proposed positioning method can achieve the positioning accuracy better than PID controller ,faster convergence speed and better robustness than ordinary ILC.

articleTitle: Research on walking stairs of wheeled-legged robot based on leg structure transformation
abstract: When using the quadruped control mode to climb and descend stairs, the common wheeled-legged robot is prone to overturn due to the collision between the knee joint and the stairs. In this paper, virtual model control method is used as the basic control method, and the deformation mode of leg configuration is designed through the wheeled characteristics of wheeled-legged robot. It can select its Elbow or Knee structures for the ascending and descending stairs. All this work obtains satisfactory results the Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Magnetic column defect recognition based on Deeplab V3+
abstract: In order to solve the defect detection problem caused by the loss of detail information and low segmentation accuracy of Deeplab V3+ model, an improved Deeplab V3 + semantic segmentation model was proposed to detect magnetic column defects. Firstly, in order to reduce the model's parameter quantity, Mobilenet V2 is updated and used as the skeleton network of Deeplab V3+. Secondly, the attention module is added in the block of Mobilenet V2 network to strengthen the processing of details. Finally, the ASPP module is replaced with the D-ASPP module, which obtains richer semantic information and covers a bigger scale more densely. The experimental findings demonstrate that the novel method's mIoU value is 79.25%, which is 2.88% higher than that of the original Deeplab V3 + algorithm, and the defect recognition precision reaches 96.87%. Parameter quantity is decreased by 52.95%, operation time reduced by 27.8%.

articleTitle: Indoor UAV Integrated Navigation Technology Based on UWB and IMU
abstract: To solve the problem of poor motion tracking of the indoor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), this paper studies the position estimation of Ultra-wideband and Inertial Measurement Units, puts forward an indoor positioning model to estimate the position of UAV, and effectively solves the problem of position tracking accuracy and error caused by NLOS (Non-Line-of-Sight, NLOS). The model uses the concept of data fusion to analyze the data of UWB and IMU by the extended Kalman filter, and then outputs the exact position of the UAV after sensor fusion. First, through the simulation of the model, the model for the position estimation of the UAV reveals the ability of continuous tracking and stability. Secondly, the calibration simulation of the UWB base station is compared with the non-calibration simulation. The results show that the calibrated UWB base station shows more accurate and robust position estimation for the unmanned aerial vehicle after multi-sensor data fusion, which verifies the rationality of multi-sensor data fusion in the proposed algorithm. Compared with existing pose estimation algorithms, the proposed algorithm is more effective for indoor unmanned aerial vehicle navigation, and provides a solution for object tracking under indoor scenes.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Dynamic Interval AHP Threat Assessment Method for Low Observable Targets in Air and Space
abstract: Aiming at the problem of threat assessment of air and space target, a new algorithm for target threat assessment and ranking in intelligent aided decision system is proposed. The algorithm uses the radar characteristics of the targets, such as velocity, acceleration, altitude, heading and electronic interference, as target threat assessment features. Then the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method of multi-attribute decision is used to fuse information, and the judgment matrix of attribute importance is constructed by fuzzy dynamic interval method, which effectively solves the problem of attribute weight changing with time. Finally, the threat degree is determined by sorting the fusion results. The simulation results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Identifying Topology of Complex Networked System Based on Block Orthogonal Matching Pursuit and Nonlinear Conditional Granger Causality
abstract: Network topology represents the influencing mechanism of complex networked system. So it is very important to infer network topology based on the measured data in various fields. In this paper, based on the consideration of nonlinearity, causality and sparsity, a novel method is proposed, termed Block Orthogonal Matching Pursuit-Nonlinear Conditional Granger Causality (BOMP-NCGC). Firstly, Gaussian kernel function is used for fitting the nonlinear system model and the formulation of nonlinear conditional Granger causality is illustrated. Secondly, the block orthogonal matching pursuit is adopted for group sparse selection. Finally, based on the construction of restricted and unrestricted model, nonlinear conditional Granger causality is applied for causal judgement to get the network topology. As a result, the verification of performance is executed by the classical model of gene regulatory network. Compared with linear conditional Granger causality and nonlinear conditional Granger causality, BOMP-NCGC demonstrates the superiority and robustness across the different types of networks.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Task Offloading Strategy Framework for Mobile Edge Computing based on User Collaboration
abstract: With the development of 5G and new mobile services, Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) has become an indispensable key technology to meet the high bandwidth requirements in 5G scenarios, high density and low delay in 5G environment. The focus of MEC is to divide the transaction processing completed by the core node into each edge node for processing, which can make the system more efficient and easy to manage. However, the performance of existing algorithms depends on parameters, which leads to a long execution time and increases the total time consumption of MEC systems. In addition, users that are far away from the MEC server often have poor channel quality. To address these issues, we proposes an Inertia Seagull Optimization Algorithm (ISOA) to calculate the unloading strategy for users with poor channel quality. Firstly, the edge computing system is reconstructed into a specific model, in which the mobile devices with better channel quality and close to the MEC server assist mobile devices with poor channel quality forwarding task. Then, the delay and energy consumption of the whole mobile edge computing scenario model system constructed are taken as the optimization objectives ISOA is introduced to solve the task unloading strategy optimization problem. Finally, simulation experiments with different tasks prove that the proposed framework has better time delay and total system consumption than the traditional algorithm. It has certain engineering practice significance.

articleTitle: Recognition of Pine Wood Affected by Pine Wilt Disease Based on YOLOv5
abstract: In order to recognize pine wood affected by pine wilt disease (PWD) efficiently, a dataset of infected pine wood was constructed and a recognition algorithm YOLOv5-PWD based on YOLOv5 was designed. In the mountainous area of Fushun City, Liaoning Province, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) was used to collect images of infected pine wood at three different heights of 200/220m, 100m and 60/80m, and the images were expanded to establish an infected pine wood dataset. Based on the YOLOv5 framework, combined with Moasic data enhancement, Focus unit and spatial pyramid pooling (SPP) unit, a recognition algorithm for pine wood affected by pine wilt disease was designed. The experimental results show that the mean average precision of the dataset at the 100m collection height is the highest. Compared with the Faster R-CNN algorithm, the mean average precision of YOLOv5-PWD is increased by 16.8%, and the recognition speed is increased by 64.5%.

articleTitle: Research on Local Path Planning for Autonomous Collision Avoidance of USV
abstract: While sailing, unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) should avoid both static obstacles and moving ships, and the collision avoidance between two ships should follow COLREGs, which brings challenges to local path planning. This paper proposes a local path planning algorithm based on a three-stage collision avoidance strategy. The three stages correspond to the moving ship is far away, the moving ship is close but has a low risk of collision, and the moving ship is close and has a high risk of collision, respectively. In the first stage, a dynamic obstacle avoidance maneuverable range and an improved dynamic window approach are proposed, and the environmental influence is introduced to improve collision avoidance efficiency. In the second and third stages, this paper combines velocity obstacle and COLREGs to design the collision avoidance algorithm between USV and moving ship. In order to select the optimal dynamic target point, VO limit is introduced in the second stage, port limit and starboard scoring mechanism are introduced in the third stage. The experimental results show that the algorithm can realize the collision avoidance of USV effectively based on COLREGs.

articleTitle: A Novel Discrete Sliding Mode Controller for MIMO Complex Nonlinear Systems With Uncertainty*
abstract: This article proposes a model-free adaptive-based discrete terminal sliding mode control (MFA-DTSMC) strategy for the multi-input multi-output (MIMO) complex nonlinear systems with model uncertainty and the existence of uncertain external disturbance. Firstly, the compact form dynamic linearization (CFDL) model of system is used to deal with the part of model-free adaptive, and pseudo-Jacobin matrix (PJM) estimation algorithms only depend on the data of system. The disturbance estimation algorithm is utilized to resolve the problem of disturbance of the system. Further, by utilizing the discrete terminal sliding mode control (DTSMC), the MIMO MFA-DTSMC strategy is proposed to improve the control performances which are tracking accuracy and inhibit disturbance. Finally, a two-tank system is used as a typical example, the simulation results confirm that the MFA-DTSMC strategy proposed has good performances than the traditional sliding mode control (SMC) method.

articleTitle: Field Grape Berry Counting Algorithm Based on Spatial Attention Mechanism
abstract: Automated grape yield estimation is one of the important aspects of intelligent vineyard management. In order to meet requirements of fast estimation and large-scale grape yield estimation in complex field environments, this paper proposes a Spatial Attention Grape Berry Counting Network (SAGBCNet). Firstly, the Spatial Feature Network (SFNet) is used to extract more spatial information of grape berries in image. Then attention mechanism is used to adaptively fit the long-distance context features of location and channel, so as to effectively distinguish the grape berry from background. Finally, through Feature Fusion Network, feature maps of different scales are fused to generate the predicted density map, and counting results of grape berries in the field are obtained. The experiment on the field grape counting dataset showed that SAGBCNet obtained a lower counting error for grape berries. The mean absolute error (MAE) and mean squared error (MSE) were 35.39 and 47.39 respectively.

articleTitle: Learning Greenhouse Climate Control Policy from Monitored Data
abstract: The knowledge of solar greenhouse growers on environment control plays an important role in greenhouse production and management. We proposed a way to extract the control strategies from the monitored data of greenhouses by building a long short-term memory (LSTM) model. The result is verified according to the real monitored data of a solar greenhouse, which shows that the model can learn the control strategy of a ventilator in the solar greenhouse. Through monitored data and models, the knowledge of greenhouse ventilation control can be learned, and automatic control can be achieved in a greenhouse with a similar configuration.

articleTitle: Curve Path Following Based on Improved Line-of-Sight Algorithm for USV
abstract: In this paper, we propose an adaptive forward-looking distance tracking algorithm for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) based on extended state observer (ESO) so as to track the curve path better when sailing at sea. Firstly, the setting waypoints are interpolated to generate the curve path by using the cubic Hermite algorithm. Then, aiming at the problem of large tracking error caused by fixed forward-looking distance in traditional line-of-sight (LOS) guidance algorithm, we introduce a function of cruise speed, cross-tracking error, path curvature and turning radius of the vessel to adjust the forward-looking distance adaptively. In addition, a guiding law is designed to compensate for the navigation error caused by the time-varying sideslip angle, and the angle can be accurately estimated online based on ESO. Finally, the S-plane controller is adopted to control the heading of the vessel. Simulation experiments show that the designed path tracking algorithm can achieve good tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Path Tracking Control of Four-wheel Independent Driving High Ground Clearance Sprayer Considering Rollover
abstract: In this research, the path tracking control and the anti-roll control are constructed based on the kinematic model of the sprayer, respectively. The upper layer uses model predictive control (MPC) to output the desired steering angle and speed of the sprayer based on the current state of the sprayer and the desired path to achieve path tracking control. The lower layer controller uses lateral load transfer rate (LTR) as a measure of rollover to judge whether the vehicle state produces rollover, and compensates for steering angle by introducing a fuzzy controller, which in turn controls the LTR to stabilize at a certain threshold value. So that the sprayer has both better control accuracy and better safety in the process of path tracking, and ensure that the sprayer does not roll. The combined simulation results of ADAMS/MATLAB show that the LTR can be controlled within 0.5 when the sprayer adopts anti-roll control under complex road conditions, which ensures the safety of the sprayer, and the lateral deviation reaches 0.13m, which has a high path tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Control of a Novel Cable Driven Parallel Mechanism
abstract: The cable driven parallel mechanism(CDPM) has the advantage of high mobility and low inertia, it is widely used in rehabilitation robot, wind tunnel simulation and many industrial scenes. This paper focus on a type of CDPM with only two rotational degrees of freedoms(DoFs). Through the proper design of the structure, the motion of the mechanism can be measured accurately. Then on the basis of kinematics and dynamics analysis, a linear active disturbance rejection control(LADRC) method is proposed to achieve the precise control of the CDPM. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Handwritten Manchu Historical Document Segmentation with Anisotropic Gaussian Kernel
abstract: It is key technology for handwritten historical document image analysis to segment text lines. There is no doubt that it is very difficult for text line segmentation owning to varied forms of handwritten Manchu historical document images. A novel method for handwritten Manchu historical document segmentation is presented. Initially, this method extracts the blob lines of the text lines by anisotropic Gaussian kernel and obtains connected components by contours. Then, it breaks the adhesion region between lines which is obtained by blob lines merging. Finally the detected text line and connection components combine to form the initial text line region, and text lines segmentation is achieved by boundary area growing. Results of segmentation for heterogeneous documents are provided, and the proposed method is compared with projection profit and seam craving methods in the same settings. The method is good at handling the skew and adhesion Manchu text lines. Tested on dataset of handwritten Manchu historical documents, the recall of 97.57% correct lines is achieved by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Light Field Depth Estimation Based on Channel Attention and Edge Guidance
abstract: Light field images incorporate the angular and spatial distortion of the captured light. Benefiting from the abundant information contained in the light field, depth estimation emerges as one of its key applications. In this article, we presented a neural network in order to precisely estimate the depth of the light field. The proposed network fully considers the rich feature information of the full light field image, designs an attention mechanism to select more valuable views in the same channel branch and performs multi-feature fusion to enhance the inference accuracy of the occluded region. Meanwhile, the network extracts the edge detail features of the target for guidance to provide more effective information for depth estimation. The proposed network achieves positive results and performance on the commonly used 4D HCI dataset in quantitative, qualitative, and computational cost evaluations.

articleTitle: Research on the detection method of alignment beacon based on the spatial structure feature of train bogies
abstract: The high-speed train inspection robot needs to perform alignment parking and image acquisition at the position of the train bogie, and reliable alignment identification marks are the basis for the inspection robot to achieve highprecision alignment parking. The existing alignment method is mainly based on the way of artificial beacons, in the inspection workshop through manual laying of additional identification marks such as QR codes, magnetic stripes, RFID electronic tags, auxiliary robot alignment parking, but this type of method in beacon maintenance, laying costs and other aspects have certain limitations. Aiming at the problem, this paper proposes a vision-based bogie beacon detection method, which combines the target detection technology with the unique bogie spatial structure feature of the train, and provides reliable identification marks for the alignment and parking of the inspection robot. This method improves the alignment accuracy, reduces the cost of laying and maintaining artificial beacons, and has high application value.

articleTitle: Path Optimization of AGV in The Environment of Smart Bookstore
abstract: This article is based on the smart bookstore in the laboratory, aiming at the problem that the RRT* algorithm has a big sampling range, vast traversed nodes, low search efficiency and long time for the searched path in the path search, a target bias strategy is set up, which combines the artificial potential field method and the RRT* algorithm. And applied to the path planning of AGV to accelerate the movement of AGV to the target point, improved the efficiency of path search, and compared the RRT algorithm, RRT* algorithm, and improved RRT* algorithm through Matlab simulation experiments, the simulation results illustrate that the improved RRT* algorithm used in this article can reduce the number of traversing nodes and take a shorter time to find a reasonable driving path in the environment of the smart bookstore.

articleTitle: Non-fragile control of car system based on observer
abstract: For a series of systems which is uncertain and delay in time, considering the vulnerability of the controller, a robust non-fragile H<inf>∞</inf> controller about this was designed based on state observer when the system state could not be measured directly. It is applied to vehicle system control simulation to realize dynamic lateral obstacle avoidance robust and precise control of intelligent vehicle, and the effectiveness of state observer and the feasibility of robust non-fragile H<inf>∞</inf> control are verified.

articleTitle: Compensation Type Improved Droop Control Based Current Sharing Method of Parallel DC-DC Converter
abstract: In order to realize the current sharing of parallel DC-DC converter under different line resistances, and to guarantee constant bus voltage and improve the power supply quality, a compensation type improved droop control strategy is proposed. Aiming at the common node voltage which cannot be accurately measured by the traditional droop method, the compensation formula is derived by using the converter output voltage and bus voltage, and the control accuracy of current sharing method of parallel DC-DC converter is improved. Due to the droop coefficient and line resistance of the converter in parallel, the bus voltage decreases, so it is necessary to increase the voltage compensation term to reduce the bus voltage deviation. Then the simulation analysis is carried out. The simulation is compared with the traditional droop method and the droop method with voltage compensation term. Finally, the simulation and experimental results are analyzed, and it is concluded that the proposed control strategy can realize the current sharing and bus voltage drop compensation of the parallel DC-DC converter, and improve the quality of power supply.

articleTitle: A Reinforcement Learning Approach Based on Parameter Prediction for Multi-AUV Task Assignment in Ocean Current
abstract: In this paper, the reinforcement learning (RL) is used to study task assignment problem of multiple autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) in ocean current. To solve the problem that traditional RL is prone to trap into non-optimal policy in training, a RL algorithm based on parameter prediction is proposed. The algorithm consists of four parts: First, we design an objective function with four constraints, including ocean current, task emergency, energy consumption and collision detection. The AUVs need to balance these constraints to find optimal strategy. Second, the reward distribution matrix (RDM) is constructed by the team cumulative reward generated by multiple episodes. Third, the features in RDM are extracted by truncated singular value decomposition, and the features are used to predict the policy feature. Forth, the prediction feature is mapped into policy parameters by its surrounding features, and we design a recovery mechanism to avoid the prediction errors. Finally, we analyze the effectiveness of the algorithm, and the simulation results show that compared with DDQN, our algorithm have a better performance.

articleTitle: Fault Reconstruction Method of Ship Power Grid based on Improved Gray Wolf Optimizer
abstract: A mathematical model is established for the purpose of rapid and accurate fault reconstruction of ship power grid and the improvement of grid reliability and vitality. In view of the unsatisfactory local and global optimal solutions of traditional gray wolf optimizer (GWO), an improved method is put forward for fault reconstruction of ship power grid. the effectiveness of the fault reconstruction method is verified by simulation experiments, together with the practicability of the improved optimizer in the accuracy of the optimal solution.

articleTitle: Representing Objects in Map Building Using A Semantic SLAM Scheme
abstract: In order to make the robot understand the scene better and the human-robot interaction more friendly, a lightweight semantic SLAM system is proposed in this paper. Our system uses a LIDAR combined with a camera to obtain object location in SLAM and determines object information such as category with a CNN-based object detector. The object identities are represented in the form of joint probability distributions that are updated by Bayes’ theorem. The FPA algorithm is used to obtain parameter valuation with maximum posterior probability so as to determine the modeling feature parameters of objects on the map. The similarity between objects is measured with the Bhattacharyya coefficient to avoid duplicate modeling of identified objects in map updating. The proposed system is simulated in Gazebo and an effective scheme balancing accuracy and computation cost is obtained. Finally, experiments on a small indoor robot demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Active Mapping Method for Agricultural Robot Using Frontier-Based Exploration
abstract: Robots play an important role in modern agriculture, however, few studies have been focusing on the robot mapping approach. Most used Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) method usually depends on expert knowledge, which is costly and time consuming. In addition, it’s hard to plan agricultural robots’routes when experts are absent. An active mapping method was proposed using Wavefront Frontier Detector (WFD) and Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT) to select exploration points based on Gmapping algorithm. In this method, 2D LIDAR data were analyzed to select active exploration point, develop Gmapping algorithm, and manage local navigation. A wheeled mobile robot (45 cm * 37 cm * 30 cm) with LIDAR was used in real simulation scene to verify the method’s stability and feasibility. The results showed that the wheeled mobile robot can map the field with an explored region rate of 98.97%.

articleTitle: Multi-view infrared small target recognition based on YOLOv5
abstract: In order to improve the recognition accuracy of small infrared targets in complex environment, a SyluInfrared dataset is built by taking multi-view infrared images with the Frock TiX600 infrared thermal imager. Seven image enhancement algorithms including image brightening, contrast adjustment, image blurring, image flipping and image scaling are designed to improve the image quality of small infrared targets. The YOLOv5 deep learning model is used to identify small infrared targets with multiple views to improve the recognition accuracy of small infrared targets. The experimental results show that the accuracy of multi-view infrared small target recognition model for YOLOv5 deep network is 97.7%, which is 6.6% higher than that of single-view infrared small target recognition model based on YOLOv5. The multi-view target recognition strategy significantly improves the infrared small target recognition performance.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection Based on Lidar-Camera Fusion Using Wasserstein Distance Method
abstract: In the automatic driving environment awareness system, the information obtained by a single sensor is limited and the environmental adaptability is poor, and it is difficult to obtain all the information of the vehicle's environment. Accordingly, in this paper, a novel lidar and camera fusion algorithm by Wasserstein distance method is proposed. In the propose method, the advantage of Wasserstein distance, which has the ability to describe the shape of object, is exploited. Therefore, we use Wasserstein distance to fuse the results of object detections of lidar and camera. In order to demonstrate the propose method, the simulated and real data are proposed. Empirical findings confirm that the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of WOA-VMD-SVM in Fault Diagnosis of Generator Inter-turn Short Circuit
abstract: This paper proposes a feature extraction method based on whale optimization algorithm and variational mode decomposition (WOA-VMD) to overcome the low feature extraction accuracy of generator early inter-turn short circuit fault. WOA-VMD process the current signal, and the sample entropy is taken as the fitness function of WOA to optimize the VMD parameter combination of modal components' number K and penalty parament α. Then, the optimized VMD decomposes current signals into K intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). IMFs with higher kurtosis values are selected to extract energy entropy as the feature vectors. Finally, the whale optimization algorithm and support vector machine (WOA-SVM) pattern recognition model is used to classify the feature vectors and diagnose generator inter-turn short circuit degree. The experiments show that the proposed method extracts the weak fault features in the early inter-turn short circuit signal and improves the fault diagnosis accuracy, reaching 97.75%.

articleTitle: Framework Design of the Industrial Apps Simulation Platform for Networked Collaborative Manufacturing in Cement Industry
abstract: This paper studies the process of industrial App development for cement industry and the basic framework of the support platform for network collaborative manufacturing. The key processes of App development are realized with a concrete case of multi-base collaborative manufacturing in cement industry. In the framework, a complete closed-loop is formed starting from the definition of collaborative problem, abstraction of manufacturing resources, integrated model design, optimization algorithm and low-code development. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility of the supporting platform framework, we design a simulation software to stimulate the overall Apps development environment.

articleTitle: Visual Loop Closure Detection: a fast convolutional auto-encoder based approach
abstract: For a large-scale visual simultaneous localization and mapping (vSLAM) system, robust and fast loop closure detection is very indispensable. It can provide more effective information for back-end optimization, eliminate the drift problem caused by accumulated errors, and provide the relocation function after the tracking algorithm is lost. In this paper, we propose a lightweight unsupervised loop closure detection scheme. The model is built on a convolutional autoencoder network to reconstruct the Sector-ring histogram of oriented gradients (SRHOG) descriptor, not the raw image. SRHOG, which preserves invariance to image geometry and lighting while having good rotation invariance. When deploying, only the encoder vector of low dimensional space is used for image representation. A fast search method of locality-sensitive hashing is adopted, which reduces the query time. We implement our method on the state-of-the-art (SOTA) unsupervised scheme CALC, and through experiments on three datasets, the results show that our proposed method outperforms existing methods.

articleTitle: A GNC Double Super-Real-time Hybrid Simulation System Applied To Long Period Guidance Task
abstract: A GNC mathematical simulation system with double super real-time hybrid simulation capability is proposed to meet the rapid and reliable simulation test, when the system applied to the long time consuming GNC autonomous navigation and guidance task. The system can use with two kinds of super real-time simulation capabilities, named "super real-time of running acceleration" and "super real-time of state jump". Super real-time of running acceleration can realize the closed-loop super real-time simulation of GNC system in the whole process of task "control action" with high simulation accuracy, but the simulation super real-time acceleration ratio is relatively not high. State jump super real-time is recursive oriented to super real-time rapid state in the task "no control" free operation stage. For the long-period guidance mission, it greatly improves the simulation acceleration ratio with the way of ignoring the task "irrelevant" process. These two super real time technologies can be used in coordination and mixed simulation, which can combine the advantages of both, to perfectly meet two demands of the simulation authenticity and rapidness of GNC long period guidance mission.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Dual-arm Robot Task Scheduling Considering Collision Risk
abstract: An optimization method is presented for dual-arm robot task scheduling in this paper. The purpose of task scheduling is to assign tasks and determine optimal task paths for dual-arm robot. The robot tasks are considered as a set of task points. The task scheduling is modeled as a Multi-Objective Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem (MOMTSP) to optimize three goals (total time consumption, takt time and collision risk). An improved algorithm based on Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-II) is proposed for the MOMTSP solution. The simulation demonstrates that the improved algorithm performs faster iterations and better results. Experimental results are shown to prove the method improvement compared with the classical method based on genetic algorithm. The proposed method significantly reduces the collision risk and time consumption.

articleTitle: Distributed secondary control of microgrid with intermittent communication
abstract: Communication line maintenance and repair, external interference and other problems will lead to communication interruption in short time for the microgrid secondary control. If interruption lasts for a long time, DG (Distributed Generation) will not be able to accurately output voltage and frequency. This paper studies the distributed secondary control of microgrid with intermittent communication. Firstly, the mathematical model of a single DG is built through the small signal model analysis method, and the tracking consistency control algorithm is applied to the microgrid secondary control; Then the microgrid control system is approximated as a nonlinear dynamic system. For the nonlinear dynamic system, the exponential stability condition is obtained by using Lyapunov method. Finally, the analysis results are experimentally verified in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Kernel correlation filtering algorithm based on fractional Fourier transform
abstract: Robust tracking is an important and challenging task in the field of computer vision. Kernel correlation filtering is one of the most popular tracking algorithms. Diversity and complexity of tracking objects usually lead to degradation of its tracking performance. To improve the tracking performance, we propose a kernel correlation filtering based on fractional Fourier transform. We replace Fourier transform by fractional Fourier transform. The Peak-to-Sidelobe Ratio of the tracking object in the response map becomes higher, which benefits the tracking performance. Extensive experiments on the dataset OTB100 show the advantage of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Perception and Motion Prediction Based on Driving Scene Features
abstract: Environment perception and motion prediction are crucial tasks for autonomous driving. In recent years, there have been many related researches based on LiDAR point cloud, but most methods only consider the raw point cloud data without considering the scene level features Driving scenarios have unique characteristics, and it is of great significance to fully capture and exploit these characteristics. In this work, we aim to obtain the adaptive features of the main target vehicles and pedestrians in the driving scene without increasing the network parameters, and design the corresponding loss function, so that the network can be trained in a targeted manner. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset show that our method achieves the highest detection accuracy for vehicles and pedestrians on state-of-the-art networks, and the highest average accuracy for detection of all objects.

articleTitle: Parity space based intermittent fault diagnosis for linear time-varying systems over sensor networks
abstract: In this paper, the problem of intermittent faults (IFs) diagnosis is dealt with for linear time-varying systems over sensor networks with unknown inputs. By utilizing the parity space, the residual generators are generated to decouple unknown inputs, and then the detection thresholds are set for IFs according to the probability theory. The intermittent fault location is achieved via a series of residual evaluation functions, where each residual evaluation function is designed to compare with detection thresholds. Then an unknown input observer is established to estimate the augmented state vector, so as to realize the purpose of IFs estimation. Finally, an example is given to verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Security and Trust Protection Framework for Open CNC Production Line
abstract: With the further integration of information technology and industry, the computer numerical control (CNC) production line has gradually changed from the original isolated and closed mode to an open one. It faces not only internal threats, but also threats from the Internet. Starting from the characteristics and cybersecurity problem analysis of open CNC production lines, this paper proposes a security and trust protection framework based on trusted computing 3.0 and the concept of defense in depth, where a tri-element peer architecture is introduced to realize two-way authentication between the access device and the platform and an active immunity scheme for open CNC system is designed to ensure the trust from the source, and the trusted NC-Link agent/adaper are utilized to connect the heterogeneous equipments trustedly in the production line. The proposed framework can improve the information security level of the open CNC production line while maintaining its openness.

articleTitle: ECG abnormalities classification using Deep Learning
abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) is the key to diagnosis of ECG abnormalities including arrhythmia, which represents a great dilemma for physicians. The topic of how to better use deep learning to aid ECG diagnosis has been widely studied in recent years. However, it has not yet been used in the identification of ECG abnormalities with wide QRS complex in normal heart beat. We constructed a dataset of ECGs with 5 distinct kinds of ECG abnormalities with wide QRS complex in normal heart beat, and the normal ECGs (N) served as control group. We developed an AI-enabled system to generate diagnoses of these abnormalities in this dataset. For evaluating the performance of the model, the F1 score, area under the curve (AUC) of receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC), accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and the 95% CI for both sides were calculated separately for the model and the diagnoses result of 3 physicians. Our deep learning model resulted in an accuracy of 96.6%, which is higher than the doctors' average of 86.8%. Our model is promising to distinguish the abnormal part of the normal heart beat containing the wide QRS complex, laying an essential foundation for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems in clinical applications.

articleTitle: Distributed Control for Charge State Equilibrium of Lithium Battery with Different Energy Conversion Efficiency
abstract: The control of charge state equilibrium plays a very important role in the battery energy management system (BEMS) of electric vehicles. Due to the difference of energy conversion efficiency of different cells in the process of charge and discharge, the state of charge (SOC) of different cells becomes unbalanced, which leads to potential safety and stability problems of BEMS. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a distributed charge state regulator with negative feedback control mechanism. It can make the cell with high charge release more energy when discharging and absorb less energy when charging; and conversely, the cell with low charge can release less energy when discharging and absorb more energy when charging. Therefore, the charge state of all the cells can reach the same SOC level after charging and discharging. Finally, the feasibility and stability of the proposed charge state regulator are verified by a specific example.

articleTitle: Detection method of nickel foam foreign matter based on double-branch lightweight network
abstract: Real-time, accurate and rapid detection of defects in nickel foam is a challenging task and plays a crucial role in the quality control of nickel foam production. Currently, research on deep learning-based industrial defect detection usually uses large neural network models to pursue high accuracy, ignoring model complexity and hardware requirements. In order to reduce the application cost, the Detection method of nickel foam foreign matter based on double-branch lightweight network is proposed. First, a lightweight backbone convolutional network is designed to extract features, which reduces computational complexity while effectively extracting features. Then, atrous convolution is used to further optimize the model accuracy, increasing the receptive field of the convolution without losing information, and ensuring the quality of the extracted features. Finally, we use a dual-branch structure for segmentation and classification to dynamically query the detection results of defects. The experimental results on the nickel foam defect dataset show that our model is able to achieve high detection accuracy and single-sheet detection rate, and has strong competitive accuracy and lower detection rate compared with state-of-the-art detectors amount of calculation.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Course-Keeping Control and Its Application to Ship Autopilot
abstract: This paper focuses on the course-keeping control problem for marine ship with the unknown environmental disturbances, system uncertainties and gain uncertainty. Within the backstepping framework, the gain uncertainty problem can be solved by resorting to a Nussbaum function. For the merit of adaptive technique and minimal learning parameter (MLP) method, the unknown system terms and external disturbances can be compressed as a unknown parameter, and only one adaptive law needs to be updated online. By Lyapunov analysis, it could be proved that all tracking errors of the ship control system are globally consistent and bounded. Finally, taking the scientific research ship "YU PENG" as an example, the effectiveness of the algorithm is illustrated by the simulated example.

articleTitle: Robust stabilization of underactuated inertia wheel pendulum system based on disturbance observer
abstract: An inertia wheel pendulum (IWP) is a mechanical system with two degrees of freedom (DOF) and a control input. This paper studies the robust stabilization of this underactuated system. Firstly, we design a disturbance observer to estimate the value of disturbance existed in the system. Secondly, the nonlinear state equations of the IWP are given by a coordinate transformation. After that, a Lyapunov function is designed for this nonlinear system. And a robust stabilizing controller is developed utilizing the Lyapunov theory, an idea of controller switching and the estimated disturbance value. Finally, the effectiveness of our presented method is verified through a numerical example.

articleTitle: High-precision data acquisition method based on differential evolution calibration
abstract: In the process of high purity indium purification and refining, the calibration data time of high precision data acquisition system is not synchronized. Aiming at this problem, this paper constructs the optimization of the data processing parameters, with the linear model as the model of the acquisition data processing parameters, and the equipment display value as the real value of data acquisition. Based on the differential evolution algorithm, the optimization search of model parameters is realized. Finally, taking the temperature data acquisition of single crystal pulling furnace as an example, this paper constructs a high-precision data acquisition system and verifies it by experiments. The experimental results show that with the optimized model parameters, the average error of data acquisition is only 0.14°C, and the accuracy can reach 99.81%. Compared with the non-optimized model parameters, the optimized model parameters significantly improves the accuracy of data acquisition system with the average error is reduced by 61.11%.

articleTitle: Acoustic Target Recognition Method Based on EEG Signals
abstract: In this paper, a novel acoustic target recognition method is proposed by decoding the Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals of an operator when perceiving environmental sound. Taking unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) detection (detection of the presence of drones from sound) as an example, we recorded real environment noise and target sound. Then the experimental paradigm was designed to simulate real acoustic target detection. Clear event-related potentials (ERP) were observed from the EEG signals of 4 subjects. We extracted the time domain features of the EEG signals based on the observed neural representations and designed a CNN(convolution neural network)-based classifier to distinguish the EEG signals in two different states ("normal "versus" target") which was compared with the traditional SVM(support vector machine)-based classifier. The results show that the classification accuracy based on CNN reaches 81.25%, higher than SVM. The method proposed in this paper can be used as the theoretical basis for adding human intelligence to perceive the environment in a target detection system.

articleTitle: Attitude Stabilization Control of Flexible Spacecraft Based on High-Order Disturbance Observer Using Nonlinear Parameter-Varying Perspective
abstract: The control technique based on high order nonlinear disturbance observer is used to study the high precision attitude control problem of flexible spacecraft (HONDO). For the flexible spacecraft model, a nonlinear parameter variation (NPV) framework built on Lyapunov is applied. A composite control technology for attitude stability of flexible spacecraft is proposed by combining HONDO and controller created using SOS theory.
