This is done under the influence of elastic vibration caused by flexible mode, parameter perturbation caused by modeling, and fast time-varying disturbance. Many of the aforementioned interferences are calculated using the proposed HONDO, and its estimated values are derived. Second, the status feedback controller is compensated with the estimated value. The state feedback controller can cause the spacecraft stiff body to stabilize exponentially based on SOS theory.

articleTitle: An improved Generative Adversarial Network for Denoising EEG signals of brain-computer interface systems
abstract: Removing artifact contamination from electrooculogram (EOG) and electromyography (EMG) signals is a key preprocessing step for detecting and diagnosing Electroencephalography (EEG) signals. Previous traditional approaches to denoising depend on inherent experience and prior knowledge, which is clearly detrimental to the development of real-time brain-computer interface (BCI) systems. Several methods have been proposed for end-to-end denoising using deep learning networks recently, but effectively improving the accuracy and robustness of denoising remains a great challenge. Here, we carefully design a novel Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) neural network framework including a generator (G) and discriminator (D) where the G is used to remove artifacts in EEG and reproduce the original signal. Through the relevant tests on the EEG data set, the experimental results indicate that our algorithm far outperforms the three benchmark models in the case of the worst signal contamination, especially showing converges quickly and rarely appears mode collapses during the training process which may better promote the development of real-time EEG denoising in the BCI.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of FPGA-based hardware acceleration system for target detection
abstract: Since the application of target detection in convolutional neural networks is becoming more and more widespread, and the computational volume is increasing, the complexity of the network hierarchy and the memory requirements are gradually increasing, so according to the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) parallel computing characteristics, using FPGA to accelerate the convolutional neural network hardware, can design a CPU+FPGA target detection hardware acceleration system. The system adopts the YOLOv2 target detection algorithm and divides the tasks according to the network structure of the algorithm, and at the same time, it quantifies the 32-bit floating-point numbers of the algorithm with 16-bit fixed points, optimizes the convolutional, pooling, and reordering layers of the algorithm, and finally designs the algorithm by using the HLS high-level synthesis. The system uses PYNQ-Z2 platform to implement the convolutional neural network YOLOv2, and the final system performance reaches 27.06GOPs (Giga Operations Per Second, 1 billion operations/s), and the power consumption is only 2.609W, compared to CPU (E5-2620V4), its performance is 6.58 times that of CPU, and the power consumption is only 3% of the CPU, which has certain advantages compared with current target detection systems.

articleTitle: Unknown Input Observer Design for Vehicle Based on Interval Type-2 TS Fuzzy Model
abstract: It’s presented the design of the unknown input (UI) observer to estimate vehicle system’s states. The article builds fuzzy model for vehicle by using type-2 TS fuzzy model. The vehicle fuzzy model’s premise variables exist uncertain information, due to the complication of the driving environment. The uncertain information leads to the uncertainty of membership function. Type-1 TS fuzzy model has limitation to solve the uncertainty of membership function problem. This paper applied to interval type-2 TS fuzzy model to deal with the uncertainty of membership function. In addition, the vehicle model is a complex system, and it can be seen as a highly complex nonlinear system. TS fuzzy model is one of effective methods to solve the nonlinear system problem. When describing the vehicle system by TS fuzzy model, there are needed a lot of rules, that increase the complexity of the calculation, and reduces control efficiency. To reduce the complexity of calculation and increase control efficiency, the N-TS vehicle fuzzy model is builded.

articleTitle: An Improved Remora Optimization Algorithm with Lens Opposition-Based Learning for Global Optimization
abstract: The remora optimization algorithm (ROA) is one of the newly proposed swarm behavior-based algorithms. During the implementation of ROA, each search agent updates its position with the host, which leads to the algorithm difficult to converge and solve complex engineering problems. To alleviate these situations, Lens Opposition-Based Learning (LOBL) is added in this paper to optimize the performance of ROA when solving complex problems. The improved algorithm called IROA. LOBL is inspired by the imaging principle of the optical lens. Moreover, the LOBL strategy can improve the probability of the traditional ROA escaping from the local optimal solution. To bear out that the proposed IROA is functional, this paper selects 13 benchmark functions to prove the superiority of the improvement. By comparing IROA with five meta-heuristics, the experiment results illustrate that the IROA is more effective in working out benchmark optimization problems. Additionally, the performance of IROA in car crashworthiness design also reveal that IROA can get the optimal solution in solving practical optimization problems. Generally speaking, all the above experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Path Planning Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of genetic algorithm in robot path planning, such as blindness and randomness of initial population, too many path turning points and easy to fall into local optimization, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed. The prior knowledge is used to initialize the path in the direction of the target point, and the continuous and obstruction-free collision path is further obtained to enhance convergence rate. A new fitness function is designed combining the path length and the number of turning points to improve the efficiency of path planning. Simulation results show that compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the shortest path of the improved genetic algorithm can be shortened by 9.97%, and it is better than the traditional genetic algorithm in convergence rate and the number of turning points.

articleTitle: Configuration strategy of integrated energy system considering economic and dynamic characteristics
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) coupled with different equipment has attracted widespread interest owing to its high efficiency. However, the dynamic characteristics are rarely considered in configuration, which may leave little optimization room for dispatch. Hence this paper proposes a dynamic performance index to take the dynamic characteristics into full consideration. Firstly, the static model and dynamic model of each device are formulated, and PI controllers are implemented. Secondly, the mathematical description of the optimization problem is given, including the objective function, optimization strategy and constraints. It is worth mentioning that the dynamic objective is derived from the time scale. Afterwards, the economic and comprehensive objective combining economic and dynamic objectives are implemented. Finally, in order to testify the availability of the comprehensive objective, dynamic deviation of the configuration results is computed. The results indicate that the configuration strategy using the comprehensive objective reduces the total deviation by 5.56% in dynamic dispatch.

articleTitle: Implementation of dual capture data storage based on a high-speed data acquisition unit
abstract: With the rapid development of high-speed data capture technology, the performance of data process, analysis, and storage in the data acquisition unit has become a vital part of the data acquisition system. Especially, the dual capture mode is quite important function for a long-time waveform analysis and special points catching. Because of its high demand for high-speed, very-deep storage and risk of address hopping, it is difficult to satisfy. The objective of this article is to design and implement a high-speed data acquisition unit based on a field programmable gate array with the realization of the dual capture mode and the improvement of the data storage efficiency. Separate data and address control mechanisms are used in the method to store processed points and original data in on-chip resources. This method greatly reduces the resource occupancy rate and is suitable for high-speed digital acquisition modules. By the proposed design introduced in the article, experimental results show that the high-speed dual capture data storage speed could reach 1.6GSa/s with a 0% error rate.

articleTitle: Short-Time Traffic Flow Prediction Based on PCC-AT-CNNGRU
abstract: The prediction of traffic flow plays a key role in the planning, control and management of traffic system. This paper proposed a traffic flow prediction method including a road correlation analysis method based on Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) and a prediction model which is composed of convolutional neural network (CNN) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) based on attention mechanism (PCC-AT-CNNGRU). Firstly, PCC is applied to analyze the spatial correlation between roads and select the roads that is related to the predicted road to construct a spatial-temporal features matrix and input it to the model. Then, CNN can mine the spatial feature of traffic flow, GRU can process the temporal feature of traffic flow, and the obtained two features are fused. In order to enhance the prediction effect, this paper used the attention mechanism to focus on traffic flow with significant features in longtime series. Finally, experiments use the real traffic dataset to evaluating model performance. The experiment results show that PCC-AT-CNNGRU has more excellent prediction effect by comparing with the latest research models and variant models.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Output Synchronization of Heterogeneous Multi-agent System with Input Delays
abstract: The paper studies and solves the problem of distributed optimal output synchronization for HMASs with input delays. After adopting the idea of discreting and transforming the model, a continuous-time system with input delay is converted into a discrete-time system without delay of input. When studying the system’s optimization, the discounted performance function is defined, then the optimal control protocol of every follower is designed to achieve synchronization of all agents. A Q-learning method where dynamics of all agents do not need to be known is shown by using the online solution of ARE. Finally, several curves are shown to ensure that the theory of paper is correct.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Data Communication of Industrial Ethernet
abstract: The traditional Ethernet technology adopts the medium access mechanism of CSMA/CD. The communication mode is uncertain. The nodes realize data transmission through the competition bus. Real-time data and non-real-time data cannot be distinguished, which easily leads to real-time data not being sent for a long time. This paper proposes a comprehensive hierarchical scheduling queuing algorithm to improve the real-time performance of industrial Ethernet data transmission by analyzing the mechanism of Ethernet exchange price delay, combined with fixed priority mechanism and real-time deadline mechanism, and verified by opnet simulation.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Channel Feature Shrinkage Network for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
abstract: Recent years, human action recognition based on skeleton data from RGB-D sensors has achieved remarkable performance. However, the accuracy of action recognition is primarily affected by a large amount of noise introduced during the acquisition of human skeleton data and the subsequent feature extraction operation. In this work, we present a new type of Spatio-temporal channel feature shrinkage network (STCSN), which dynamically learns thresholds for practical feature shrinkage across channels and spatiotemporally for eliminating noise in features or irrelevant features. The proposed Spatio-temporal channel feature shrinkage network introduces only a small number of parameters, while delivering significant performance gains. By adding STCSN to a basic graph convolution network, we develop a robust STCSN-GCN graph convolution network that achieves substantial performance gains on the NW-UCLA and NTU RGB+D datasets.

articleTitle: Performance Attitude Tracking Control for Spacecraft during Target Damping by Electromagnetic Eddy Current
abstract: For the spacecraft attitude system with external disturbance and system uncertainty in the task of non-cooperative target damping by electromagnetic eddy current, combining with the prescribed performance control theory, an adaptive sliding mode controller based on disturbance observer is designed in this paper. And this controller is designed to ensure the expected dynamic and steady-state responses of spacecraft attitude tracking control. A new finite time convergence performance function is designed, which doesn’t need the exact initial error value. Aiming at the problem of control singularity caused by the increase of disturbance during steady-state of the new system after error transformation, we design an adaptive sliding mode controller based on disturbance observer, in which the observation gain matrix is related to the performance function. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed control law is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A task recognition algorithm based on CNN-LSTM for The Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology and the increasingly perfect Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network(STIN) architecture, the types of transmission tasks are increasing, and the network performance requirements are vastly different. This requires the STIN to quickly identify different mission types and further provide corresponding service standards. However, the direct transfer of traditional service recognition methods to task recognition ignores the exceptional transmission environment of the STIN, resulting in low recognition efficiency and high computational overhead. This paper introduces the environmental feature items as an auxiliary based on the convolutional recurrent neural network. It combines the service type and quantity to design a multi-layer CNN-LSTM task recognition algorithm. The simulation results show that the task recognition algorithm that introduces environmental feature items has a better accuracy rate. The precision and recall rates are further improved compared to the traditional recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: Prospect Value Function Construction for Pattern Recognition Algorithm’s Accuracy Metric
abstract: Accuracy metric of pattern recognition algorithm has a small amount of randomness because of train/test data selection and their sample sizes limitation. We proposed a prospect value function constructing method for pattern recognition algorithm by translating its accuracy to prospect value in order to avoid the potential random of accuracy. The normalized prospect value could also be used for further multi-attribute decision making. We analyzed some important steps in constructing the prospect value function of a pattern recognition algorithm, such as reference point selection, value function development, decision weight calculation and so on. The numerical application shows that the prospect value function constructed in this paper has a diminishing marginal. Further discussions conform that our method is fit for most pattern recognition algorithms’ accuracy domain and insensitive to test data sample size variation, i.e., the pattern recognition algorithms’ accuracy improvement can be measured quantitatively by its prospect value function.

articleTitle: Static voltage stability analysis of power grid with new energy sources considering DSSC
abstract: With the development of power electronic devices, the research of Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) in regulating line power flow and improving static voltage stability is more in-depth. This paper discusses the static voltage stability of power grid with new energy taking into account the distributed static series compensator (DSSC), and evaluates the power flow control efficiency of DSSC from the aspect of system static voltage stability. First, the equivalent circuit and working principle of DSSC are analyzed, and the power flow equations are obtained based on the equivalent power injection model of DSSC; Secondly, based on the power flow calculation equation, the efficiency evaluation index that can reflect the static voltage stability of the system is proposed, and the impact of new energy with different capacities on the static voltage stability is calculated and analyzed; Finally, the proposed method is verified by the simulation analysis of IEEE-24 bus system and actual power grid: the proposed method is fast and simple, and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Equilibrium Optimizer Algorithm Based On Survival Score Strategy
abstract: This paper proposes a new multi-objective equilibrium optimizer algorithm(MONEO) for complex multi-objective optimization problems(MOP). A fast non-dominated sorting strategy is merged with MONEO to maintain population diversity and prevent premature convergence. Applying survival score strategy can objectively reflect the true degree of crowding between individuals at the same level. To avoid from falling into local optimum, the equilibrium state pool and generation probability are improved: adding the disturbance individual allows the population to search in other directions during the update process, and introducing a non-linear convergence curve to the generation probability can better balance the relationship between algorithm search and exploration. The experimental results confirm that MONEO has better convergence and diversity compared to other five algorithms.

articleTitle: Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration Based on Local Phase Congruency and Keypoint Filtering
abstract: Robust registration is able to register the complementary information captured by multimodal images. Owning to the nonlinear intensity differences and repeating patterns in multimodal images, many classic descriptors are unable to achieve good performance. Aiming at this problem, a remote sensing image registration method based on key point description and filtering is proposed. First, this work utilizes a new keypoint descriptor with Log-Gabor filters to characterize the oriented phase congruency information in multimodal images. Then, a keypoint filtering is performed on all descriptors by mean-shift clustering to remove the repeating patterns. This approach is evaluated on three commonly used data sets, which are used for structure map construction and image registration comparisons. The experimental results show that the proposed method is able to preserve highly similar structure features and remove most repeating keypoints in multimodal images, which indicates this method is efficient and can achieve good registration performance.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of a Flexible Hand Rehabilitation Robot
abstract: A flexible and wearable hand rehabilitation robot is designed to address the problems of poor flexibility of the traditional hand exoskeleton robot and the heavy hand load. The robot consists of a drive system, a delivery system and a glove system. The finger bending angle and force analysis show that the bending and stretching length ratio of the finger cable is 1:1.409, the tangential force of the finger for object grasping is 0.44-0.69 times of the flexion and extension force, and the normal force range is 0.61-0.94 times of the tension force to provide assistance for the wearer's finger bending activities. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the design of finger rehabilitation exoskeleton robots.

articleTitle: Classification and Prediction Method of 3D Material Surface of Blast Furnace
abstract: Due to the lack of blast furnace data, unknown mechanism and inaccurate model, it is a typical black box system, and the blast furnace operator has long relied on experience to operate the fabric and then control the gas flow distribution, which makes the furnace condition usually in a reasonable-deteriorating-reasonable iterative state. It is difficult to realize the optimization of blast furnace operation. In this paper, in order to solve the above problems, we propose a method for classifying and judging blast furnace 3D material surface based on deep learning 3D point cloud algorithm DGCNN, which classifies blast furnace material surface into four categories based on the data collected by phased array radar used at the blast furnace site, and uses deep learning neural network to learn so that it can accurately determine whether the 3D material surface is abnormal and analyze the abnormal areas and causes, and uses a variety of methods for blast furnace 3D material surface This paper proposes a new data enhancement method to meet the actual situation in the field by using various data enhancement methods for blast furnace three-dimensional material surface to improve the accuracy. This paper proposes a method for classifying and determining whether the material surface is abnormal or not using deep learning neural network, which has the advantage of fast and accurate.

articleTitle: Deep Feature Filtering and Contextual Information Gathering Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection
abstract: Along with the update of depth sensors, salient object detection (SOD) models are evolving in dividend and are being increasingly investigated. Due to the essential difference between depth and RGB images, existing SOD models mostly focus on finding a reasonable way to facilitate multimodal (i.e., RGB and depth) features fusion while ignoring the interference of low-resolution depth maps on the inference stage. To this end, we first propose a Deep Feature Filtering and Contextual Information Gathering Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection (DCNet). First, a filter based on an attention mechanism is used to select important information in the depth features, which can adequately filter the low-quality depth maps. Moreover, before integrating multi-level feature complementarity, we incorporate a pre-processing step, the contextual information gathering module, which consists of separable (Sep) convolution, dilated (Dil) convolution, adaptive averaging pooling (AVP), and residual networks, to capture information diversity from a global perspective. We conclude by proposing a new mixed loss function based on binary cross-entropy loss (BCE) and intersection over union loss (IOU) for supervised network optimization. With four evaluation metrics on five public datasets, DCNet outperformed ten start-of-the-art methods in terms of simplicity and efficiency.

articleTitle: Row Current Compensation for Optimizing the Output Performance of Photovoltaic Array
abstract: This paper presents a row current compensation method to enhance the output performance of total cross-tied (TCT) photovoltaic (PV) arrays. This method can improve the output performance of TCT PV arrays under partial shading conditions (PSCs) and make full use of the power generated by PV arrays. The system mainly consists of batteries, DC-DC converter, PV array, maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller. The DC-DC converter controls the output current of battery to compensate the PV array while MPPT tracks the maximum power point (MPP) to ensure maximum output of PV array. In this paper, the effectiveness of the method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization based Trajectory Propagation for RLV Approach and Landing Phase
abstract: The trajectory propagation is used to estimate the flight states of the RLV when landing with a designed trajectory, so as to verify that whether the trajectory is suitable or not. Most of existing results are developed based on Euler numerical integration technique, and due to the implementation of the method, the efficiency of propagation may be low if a small integration step is used for high accuracy. To handle such issue, the paper propose a particle swarm optimization (PSO) based trajectory propagation method. With the proposed method, the efficiency of propagation can be significantly improved without losing accuracy. Simulations are done to show the advantages of our method.

articleTitle: DDoS Attack Detection for Cloud Control System Based on BiLSTM Algorithm
abstract: The huge advantages of cloud computing technology and the bottlenecks in the development of traditional network control systems have prompted the birth of cloud control systems to address the shortcomings of traditional network control systems in terms of bandwidth and performance. However, the information security issues faced by cloud control systems are more complex, and distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks are a typical class of attacks that may lead to problems such as latency in cloud control systems and seriously affect the performance of cloud control systems. In this paper, we build a single-capacity water tank cloud control semi-physical simulation system with heterogeneous controllers and propose a DDoS attack detection method for cloud control systems based on bidirectional long short-term memory neural network (BiLSTM), study the impact of DDoS attacks on cloud control systems. The experimental results show that the BiLSTM algorithm can effectively detect the DDoS attack on the cloud control system.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: Research on Pedestrian Inertial Navigation Assisted by Geomagnetic Matching Positioning
abstract: Pedestrian Inertial Navigation System is of great significance in the fields of smart city services, emergency assistance, home health supervision, etc. However, the wearable Micro Inertial Measurement Unit (MIMU) contains relatively high noise and the error of MIMU accumulates with time. This paper proposes a method of pedestrian inertial navigation assisted by geomagnetic matching positioning. According to the measurement of pedestrian inertial navigation based on zero velocity update (PINS-ZUPT) and the geomagnetic matching positioning, the system model of the PINS-ZUPT/Geomagnetic matching navigation with the Kalman Filtering (KF) working in the zero-velocity interval is established in this paper. The positioning errors and velocity errors are gained from the Iterative Closet Contour Point (ICCP) algorithm of the geomagnetic matching positioning and the zero-velocity information respectively, which can be used as the observation values of KF to obtain the optimal pedestrian trajectory and correct accumulated errors. The experiment shows that the average positioning error of integrated navigation is within 1m under the mileage of 140m, reduced by more than 50% relative to PINS-ZUPT, which verifies the effectiveness of the integrated navigation.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Adaptive Backstepping Dynamic Surface Control for Strict-feedback Fractional-Order Nonlinear Systems*
abstract: This paper addresses an event-triggered adaptive dynamic surface control (DSC) problem for a class of strictfeedback uncertain fractional-order nonlinear systems (FONS) with external disturbances. An adaptive backstepping DSC approach combined with a serial-parallel estimation (SPE) model is introduced by designing a compensation signal. Specifically, the predicted errors of the system states and the estimated states are utilized for the control and adaptive laws design. A novel eventtriggered scheme with relative-threshold is introduced to reduce the triggering number. It is shown that with the proposed scheme, the semiglobally uniformly ultimate stability of the uncertain FONS is guaranteed, and all the signals of the closed-loop system are bounded. An example for Chua-Hartley’s system are shown to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Attitude Estimation Algorithm Applied to Wave Compensation System
abstract: Access to the accurate attitude of the platform is one of the most essential component in wave compensation system based on the Stewart platform. However, serious magnetic interference to magnetometer is produced by the steel material of the platform, which render the drift of the yaw unable to be improved. To address the issue, an attitude estimation algorithm applied to the wave compensation system is proposed. Firstly, the magnetic interference correction is performed on the data output from the magnetometer for the environment with the influence of steel material, and then the complementary filter fusing accelerometer, magnetometer and gyroscope is used to perform attitude estimation for the wave compensation system. The experiments show that the method can effectively suppress the drift generated in the attitude estimation process and improve the accuracy of attitude estimation while controlling the production cost.

articleTitle: Semantic Intervention GAN for Generalized Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: In generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL), the method of transforming the zero-shot learning problem into a traditional classification problem is mostly handled by generating invisible data with the generative adversarial network (GAN). Currently, the data generated by the GAN has less differentiation between categories and the similarity within categories. In this paper, we modify CoGAN and optimize the loss function accordingly, and propose a semantically differentiated GAN structure, so that GAN has more inter-class differences and intra-class similarities when generating data, we call it S-CoGAN. We perform validation on MNIST and KDD99 datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed network structure.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning and Tracking Control for the Pendubot
abstract: In this paper, we study the trajectory planning and tracking control for the Pendubot, which is a two-link robot has a single actuator at the base joint of the first link. We realize a fast swing-down control under the sinusoidal-derivative (SD) controller which introduces a damper and spring, and obtain a desired trajectory of the state and the control input by using the swing-down controller and the time-reversal method. To track such a trajectory, we derive the linearized time-varying model of the Pendubot around the trajectory, and design a linear state feedback control along with a feedforward term determined by the trajectory of the control input. We study several obtained trajectories and focus on two issues: 1) the linear controllability of the corresponding linearized time-varying model for each trajectory; 2) the sufficient condition in the literature for checking the stability of the tracking control of the linearized time-varying model. Through our numerical investigation, we find that we have to choose appropriate control gains of the SD controller to guarantee the linear controllability, and that the sufficient condition is difficult to be satisfied.

articleTitle: A Memristor-Based System with Two Routes to Chaos
abstract: In this paper, a novel memristor with voltage control is proposed and analyzed. It is used to replace the diode in the traditional Chua’s circuit, and a memristor chaotic system with complex dynamics is obtained. The existence of chaos is proved by Lyapunov exponents, Poincaré sections and power spectrums. Through complex theoretical analysis, the system pass into the chaotic state via two paths: alternating period-doubling bifurcations and boundary crisis. Furthermore, the system has the invariance of chaos. The simulation circuit of memristive system is devised by using Multisim software, and the theoretical analysis results of the system are verified.

articleTitle: Fully Distributed Consensus of Multi-agent Systems with Fuzzy Communication Topology
abstract: This paper investigates a fully distributed consensus problem of multi-agent systems (MASs) with fuzzy topology. T-S fuzzy models are utilized to represent the uncertain communication topology among the agents. An edge-based adaptive protocol using only local information is applied, then a parallel distribution compensation controller based on the adaptive protocol is put forward to resolve the consensus problem in a fully distributed fashion. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, a sufficient condition that ensure the consensus of the closed-loop MASs is presented. Finally, a simulated example is supplied to demonstrate the viability of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Moment-Estimation-Based Control Algorithms for Networked Control Systems under DoS Attacks
abstract: This paper proposes a novel adaptive-moment-estimation-based model-free adaptive control (AMEBMFAC) algorithm, which is applicable for the networked control systems (NCS) where denial-of-service (DoS) attacks are under consideration. Compared with basic-gradient-descent-method-based MFAC, this algorithm has better tracking performance and faster convergent speed. With the consideration of DoS attacks, a compensation scheme is given where an observer of output is designed for the randomly occurred attacks. The proposed algorithm is proved to be BIBO stable and effective by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Research on short-term power load forecasting based on Elman neural network with Genetic Algorithm
abstract: The electric power industry is closely related to the development of national economy. With the development of economy, the social electricity situation is increasingly complicated, which brings great test to the prediction of electric load system. Accurate short-term power load forecasting plays an important role in production scheduling and safe and stable operation of power system. In this paper, Elman neural network based on genetic algorithm is established and a short-term power load forecasting model is established. The actual history data of municipal power grid are simulated, the experimental results show that compared with the BP neural network and Elman neural network commonly, Elman neural network based on genetic algorithm to solve the problem of random initial weights of the Elman neural network, can effectively enhance the power load forecasting accuracy and meet the needs of the actual production and work.

articleTitle: Predictive Current Method for Expected Sector Based on Coordinate Compression
abstract: The direct arctangent method is used by the expected sector prediction current control to calculate the expected voltage vector angle. With the disadvantages that the particular angle cannot be solved and there are multiple positive and negative infinite jumps in the calculation process, a predictive current method based on coordinate compression of the expected sector is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the expected voltage vector is calculated by the Clark transformation. Then the range of the expected voltage vector angle is divided by the two-phase stationary coordinate system, and the angles located in different quadrants are transformed and compressed in equal proportion. Finally, the sector where the expected voltage vector is located is obtained by the arctangent method based on coordinate compression, and the basic voltage vector contained in this sector is used as the optimal voltage vector to regulate the inverter in conjunction with the zero voltage vector. Simulation and experimental results show that the method is able to maintain good control performance and calculate the expected voltage vector angle accurately, thus enabling more accurate selection of the expected sector.

articleTitle: Integrated Capacity Analysis Model and Optimization Based on Conflict Resolution for High-Speed Railway
abstract: With the increased demand of passengers, the capacity analysis of high-speed railways has attracted much attention for serving more passengers with limited line resources. Existing methods mainly focused on the capacity analysis of rail sections or stations, separately. Our study first addressed the integrated capacity analysis of high-speed railways. We established an integrated capacity analysis model by combining the signal control of track sections, the overtaking of trains and the capacity of rail stations. Then this paper proposed a conflict resolution strategy based on multi-objective optimization. A real-world case study on the Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway demonstrated that our approach can better model the influencing factors in high-speed railways and can further improve the line capacity compared with existing approaches.

articleTitle: Intelligent control of hydrometallurgy leaching process based on RBF neural network
abstract: Hydrometallurgy is an important part of nonferrous metal production. The leaching is an important process of chemical dissolution reaction between leaching agent and specific components in solid materials. The leaching rate is a key output control variable in leaching process. The leaching rate is a nonlinear function of sodium cyanide and dissolved oxygen. There are some assumptions and simplifications in the establishment of mechanism model of leaching process, which mainly includes gold conservation equations, cyanide ion conservation equations and kinetic reaction velocity equations. The mismatching of mechanism model parameters may cause prediction error. The existing control algorithms based on model are difficult to achieve accurate control and have great application limitations. The intelligent control algorithm based on radial basis function (RBF) neural network will be ultilized to control the nonlinear leaching process due to the less limitation. The consistent stability and merit of the presented adaptive control algorithm are also analyzed and verified via practical test. The proposed intelligent control algorithm has good promotion performance, and can be easily extended to other industrial systems, hoping to obtain satisfactory control effect.

articleTitle: Iterative Weighted Least Squares Accelerometer Calibration Based on Kalman Smoothing
abstract: In the process of production and use of accelerometers, there are deterministic errors caused by nonorthogonal installation and zero offset. This paper proposes 'to use Kalman smoothing to calibrate the accelerometer. Before applying the iterative weighted least squares(WLS) method, Kalman smoothing is used to process and calibrate the collected data, and the weighted value is obtained by smoothing, and then the iterative least squares method is processed to obtain better calibration parameters. Through data experiments, the calibration method proposed in this paper can better calibrate the accelerometer output data, improve the calibration results, improve the data accuracy, and provide technical support for expanding the use of the accelerometer.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID control for suppressing stick-slip vibration of drill-string system
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) controller is introduced to suppress the stick-slip vibration present in the drilling process. First, the dynamical model of stick-slip vibration is composed of the multi-DOF (Degree-Of-Freedom) drill-string model and the Karnopp model describing the interaction of the drill bit with the rock. Then, stability analysis is made for the initial PID parameters of our controller. To suppress the stick-slip vibration and at the same time mitigate the effects of the stratigraphic environment variation on the control performance, the fuzzy adaptive algorithm is chosen as the method of optimization controller parameters. From the experimental results, it is clear that our controller has good control performance in the complex and changing stratigraphic environment.

articleTitle: System Dynamics-Based Analysis on Factors Influencing Comprehensive Competence of Primary and Secondary School Students
abstract: With rapid progress of artificial intelligence (AI) , it is urgent to promote educational reform to improve comprehensive competence level of primary and secondary school students (CCLPSSS). However, educational reform is a system engineering involving multiple and intertwined factors. In this research, a system dynamics-based model of education reform is developed. Then, based on this model, a series of simulation experiments are carried out to find main factors affecting improvement of CCLPSSS. Results show that: 1) this model could simulate trends of CCLPSSS under different educational reform measures; 2) Measures including teaching mode reform, development and application of AI-based new teaching method, implementation of Double Reduction in compulsory education, implementation of deepening education evaluation reform policy, and development and application of AI-based education evaluation technology could play significant roles in promoting CCLPSSS and further strengthening cultivation of AI compound talents.

Author Keywords: comprehensive competence of primary and secondary school students

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation of Ground- Based Cloud Image Based on Fully Convolutional Network
abstract: The production, dissipation, and variation of cloud play important roles in the weather forecast such as rain, snow and hail, which are typically reflected in changes in cloud types and cloud cover. It is critical to obtain the cloud cover of each type of cloud quickly and accurately in the constantly changing ground-based cloud images in order to capture and predict weather changes, and the prerequisite is to implement automatic ground-based cloud image segmentation technology classified by cloud type. To implement this technique, this paper introduces a full convolutional network structure in deep learning to implement a segmentation algorithm for ground- based cloud images at the semantic level. We first create the ground-based cloud image database for semantic segmentation (GBCSS). This database includes ten categories of cloud and one category of background for a total of eleven categories, with pixel-level labels for each image. Then, using convolutional neural network structures, we design five full convolutional networks and evaluate the semantic segmentation effects on GBCSS. The experimental results show that all five full convolutional networks have good segmentation accuracy of on GBCSS, with the highest accuracy reaching 75.7%, laying the foundation for the application of semantic segmentation in ground-based cloud image.

articleTitle: A Novel Iterative Adaptive Critic Design for Smart Home Energy Systems With Solar Energy
abstract: As a distributed energy storage system, smart home energy (SHE) system can be used to reduce the consumption cost of household users. Aiming at the optimal control SHE systems, a novel multi-iteration adaptive dynamic programming (MIADP) method is constructed. The present algorithm introduces three iterations, namely, exterior iteration, local iteration and interior iteration, to ensure that the iterative Q-function converges to the optimal, and thus the optimal energy storage control scheme of the SHE system with solar energy is obtained. Finally, the present MIADP algorithm is illustrated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Data-driven Online Modeling and Parameter Estimation of Highway Traffic Flow
abstract: Traffic flow models are an important tool to describe highway traffic conditions. With the advent of the big data era, it is necessary to develop a data-driven model to identify the spatial-temporal characteristics of highway traffic flow from partially observed and noisy traffic data. For such a purpose, we propose a data-driven modeling method of highway traffic flow using Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) algorithms. To accurately describe highway traffic flow, a recursive method for updating model parameters is proposed. A small weight term for the historical data and a penalty term for the cost function are considered, which can be more accurate and suitable. Finally, extensive numerical simulations are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the recursive data-driven modeling method. The results show that the proposed recursive algorithm has high accuracy in reconstructing traffic states compared with classical DMD. It may also have the potential to predict the highway traffic flow in real time.

articleTitle: Research on layout algorithm of all steel attached wall climbing frame walkway boards based on Revit
abstract: In order to realize intelligent processing of drawings in building construction, improve the accuracy of drawings and provide more security for construction personnel, this paper proposes a layout algorithm of all steel attached wall climbing frame walkway boards, which can read and process the building contour data. Based on the building contour data, the layout drawing of building peripheral climbing frame walkway boards can be generated by one click in Revit and the walkway board data can be obtained Read and process the recognized building contour in the database, analyze the coordinate change and summarize the law by using the processed data, and obtain the walkway board contour map, walkway board partition map and walkway board data. The implementation of this algorithm greatly improves the work efficiency of technicians and lays the foundation for the layout of other parts. It has great application value in the field of computer- aided building construction design.

articleTitle: Study on Transient Modeling and Parameter Identification of Battery Energy Storage System
abstract: Battery energy storage technology plays an important role in suppressing power fluctuation, improving transient response characteristics of power system and supporting safe and stable operation of power system. In this paper, based on power system simulation software, a battery energy storage system model for electromechanical transient simulation of power system was established for the safety and stability analysis of power system, and the parameter identification function of energy storage control system was realized. In this paper, simulation analysis and functional test are carried out based on typical examples to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the above methods.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Integrated Hybrid Microgrids with Stable Voltage Supply under Islanded and Grid- connected Modes
abstract: Wind turbine, as one of the common renewable energy generations, is an important distributed generation type for microgrids. However, it often presents large inertia and is difficult to be stably controlled in microgrid systems. Currently, on one hand, regarding renewable energy generation, it is still rare to see the configuration of only wind turbine integrated ac/dc hybrid microgrids. On the other hand, the voltage supply quality is also less concerned in the above-mentioned microgrids. Therefore, to fill these gaps, this paper builds and studies an ac/dc hybrid microgrid integrated with wind turbines. Besides, the energy storage devices are coordinated to facilitate stable and steady ac/dc voltage supplies, where the output voltage of the wind turbine is strongly addressed. The microgrid can operate in both islanded and grid-connected modes, ensuring a smooth voltage connection to the main grid. Comprehensive case researches have been undertaken to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the microgrid system and its control strategy.

articleTitle: Cooperative Output Regulation of Heterogeneous Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Based on T-S Fuzzy Models
abstract: This paper studies the problem of cooperative output regulation of heterogeneous nonlinear multi-agent systems. Firstly, the T-S fuzzy model is used to describe the heterogeneous nonlinear multi-agent systems. Then, a distributed fuzzy observer is designed to get estimation of the states of the followers and the leader. An adaptive distributed controller is proposed based on the observer. It can be proved that the systems can achieve cooperative output regulation under the designed controller by using regulator equations. Finally, the analytic results are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Lunar ascent control using explicit guidance and slidng mode techniques
abstract: Ascent guidance and control techniques are vital for the lunar lander and the upcoming extensive lunar explorations. To improve the efficiency and robustness of the ascent controller, an explicit guidance and integral sliding model approach are synthesized in this paper. In the design of the guidance law, model simplification is adopted and analytic solutions replace the traditional iteration process. The efficiency is improved without loss of orbit insertion accuracy. For the controller design, by setting the initial value of the integral function and designing of the reaching law, the response speed is accelerated and finite-time stability is guaranteed. Simulations are conducted and performances are verified in the presence of parameter uncertainties.

articleTitle: Satellite-Ground Pointing Properties of Constellation with Regressive Common Ground Track
abstract: Satellite constellations have important applications in communication, navigation, remote sensing, scientific experiments and other fields. This paper presents a new analysis for satellite-ground pointing properties of constellation with regressive common ground track. This analysis employs the fusion of regressive orbit and common ground track. In this paper, the satellite-ground pointing properties of constellation with regressive common ground track is investigated using "access and link" simulation. First, build data links between satellites and ground stations. Second, according to the dynamics of satellite motion and Earth rotation, combined with communication constraints such as elevation Angle, the access analysis of satellite and ground station is constructed. Third, on the basis of access analysis, link planning is carried out. The period property, access time property and pointing path planning property are weighed based on a set of simulation cases. The analysis of the characteristics of constellation with regressive common ground track provides important reference for engineering application.

articleTitle: Co-Loss Function for Rodents Sleep Stage Scoring Based on Single-Channel EEG
abstract: Sleep stage scoring of rodents is important to study the pathological significance of altered sleep. In tradition, sleep experts classify electroencephalogram (EEG) signals into three cardinal sleep stages: Wake, NREM, and REM, which is laborious. Some existing automatic staging methods are over-reliance on domain knowledge and manual labels during extracting features. To solve these problems, we propose a new loss function named Co-Loss to train a contrastive learning model based on single-channel EEG end-to-end. We evaluate Co-Loss in a public rodent sleep dataset from three independent sleep labs. The accuracy is achieved as 88.85%, improving 0.9% compared with Cross-Entropy. This demonstrates, that without changing the model architecture, our loss function can learn features effectively from single-channel EEG with less labeled information and domain knowledge.

articleTitle: Application of Motion Planning in UAVs: A Review
abstract: Motion planning is an important decision-making part for robots to perform motion tasks, and it is indispensable for UAV to perform autonomous flight tasks. First, this article introduces the relevant theories of motion planning and a variety of current representative motion planning strategies. Then point out the problems of UAVs in motion planning tasks, and the application of motion planning in a series of UAVs decision and control problems is introduced. Finally, the development direction of motion planning in the field of UAVs is prospected to provide reference for future research.

articleTitle: Extraction of Main Causal Relationship Based on Transfer Entropy with Two-stage Filtering
abstract: Modern industrial processes are becoming more complex, creating greater challenges for industrial process control and industrial safety. At the same time, the application of a large number of sensors makes it possible to obtain detailed observation data. By analyzing the causal relationship between variables, the interaction between variables can be understood, which is of great value in risk assessment and root cause analysis. Transfer Entropy (TE) can detect causal relationships between variables without assuming a model, and has been widely used in many fields. However, TE is computationally expensive. In order to overcome this shortcoming and simplify the obtained causal relationship, a new workflow with two-stage filtering is proposed in this work. Before calculating TE, the first filtration is performed with mutual information to reduce the number of required calculations. After completing the hypothesis test, the difference between the TE true value and the hypothesis test maximum value is used to complete the simplification to get the main causal relationship. This effectively reduces the amount of computation while retaining the main causal relationship. The effectiveness of the method is verified by a chemical industrial process.

articleTitle: Research on Active Balance Strategy of Retired Lithium Batteries
abstract: In order to solve the obvious inconsistency problem of retired lithium batteries in electric vehicles, this paper designs an active equalization system circuit based on a bidirectional flyback equalization topology. Using unscented Kalman filter (UKF) to estimate the state of charge (SOC), the SOC-based, voltage-based, and SOC and voltage-based two-variable equalization strategies are designed, a system simulation model is built, and the three equalization strategies are compared and verified. The proposed balancing strategy meets the requirements of retired battery balancing control, and the SOC-based balancing strategy has the fastest balancing speed.

articleTitle: Calculation Method for Air Data Based on UKF with Information from INS and FADS
abstract: In this paper, the design and validation of an air data system algorithm for estimating the angle of attack and sideslip are presented. To reduce estimation error and improve system performance, the algorithm should deliver accurate output. The method uses a flush air data sensing system (FADS) model composed of aircraft surface air pressure and an inertial navigation system (INS) model within an unscented Kalman filter (UKF) framework. UKF uses inertial system measurements of Euler angles, body rates, body accelerations, and a measurement of dynamic pressure to form estimates. After simulations and comparison of results, this technique reduces errors in aircraft estimates of air data and improves survivability as well as reliability.

articleTitle: Parameter adaption for proxy-based sliding mode control
abstract: Proxy-based sliding mode control (PSMC) is a control algorithm that combines traditional sliding mode control and PID control. It improves safety in rigid position control while ensuring good tracking performance. In order to meet the requirements of the control system, however, its control parameters are often adjusted empirically. This paper proposes a parameter adaptation method for PSMC. The method achieves online adjustment of control parameters by an improved back-propagation neural network. Numerical simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Non-fragile H∞ Control of Manipulator Discrete Delay Systems Based on Observer
abstract: For a class of discrete systems with time delays and uncertainties, a non fragile controller based on a state observer is designed. First, the robot system model is introduced and discretized. Secondly, through the Lyapunov stability principle constructor, combined with the linear matrix inequality method, the sufficient conditions for the existence of non fragile controllers are obtained. The linear matrix inequality is solved and the gain parameter expressions of the controller and observer are obtained. Finally, through matlab simulation, the effectiveness and superiority of the non fragile controller for the manipulator system are verified.

articleTitle: Lead-Time Average Consensus of Multi-agent Systems
abstract: In this paper, the lead-time average consensus of multi-agent systems is investigated. The proposed strategy can make the multi-agent systems reach consensus before any prescribed time, which can be arbitrarily given according to actual needs. Meanwhile, compared with the prescribed-time consensus strategy, the proposed strategy has a faster convergence rate. In addition, this paper propose estimation algorithms for the actual stable time of multi-agent systems. In the end, some numerical examples are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: B-spline Decomposition based Iterative Learning Control and its Application in Load Simulator
abstract: Load simulator is a kind of hardware in the loop (HIL) simulation equipment, which is used to simulate the real load of the actuator in the laboratory environment. The main goal of the load simulator is to eliminate the surplus torque caused by the movement of the tested actuator and track the load spectrum accurately. When the load simulator tracks the high-frequency load signal, the feedback based control method has a serious lag, which can be avoided by using iterative learning control. However, iterative learning control is suitable for the case of constant reference trajectory and cannot deal with non-repetitive reference trajectory. B-spline decomposition based iterative learning control method is proposed. The reference load spectrum signal is decomposed into the basic spline signal, and the corresponding basic input is obtained by iterative learning control, the final control input is synthesized for tracking reference load spectrum. The simulation and experimental results show that compared with the traditional control method, this method can effectively improve the loading accuracy. The main contribution of this paper is to apply iterative learning control to non repetitive trajectory tracking.

articleTitle: A Hierarchial Approach to Panoptic CAD Drawing Parsing System Based on Point and Symbol Location
abstract: Computer-aided design (CAD) drawing parsing is a fundamental step to both drawing design expansion and digital management in industrial field. Existing methods can only parse some areas of the complete drawing. In this paper, we propose the task of panoptic CAD drawing parsing, which requires locating all area symbols, composition symbols and their relations in the complete drawing. This task is challenged by locating tiny symbols in high-resolution images and the pixel-wise locating the composition symbols. Therefore, we propose a hierarchical panoptic CAD drawing parsing system based on deep learning. Concretely, we use a hierarchical approach to firstly parse the drawing layout regions and then locate tiny area symbols based on symbol location. Meanwhile, for the composition symbols, we propose the Symbol-as-Points (SaPs) algorithm to obtain pixelwise location. 800 industrial drawings are precisely annotated to verify the effectiveness of our approach. Extensive experimental results prove the effectiveness of the framework.

articleTitle: Proportion-Integration-Differentiation based Aperiodic Model Predictive Control for Constrained Nonlinear Systems
abstract: In this paper, an event-triggered model predictive control (ET-MPC) strategy is proposed for the perturbed nonlinear system with state and input constraints. First, a novel strategy for event-triggering is proposed, which is based on the error of the proportion, integral, and differential (PID) of the difference between the nominal and the actual states. Then, the dual-mode control structure adopted by a novel PID based ET-MPC algorithm is developed. Besides, the recursive feasibility and resultant stability of the approach are demonstrated theoretically. Finally, numerical simulation and its comparisons are conducted to prove the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Split-and-Merge Based Simultaneous Input and State Filter for Nonlinear Dynamic Systems
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of simultaneous input and state estimation (SISE) for nonlinear dynamic systems. By the augmented state approach, we convert this problem into a standard filtering problem. Then, the split-and-merge technique is utilized for the augmented state estimation. Based on this, a novel split-and-merge based simultaneous input and state filter is developed in order to enhance the ability of dealing with highly nonlinear systems. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed filter.

articleTitle: A Target Allocation Algorithm Based on Matching Game for UAV Swarm
abstract: To design a balanced target allocation algorithm is essential for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarm. In this paper, a matching game-based target allocation algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the matching game theory is introduced. Secondly, considering the factors of time, distance and task assigned, benefit matrices are computed to establish the one-to- one match between targets and UAVs. Thirdly, a target allocation algorithm based on the matching model is proposed. Theoretical analysis verifies that the matching result of partners is stable, optimal and stable. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can balance the mission load and flight time of each UAV.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm of Double-layered Dynamic Matrix Predictive Control
abstract: This paper presents an improved algorithm of double-layered dynamic matrix predictive control (DDMC). Double layer means on the basis of dynamic control layer where it is using dynamic matrix predictive control for tracking, a steady-state target calculation (SSTC) layer is added to carry out steady-state target calculation for feasibility analysis and economic optimization. The improvement of the algorithm is mainly aimed at open-loop prediction and relaxation of constraints. The open-loop prediction is established based on the finite step response (FSR) model near the equilibrium point. In dynamic calculation, constraints are relaxed for the second time , then slack variables of constraints are added to the objective function after considering the results from SSTC. Finally, the improved algorithm was verified in an industrial model.

articleTitle: Multimode Model Predictive Control for Three-phase PWM Rectifier
abstract: In this paper, a multimode model predictive control(MMPC) strategy is proposed for PWM rectifiers. The control strategy automatically switches between single vector control, two vector control and three vector control, three modes according to the demand of PWM rectifier performance under different operating conditions. Thus, the conflicts between the wasted computing power, total harmonic distortion (THD) values and switching frequency caused by fixed control modes are effectively solved. First, a multimode control system framework is constructed in this paper. This framework uses two cost functions for vector selection and vector operation time calculation, respectively. THD values and DC side voltage value are used as the condition for mode switching. The simulation results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the losses caused by the switching frequency under the condition of ensuring the control accuracy.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Safe Arbitrator for Human-Machine Shared Control
abstract: Shared control has become a popular subject of human-machine hybrid intelligence. This paper presents a dynamic safety arbitrator for shared control in an automated vehicle. The vehicle is controlled autonomously by a model predictive controller (MPC) tracking a given trajectory, while at the same time human input is provided via a joystick. Unlike traditional mixed-initiative control methods that blend weighted human and vehicle inputs, the proposed arbitrator first adopts control barrier function (CBF) to generate weights for human and vehicle inputs under safety critical situations, and then employs the null-space based control (NSBC) to merge the two inputs with priorities determined by the weights. As a result, the final input to the vehicle has a clear physical meaning that represents dynamic priorities of human and vehicle autonomous inputs, in which the higher priority input is fully adopted and the lower priority input is partially adopted without intervening the higher priority input. An immediate advantage of the proposed arbitrator is that there is no need to tune the weights between human and autonomous inputs. Simulation results show that the dynamic safe arbitrator is effective for shared control.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive and differentiated control method of drive controller in Wentian and Mengtian experimental cabin of space station
abstract: Focused on the key single machine of the Alpha sun orientation subsystem in the power sub-system of the Wentian and Mengtian experimental cabin of the space station - the in-cabin and extra-vehicle drive controller which needed to autonomously complete the cabin segment (Wentian, Mengtian) and cabin space (inside and outside the cabin) identification and independently fulfill the needs of the differentiated control of flexible sailboards in the Wentian and Mengtian experimental cabins by receiving the commands of the space station digital management sub-system and the GNC sub-system according to the requirements of the space station’s energy assurance tasks, this paper proposed an in-cabin and extra-cabin drive controller autonomous identification and differentiated control method. At the same time, combined with the different working modes inside and outside the cabin, the drive controller executed the information collection and processing of other functional components in the Alpha sun orientation subsystem, and completed the closed-loop control and fault detection processing of the Alpha sun orientation device, and sent the different processing information to the GNC sub-system and digital tube sub-system. As a key single machine of the power supply subsystem which was a key sub-system of China’s space station, an important national project, the in-cabin and out-cabin drive controller was very important to ensure the energy security of the entire space station.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Voltage Control in Electrothermal Integrated Energy System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: To solve a voltage safety issue during operation in electrothermal integrated energy systems (ETIES), a multi-time scale voltage control (VC) method is presented in this paper. Firstly, based on the mathematical models of combined heat and power (CHP), photovoltaic (PV) and electric boilers (EB), the target function and various restraints of system voltage safety are established and transformed into a Markov decision process. Secondly, a voltage regulation scheme that prioritizes reactive power compensation over active power reduction is used to enhance the system new power absorption capacity, and a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based voltage regulation method for PV units and capacitor banks in multiple time scales is proposed. The optimal strategy of VC is obtained by agent training. Simulations are conducted to analyze in terms of reliability and efficiency of the scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-task Deep Learning Based Defect Detection For Lithium Battery Tabs
abstract: After the welding process of Lithium battery tabs, it is necessary to detect the surface defects of the welded products. The Gap is one of the common defects, and the defect forms are changeable, which brings a great challenge to the detection. This paper proposes a lithium battery tab gap defect technology based on multi-task deep learning model. The model takes U-Net as the architecture, ResNet as the encoder backbone network, and the decoding end connects up to three task-related networks, including defect area detection task network, defect contour detection task network, and defect binary classification network. The method is verified on the polar ear data set collected from the production line. The results of defect detection and product judgment show that the multi-task method has achieved good results, and the accuracy of product judgment can reach 98.8%. Compared with the single task method, it only needs 50% samples to obtain the same performance, which can effectively alleviate the problem of the insufficient number of on-site samples.

articleTitle: Software Application of Control and Compensation for EAST Articulated Maintenance Arm
abstract: EAMA (EAST Articulated Maintenance Arm) is an articulated serial robot work in an experimental advanced superconductor tokamak. A sort of challenges occurred for joint error and sensor data fusion in position control. The aim of this work indicates the error compensation software application principle. The open architecture, the layers, the communication models, the user interfaces and the real-time operate system with the supervision slave communication and data transmission are analyzed and integrated.

articleTitle: Nutation Mode Suppression of Magnetic Bearing Rotor System under Operating Point Deviation
abstract: The stable control of the magnetic levitation large inertia rotor system is the core of the development of the magnetically suspended control torque gyroscope (MSCMG). This paper introduces the influence of the active magnetic bearings (AMBs) rotor system operating point deviation on the nutation modal suppression of the system when the MSCMG outputs torque. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a cross-feedback control method of rotor nutation mode under the constraint of support stiffness perturbation. The influence of support stiffness on the AMBs-rotor system is studied by drawing a Bode diagram, and the design of the cross-feedback control is optimized to ensure the stability of AMBs-rotor system under the condition of operating point deviation.

articleTitle: Online calibration method of lidar positioning based on indoor AGV
abstract: In the AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) system, the accuracy of the positioning system often ultimately determines the accuracy of the AGV navigation process and results. Due to the influence of factors such as uneven ground and inertia, the mechanical structure of the lidar will shake during the navigation process, which affects the positioning effect of the forklift. To this end, we adopted an online lidar calibration method, based on the mature EKF (Extended Kalman Filter) algorithm, to estimate the pose and lidar calibration parameters of the AGV in real time. The simulation results show that the method can better estimate the calibration parameters of lidar.

articleTitle: A LAB color space style transfer method base on luminance grouping for semantic segmentation
abstract: Recently, semantic segmentation has made great progress, which is a basic task in computer vision and assigns the class label for each pixel in a image. Since pixel-level annotation of datasets for semantic segmentation is always a costly task, using the processor-generated virtual image data is an important method to solve this problem. But there are inevitable differences between the synthetic data domain and the reality domain. We propose the following ways to solve the appeal problem. Firstly, a LAB color space style transfer method based on luminance grouping is proposed to reduce the differences between the two domains. Secondly, we found that the Fourier transform spectrum transfer method reduces the difference between the source and target distributions by switching the low-frequency distributions of the source and target domains.

articleTitle: Active Vibration Control for Flexible High-Rise Building System based on PDE Model
abstract: In this paper, an active boundary vibration control strategy is proposed for single-floor flexible high-rise building system with Active Mass Damper (AMD). Firstly, the system dynamics of the single-floor flexible building equation is described by distributed parameter model consisting of partial differential equation (PDE) and ordinary differential equation (ODE). Secondly, an active boundary controller is designed to suppress the vibration of the flexible building structure, the asymptotic stability of the system is proved by using LaSalle’s Invariance Principle. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: A Kriging-Assisted Evolutionary Algorithm with Two-Stage Environmental Selection Strategy for Expensive Multimodal Multi-Objective Optimization
abstract: Plenty of evolutionary algorithms have been developed for solving multimodal multi-objective optimization problems. However, most existing multimodal multi-objective evolutionary algorithms cannot meet expectations in complex and time-consuming situations due to a limited number of real fitness evaluations are been implemented. Therefore, a Kriging-assisted evolutionary algorithm with two-stage environmental selection strategy is developed for expensive multimodal multi-objective optimization. With the help of Kriging model, the future evolutionary information of the population is explored through simulated evolution at each generation. In addition, a two-stage environmental selection strategy is employed to generate offspring population. In the environmental selection, an improved dual clustering method is used to choose promising solutions from the historical data of simulated evolution in two stages. The experimental results demonstrate that performance of proposed algorithm is more superior than its competing algorithms on ten benchmark problems.

articleTitle: Subspace Identification of a MIMO Wafer Rapid Thermal Processing System
abstract: This paper studies the subspace identification of a MIMO wafer rapid thermal processing (RTP) system driven by standard tungsten halogen lamps and output temperatures for the RTP system are measured by pyrometers. In order to estimate a linearized dynamic model for the nonlinear RTP system at an environmental temperature, input voltages for the lamps are selected as mutually independent pseudo-random binary series (PRBS). To design such PRBS to persistently excite the system, several pre-experiments for determining its settling time and maximum frequency are needed to be designed beforehand. Finally, the effectiveness of the identification method is verified by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: An Improved Model-Free Adaptive Iterative Learning Control Method
abstract: An improved model-free adaptive iterative learning control (IMFAILC) method is proposed for repeating unknown systems using dynamic linearization (DL) through the iteration direction. Based on MFAILC, a time-varying proportional control item is added. Compared with the original MFAILC method, IMFAILC is more general and has better control effect. The convergence and stability of IMFAILC scheme are proved strictly, and the effectiveness of the IMFAILC scheme is confirmed by simulation.

articleTitle: Control design under attacks of multi-agent switched systems via arbitrary switching
abstract: In this paper, the consensus control against attacks for a type of nonlinear multi-agent switched systems under arbitrary switching is studied. The attacks corrupt the information data, which cannot be used for the feedback design. Meanwhile, the switching logic is not allowed to be designed. To tackle the complicated effects, some intermediate variables and adaptive laws are introduced to compensate the uncertainties. By constructing a common Lyapunov function, an adaptive protocol is proposed such that the outputs of the agents achieve consensus against attacks under arbitrary switching.

articleTitle: Multi-robot collaborative SLAM Based on optimized ORB
abstract: A multi-robot vision collaborative SLAM system based on the updated ORB algorithm was provided to respond to the needs of large error and poor sensitivity in the multi-robot vision collaborative SLAM system. Firstly, histogram equalization is carried out on the collected image, which improves the overall contrast of the image. Shi-Tomasi corner detection algorithm is used to supplement the loss of feature points during camera rotation. Second, Lucas-Kanade (LK) sparse optical flow is employed to enhance the ORB algorithm’s feature matching process. Finally, the improved ORB algorithm is applied to the CCMSLAM multi-robot cooperative system. The experimental findings demonstrate that after using the revised method, the system has enhanced accuracy and resilience.

articleTitle: Formalizing a Continuous Function in Topological Spaces Using Coq
abstract: We present a formalization work in Coq about the continuous functions of topological spaces. The continuity of functions for topological spaces plays an essential role in general topology, which was the origin of rapid developments in general topology. Our formalization work about the continuous functions is based on the system of the axioms of Morse-Kelley, and this axiom system can provide a solid foundation for mathematics. The concepts of continuous function are then introduced and their equivalent definitions are investigated. We transpose the definitions and properties of continuous functions into a formal description using the Coq theorem prover, which demonstrated the rigorous and reliable of formal mathematics. This work shows that the definition of continuous function in topological spaces can also be described by various basic topological concepts. And our formalization work lays a foundation for the formalization of the theory of point-set topology.

articleTitle: Short-Term Traffic Flow Prediction Based on I-SAWOA-Deep Echo State Network
abstract: In recent years, the phenomenon of road congestion has occurred in all cities around the world, and this situation has become more and more severe, which has affected the travel of residents and restricted the development of cities. Short term traffic flow prediction is one of the key technologies of Intelligent Transportation System. It can predict the traffic flow in the future for a period of time through historical data, and then provide key information for traffic management personnel to make decisions. Therefore, researchers in various fields pay attention to it, and gradually propose a variety of prediction methods.In this paper, the Deep Echo State Network is selected as the basic prediction method, and the Improved-Whale Optimization Algorithm is used to optimize the super parameters of the network, which solves the problem that it is difficult to reasonably set the super parameters of the network.
