In order to ensure safety and fast convergence, we use the framework that takes a traditional control method as a basic policy and takes offline RL to fine-tune the imperfect traditional controller. For the basic policy, we use the principle of minimum curvature to generate a reference trajectory and a non-linear feedback controller to track the trajectory. For the fine-tune item, we use a simple yet state-of-the-art offline RL algorithm called TD3+BC to add some adjustive to the base policy. For the simulation platform, we use Matlab Simulink combined with the Silverstone track data as the environment, and use Carsim to provide vehicle dynamic models. The simulation results show that the proposed control policy can effectively shorten the time for the car to complete the track.

articleTitle: Proportional Power Compensation for Regional Bus Voltage Regulation in ADN
abstract: In active distribution networks (ADN) with PV, the intermit PV generation results in voltage violation problem. Power compensation is a widely used method to ameliorate bus voltage profile while lacking a necessary regional coordination. This paper proposes a regional voltage regulation method based on proportional reactive power compensation of PV inverters first and then proportional active power compensation of battery energy storage system (BESS). This not only allows the violated voltage of these buses to be adjusted to acceptable range 0.95pu-1.05pu, but also makes the burden fairly shared among all involved PV inverters and BESSs. Finally, the simulation results of a sample ADN mode demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: ASR Method Based on Desired Frequency And Its Application in Non-periodic Signal Enhancement1
abstract: Many monitoring signals are non-periodic, such as infrasound signals generated by natural gas pipeline leaks. These signals are subject to very high interference, and the interference is distributed at all frequencies. This results in the inability to obtain leak signatures that can be used for leak detection. Traditional filtering methods suppress noise while losing the active components of the signal and fail to enhance the signal for specific frequencies. And they are also not available for real-time online detection. In this paper, an adaptive stochastic resonance (ASR) algorithm based on the desired frequency is proposed to weaken the noise while actively enhancing the weak leakage signals. In application to real signals, this paper provides an idea to find the desired resonant frequency of real signals. The test results of the field measured data show that the desired leakage characteristics are obtained, with a stable and significant signal enhancement effect. And the algorithm has fast response, high sensitivity, simple calculation, and can be used for real-time online detection.

articleTitle: Teacher-student Network As An Attention Module With Memory for Defect Localization
abstract: The goal of defect detection is to detect and locate defects on product surface. Since the complexity of defect types in actual industrial production and it is difficult to obtain a large number of samples for supervised training. Current defect detection methods are thought to be mainly unsupervised training methods. However, the current unsupervised methods all learn the normal sample feature representation from the whole and lack direct defect location information. In this paper, A teacherstudent network is used as the attention mechanism to provide the network with more direct information on the location of defects. At the same time, to increase the network’s ability to characterize normal samples, a memory module is used to enhance the reconstruction ability of the network. The experimental results show that our approach obtains the best results compared to similar teacher-student networks and attention mechanism networks.

articleTitle: Cotton Image Segmentation Network Based on Improved DeeplabV3+
abstract: Aiming at the observation of cotton flow conditions in cotton production lines, a cotton image segmentation algorithm with improved DeeplabV3+ network is proposed, which introduces the lightweight network MobileNetV2 as the backbone feature extraction network; replaces the standard convolution in the void space pyramid pooling module with the depth separable convolution to compress the model size, and introduces the channel attention module to capture the image contextual information to effectively improve the segmentation accuracy of the model. The proposed algorithm achieves 96.86% pixel accuracy and 92.14% intersection ratio on the test set, which is 0.70% and 0.22% better than the original version, and the model parameter size is 15.29 MB, which is 92.7% smaller than the previous one, and the prediction time of a single frame is 18.67 ms, which is 65.8% smaller than the previous one. The experimental results show that the algorithm balances the characteristics of accuracy and real-time, and the overall comprehensive performance is optimal.

articleTitle: Many-objective day-ahead optimal scheduling in hierarchical partition-managed active distribution networks
abstract: With the increasing number of objectives to be considered in the active distribution network (ADN), the traditional distribution network is difficult to cope with the challenge of many-objective optimal scheduling. This paper proposes a many-objective optimization model in terms of the economy, safety, and power quality of ADN, which is divided into three layers: distribution network layer, microgrid layer, and user layer. An improved multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on decomposition (IMOEA/D) is proposed to solve the resulting multi-objective optimization problems. In the algorithm, the two-layer weight vector generation method is used to reduce the large-scale population size of many-objective problems first. Then, using an adaptive neighborhood update strategy, the size of the population neighborhood is dynamically updated to balance population diversity and convergence. Furthermore, a new method is adopted to reduce the waste of computing resources in the population. Finally, the experiment is carried out on the 33-node system to verify the feasibility of the model and the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting of power system based on attention mechanism CNN-BiLSTM
abstract: With the continuous development of power system, power system load Load forecasting comes into play increasingly important role. Compared with traditional prediction methods, machine learning shows better performance in dealing with the temporal and nonlinear characteristics of load, but the traditional LSTM cannot make past data and future data more closely linked. To solve this problem, In this paper, a hybrid model short-term load prediction method based on a combination of CNN, BiLSTM and attention mechanism to reduce memory loss and improve prediction accuracy. Finally, taking the load data in a certain area of Australia as an example, the method is compared with other commonly used models. It can be found from the experimental results that this method has high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Knowledge graph-based approach to wiring design and critical line identification
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency of connecting electrical elements and difficulty of modeling in the process of building wiring model, this paper design an interactive method of proposed wiring model , which adopts parametric description of anchor points of elements to realize dynamic matching and connection between elements; ontology modeling and knowledge map construction are carried out for multi-source and heterogeneous knowledge in the field of wiring model design; Based on the above preparation, we propose key line identification method on the knowledge map, It can effectively identify the shutdown key line in the wiring diagram . In the last part of the paper, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the method is verified by Comparing with existing methods.

articleTitle: Control Force Distribution Algorithm Based on MEMS Micro-Thruster Array
abstract: A control force allocation algorithm suitable for MEMS micro-thruster array is proposed. Firstly, according to the characteristics of MEMS micro-thruster array, the thrust model is established. Secondly, a tabular matrix generation method is proposed. Finally, a control force allocation algorithm based on look-up table matrix is designed for attitude-orbit coupling control. The tracking control of the flying asteroid is taken as the simulation background, and the adaptive terminal sliding mode control is taken as the control rate. The simulation example shows the effectiveness of the control force allocation algorithm. The results show that the allocation algorithm can well realize the force and torque calculated by the control rate, and the attitude and orbit can converge quickly.

articleTitle: Four-channel virtual oscilloscope based on Labview
abstract: In this paper, a Labview-based four-channel virtual oscilloscope is designed for the use of Ultrasonic logging instrument for shaft sinking by drilling (ULISSD). Firstly, the usage environment is analyzed and explained. Secondly, the functions and software design of the designed four-channel virtual oscilloscope by using the analog to digital conversion acquisition card are introduced and discussed from the research method. Finally, the designed four-channel virtual oscilloscope is tested by a certain environment. Combined with the use of experiments with ULISSD, it is proved that the virtual instrument can realize the detection of four-channel data, which can solve the problems encountered in the use of ultrasonic transducer at the present stage and lay the foundation for the upgrade of the next generation ULISSD.

Author Keywords: Ultrasonic logging instrument for shaft sinking by drilling

articleTitle: Research on 3D free bending pipe bender based on HNC-8 CNC system
abstract: According to the principle of 3D free bending technology, combined with the rule of pipe forming and the control requirements of pipe bender, the bending mechanism were optimized, and the hardware selection and the parameter setting were carried out by using HNC-8 CNC system to complete the development of 3D free bending pipe bender. It is proved by experiment that it can meet the requirements of control precision of pipe bender and the quality of pipe forming.

articleTitle: Accelerating High-resolution Image Stitching for the Dual Camera System based on GPU
abstract: Image stitching plays an important role in the field of computer vision and image processing. Although some sophisticated stitching methods have been proposed, they are usually time-consuming. Because many application scenarios, such as video surveillance, need quick image stitching to provide a wide field of view, accelerating the image stitching is critical. In recent years, the neural network is used to stitching images, but only relatively small size images can be processed; meanwhile, time-consuming image stitching is also unavoidable. In this paper, to quickly stitch 1920×1080 images generated by the dual camera system, an image stitching algorithm is proposed. We divided the algorithm depending on its timeliness on different steps, and its time-consuming steps are parallelized on Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) platforms to be accelerated. We tested different hierarchies for organization of threads and access of memory on compute unified device architecture (CUDA) programming, and the final experiment results showed that our algorithm could reach a speedup ratio up to 119x on the Desktop with 3080ti.

articleTitle: Economic dispatching strategy of microgrid based on multiple distributed power sources
abstract: This paper proposes an economic dispatching strategy for the microgrid based on multiple distributed energy sources, aiming at the problem that microgrid can fully cooperatively invoke multiple distributed energy sources and minimize the economic cost and carbon emissions. An optimization model is established, which includes wind generators, photovoltaic generators, diesel generators, gas turbines and the main grid. This study takes the minimum economic cost and the minimum carbon emissions as the dual objectives, and uses NSGA-II algorithm to solve the model. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify that this study can play a positive role in the economic and environmental protection operation of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Using Improved Discrimination Locality Preserving Projections Method Based on Cosine Distance for Industrial Process
abstract: Nowadays, with the continuous complexity of the scale of the process industry, the safety problems in industrial production have attracted numerous people’s attention. However, the current industrial data is characterized by high dimensionality, nonlinearity and strong coupling, and it is difficult for traditional data dimensionality reduction methods to extract important information from them. Aiming at this problem, a fault diagnosis method based on Cosine Distance Improved Discrimination Locality Preserving Projections (DLPP-C) is proposed in this paper. This method uses cosine distance instead of Euclidean distance, which solves the problem that Euclidean distance is easily affected when calculating high-dimensional data. Firstly, the proposed method is used to extract important information of high-dimensional data. Secondly, data of dimensionality reduction is classified by AdaBoost classifier. Finally, the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) is used for simulation experiment. The experimental results show that the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Seeker Optimization Algorithm based Path Planning of Warehouse Robot
abstract: Path optimization is one of the most important techniques for improving the efficiency of intelligent warehouse system, and which is considered by using Seeker Optimization Algorithm (SOA) in this paper. Firstly, an intelligent warehouse environment is constructed based on grid map. Then, A dichotomous randomized intermediate point selection strategy combining with a multi-directional search mechanism for path search is adopted in SOA, which is proposed for avoiding the problems of poor adaptation of the algorithm to specific maps and path redundancy. Finally, simulation validates effectiveness of the SOA by comparing it with Ant Colony optimization (ACO) and genetic algorithms (GA).

articleTitle: Active Fault-Tolerant Control for Path Following of Unmanned Surface Vehicle
abstract: In this paper a solution to the problem of active fault-tolerant control for path following of underactuated surface vessels with rudderless double thrusters is studied. The control method proposed can guarantee that the underactuated surface vessels accurately follow the given path even in case of partial gain loss of the actuator. The closed-loop system is verified to be uniformly bounded by Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, the simulation experiment is presented to display that the developed fault-tolerant control method is effective in fault detection, estimation, and controller reconfiguration for cancelling the adverse effects of gain loss of thrusters in path following task.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Classification Algorithm of Photovoltaic Array based on Noise Identification of Cluster Analysis
abstract: The development of solar photovoltaic power generation system has slowed down the aggravation of the energy crisis. Meanwhile, it has brought hidden trouble such as aging, short circuit, open circuit, hot spot of solar panels, which will cause serious obstacles to the power generation of solar photovoltaic system. Therefore, a timely and efficient online fault diagnosis method is the guarantee for the stable operation of photovoltaic system. In this paper, a 4x3 experimental model is built by a small photovoltaic power station to collect 180 sample data of each of the five types. Normalized preprocessing was performed on the data. Aiming at the situation that the experimental data classification accuracy is low due to the interference of human and environmental factors, a multi-fault classification and diagnosis optimization method of smart photovoltaic array based on cluster analysis noise identification is proposed. The optimized fault classification accuracy can reach more than 98%, which provides a favorable theoretical basis for photovoltaic array fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Migration Mechanism With Neighbor Retention Promotes Cooperation
abstract: Migration has received lots of attentions as a mechanism for facilitating the evolution of cooperation in network games. However, whether the role of migration in the evolution of cooperation is fully understood is still a debatable topic. Most previous work has generally assumed that individuals always disconnect from their preceding neighbors once they migrate, which is not always consistent with the reality. For this reason, here we examine a random migration mechanism with neighbor retention where individuals can retain relationship with some of their previous neighbors after migration. The results show that retaining a certain number of previous neighbors during migration can facilitate cooperation even if individuals migrate in a completely random way. Significantly, it can also help cooperator in random migration restore the ability to resist the invasion of defector. A positive correlation is established between the number of retained neighbors and the facilitation effect on cooperation. Our results may help explain the role of migration in underpinning the evolution of cooperation.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Super-Twisting-Like Attitude Tracking Control for A Quadrotor UAV
abstract: In this paper, a practical fixed-time controller is designed to deal with the tracking problem of a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) attitude control system subject to external disturbances. Firstly, a novel improved super-twisting-like algorithm (ISTLA) is proposed. More specifically, the signum function is substituted by the continuous function in the integral term of the ISTLA, which can further suppress the control chattering phenomenon. Then the practical fixed-time stability of the attitude tracking system is rigorously proved by homogeneous theory and Lyapunov method. Finally, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified by numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: H∞Output Tracking Control of Switched Fuzzy Systems
abstract: This paper addresses the H<inf>∞</inf> output tracking control problem for switched fuzzy systems. The objective is to design a controller to make outputs of the system tracking reference signals. Firstly, a state-dependent switching law is designed, together with the switched fuzzy controller. Then, sufficient conditions for H<inf>∞</inf> output tracking performance of the switched fuzzy system are derived in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Furthermore, the way to get parameter matrices of the controller is also given in LMIs. Finally, the proposed controller is applied to the output voltage tracking problem for four-switch Buck-Boost (FSBB) converters, and the simulation results verify its effectiveness.

Author Keywords: multiple Lyapunov functions˗ four-switch Buck-Boost (FSBB) converter

articleTitle: Solving the Collaborative Problem in the Process of Dual-Arm Robot Assembly Based on Fully Constrained Synchronous Collaboration Mode
abstract: In this paper, a fully constrained collaboration synchronization model is proposed to solve the cooperative problem in the dual-arm assembly process. Compared with the single-arm robot, the dual-arm robot has higher flexibility and larger working space, but it is more difficult to control. It has its inherent constraint relationship during movement. The dual-arm cooperation constraint is the basis of the dual-arm motion planning. The paper first analyzes the constraint relationship between the two arms when the rigid body is transported by the two arms and the assembly of the shaft hole respectively. The study finds that there are many common points between the two movements: during the movement process, the two manipulators always maintain a constraint relationship with the object. On this basis, the full constraint is proposed to solve the position and pose constraints of the tool hands when the arms are moved. Finally, the simulation experiment of dual-arm handling rigid body and shaft-hole assembly is carried out to verify that the proposed dual-arm cooperation mode can effectively realize the dual-arm cooperative motion.

articleTitle: Study on Terrain Navigation Technology for Cruise Missile Based on Laser Echo Waveform Matching
abstract: Terrain matching navigation cannot be implemented effectively for the cruise missile in the flat terrain area, which is very disadvantage for the selection of terrain matching area. In this paper, a new terrain navigation technology for the cruise missile based on laser echo waveform matching is studied. By extracting the characteristics of the laser echo waveform from the ground target and matching with the waveform data in the database, the attribute and location of the ground target are determined. The flight route of the missile can be further corrected according to the position of the target in the map. This technology can expand the selection range of terrain matching area, lower the requirement on the height fluctuation of the terrain and reduce the difficulty of planning terrain matching area for the cruise missile, and has a good military application value for improving the performance of cruise missile.

articleTitle: A Trajectory Planning Method Based on Quad-tree Convex Feasible Set in Unstructured Environments
abstract: Trajectory planning in unstructured environments is a basic task for mobile robots. When trajectory planning is considered an optimization problem, the nonlinear kinematic constraints and the non-convex collision avoidance constraints often make it challenging. A trajectory planning algorithm that consists of two steps is proposed to address these problems in this paper. The first step is to combine the quad-tree map with the improved convex feasible set(CFS) method to construct a local convex feasible space. The second step is to solve the optimization problem iteratively, and an optimal margin judgment condition is proposed to reuse the local feasible spaces. The main contribution of this paper is that we combine the quad-tree map with the improved CFS to construct local convex feasible spaces efficiently. Numerical simulation results show that this algorithm can obtain collision-free and feasible vehicle trajectory in a short time. And the completeness of the trajectory can be guaranteed under a certain number of iterations.

articleTitle: Platoon Keeping and Collision Avoidance Based on Distributed Model Predictive Control Under Arbitrary Communication Chain Malfunction
abstract: In this paper, a platoon keeping and collision avoidance method based on distributed model predictive control(DMPC) is proposed to solve the problem of arbitrary communication chain malfunctions under a bidirectional-leader topology. Firstly, for the platoon under normal communication, a DMPC controller is designed by using the trajectory information of the leader and predecessor vehicle, which also satisfies the situation when communication chain between the follower (except follower 1) and the leader malfunction. Secondly, for other communication chain malfunction situation, we proposed the corresponding communication topology transformation scheme and controller transformation scheme, which makes the proposed control scheme can adapt to arbitrary communication chain malfunction situation. Finally, as for the control strategy proposed in this paper, some simulation experiments are carried out.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of a Centrifugal Compressor for the PEMFC Air Feeding System
abstract: The performance of the air compressor, which is the most crucial part of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), has a significant influence on the steady operation of the system. The unknown parameters in the Moore Greitzer model are identified by an adaptive genetic algorithm in order to construct a precise mathematical model of the air compressor. The outcomes of the experiment demonstrate that the established compressor model and the obtained data agree well. The proposed model is then applied to a 10kW fuel cell stack model, and the compressor airflow is adjusted using a straightforward PID controller. The simulation findings show that the compressor can efficiently meet the needs of the fuel cell stack even when there are frequent load variations.

articleTitle: Global periodic event-triggered output feedback stabilization for switched nonlinear systems under arbitrary switchings
abstract: An output feedback periodic event-triggered control (PETC) strategy is developed for nonstrict-feedback switched nonlinear systems (SNSs) in this paper. In the proposed scheme, only sampled system output is utilized. To estimate the unmeasured system states, a common state observer, which is independent of the switching signal, is constructed for all subsystems. To save communication resources, an event-triggered controller is designed by only using states at event-triggering instants and the developed PETC scheme only needs to monitor the designed discrete-time event-triggering mechanism (ETM) at sampling instants intermittently. To guarantee that the closed-loop system (CLS) is global asymptotically stable (GAS), a proper common Lyapunov function (CLF) is selected and the range of the sampling period is derived. Finally, the proposed scheme’s effectiveness is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Strategy with Path-following for USV Based on Obstacle-guidance Model Using 2D-Lidar in Urban River Conditions
abstract: An obstacle detection and automatic avoidance algorithm using lidar based on the obstacle-guidance model is proposed for Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USV) in urban river conditions. The smallest bounding rectangles represent obstacles detected by 2d-lidar due to the clutter of urban river laser data and the shape of actual blocks during navigation. On this basis, an obstacle vortex guidance model is proposed. The obstacle avoidance algorithm takes the heading and speed obtained by the Line-Of-Sight (LOS) method as input. It combines the obstacle guidance model to give the speed and yaw required for collision avoidance, which achieves good real-time performance and robustness in practical applications. Finally, the actual experiment is completed based on the built USV platform, where the entire algorithm is implemented on the Robot Operating System (ROS). The experiment results verify the proposed obstacle-avoidance method’s feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Containment Control of Fractional-Order Nonlinear Multiagent Systems
abstract: This paper considers the problem of robust adaptive containment control of fractional-order nonlinear multiagent systems. More specifically, multiple leader agent systems with bounded control inputs, and multiple follower agent systems with unknown nonlinear functions, parameterized uncertainty and disturbances are considered simultaneously. A fully distributed algorithm is proposed to ensure the containment error exponentially converges to zero vector, and the proposed algorithm allows for robust even there exists heterogeneous nonlinear functions and time-varying disturbances. An example is finally given to verify the results.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Event-Based Cooperative Control Algorithm Design for Multi-Agent Systems based on Time Base Generator
abstract: Practical fixed-time bipartite consensus problem for multi-agent systems on undirected graphs is studied in this article. A new event-triggered control protocol is constructed, which incorporates fully distributed way and time base generator(TBG). The application of fully distributed control mechanism makes the controller based on local information, rather than global information. The settling time can be determined in advance due to the application of TBG, which is not affected by initial states. Some conditions are proposed to guarantee the achievement of practical fixed-time bipartite consensus and the avoidance of Zeno behavior. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the control algorithm.

articleTitle: A Semantic Interpretation Method for Deep Neural Networks Based on Knowledge Graphs
abstract: Despite the great success of deep neural networks in many fields, the lack of interpretability has severely limited their wide application in security-sensitive tasks. Although current interpretable methods of deep neural networks such as visualization, class activation mapping, and sensitivity analysis can help users intuitively understand the inner working mechanism of the neural networks to some extent, they are either too coarse in explanation or too complex in explanation form to read easily. In order to use semantic information which is more understandable and close to human thought to interpret the deep neural network and increase the readability of the interpretation,we propose a semantic interpretation method of deep neural network based on knowledge graph. The method takes the VGG16 network as an example, and by mining the key neuronsof the neural network, construct semantic dictionaries and knowledge maps of key neurons, and automatically generate human-understandable semantic explanatory statements based on the knowledge maps. The method provides a new idea to improve the transparency of the operation process of deep neural networks, and also provides a clearer reference basis for pruning and tuning of deep neural networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Robust Broad Nonlinear Representation CVA Method for Monitoring Blast Furnace Iron-making Process
abstract: Blast furnace iron-making process is one of the most crucial parts in iron and steel industry. Due to many interference factors and a series of complex physical and chemical reactions, abnormal furnace conditions often occur. The nonlinear characteristics hidden in the blast furnace data and the existence of large noise and outliers make it difficult to establish an effective monitoring model. In this paper, a novel robust broad nonlinear representation canonical variate analysis (RBNCVA) method is proposed to overcome the above problems. First, a feature extraction strategy is developed to extract robust broad nonlinear features based on stacked denoising autoencoder (SDAE). The robust broad nonlinear features can assist the model to cope with the complex nonlinearity and resist the interference of noise and outliers. Then canonical variate analysis (CVA) method is used to analyze the relationship between past and future feature vectors. Subsequently, control limits are computed through probability density functions defined by kernel density estimation. Finally, the practical blast furnace data is adopted to validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Anti-Jamming Game for Remote State Estimation under Band-Jamming Attack
abstract: Due to Cyber-Physical Systems applied to a broad range of fields, as well as the advanced skills of cyber attacks, there is a growing need in the safety of CPS. In this paper, a discrete LTI estimation system with a sensor sending data to remote estimator via multiple wireless channels is considered. The system is likely to be attacked by a malicious attacker. The task of each side is to choose a proper step and channel (or channels) to transmit packets (or launch attacks) under the given constraints. We formulate this time-channel chosen problem as a framework of game model and reveal Nash equilibrium of proposed framework. Furthermore, to illustrate our results, we present some simulations.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Trajectory Prediction Method for High Speed Targets based on WD-LSTM
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy and model generalization ability, this paper proposes a wavelet decomposition (WD) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model to predict the target maneuver trajectory. Wavelet decomposition can decompose the trajectory time series into a series of high frequency and low frequency components. The long short-term memory network has a memory function, which can mine the hidden long-term dependencies between time series through learning. The combination of the two increases the accuracy of trajectory time series prediction. The proposed model is verified by simulation software, and the results show that the proposed model has a satisfactory accuracy for the prediction of air combat trajectory, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Disturbance Rejection Control With Finite-time Convergence For Quadrotor Transportation System
abstract: In this paper, based on disturbance observer, a disturbance rejection control method is proposed to solve the trajectory tracking problem of quadrotor with suspended load. Based on the multivariable super-twisting algorithm, the external disturbance and the lumped disturbance are compensated by a finite-time disturbance observer in order to guarantee the finite time convergence of the double closed-loop system. Based on the Lyapunov method, it is proved that the closed-loop control system is stable in a finite time, and the observation error is uniformly ultimately bounded. The proposed method of control is demonstrated to be effective in simulations.

articleTitle: Development of Parametric Reinforcement Learning for different operation preferences
abstract: With the industry process becoming more and more complex, there are more and more different working conditions and operation policy requirements. Accordingly, operators with different operation preferences are needed in different conditions. Some are conservative and some are aggressive. At the same time, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is becoming notable for its excellent performance in exploring controlling policies in various kinds of problems in the past few years. However, although DRL can help solve the problem in some condition, it can be difficult for one agent to adapt to all situations, and it is also a waste of time to train a new agent when new operation requirements come. In this paper, a method called Parametric Reinforcement Learning is proposed to solve the problem, using a parameter to represent the policy characteristic of a single agent, so that the target operation can be fitted with some base agents trained ahead of time. Also, Shell benchmark is used to simulate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Interpolation and simulation of autonomous driving camera data for vehicle position synchronization
abstract: In order to meet the data requirements of the virtual simulation test of autonomous driving, we use the camera’s single-sample video data, interpolate frames to generate multiple camera simulation data. And then realize the simulation of extended front-end perception function at the data level. This paper proposes a video sampling frame simulation reconstruction mechanism based on sampling vehicle pose information in real scenes. Calculate the target position of the simulated vehicle according to the simulation requirements, and establish a simulation node on the sampling path. Taking the position difference between the simulated node and the real node as the offset, the DAIN algorithm is used to insert the image data into the target node. It is possible to realize simulation data generation of autonomous driving camera with variable vehicle speed/sampling frequency. Combined with the camera’s internal and external parameters, the coordinate system transformation of the annotation results is carried out to realize the inheritance of the annotation results of the simulation data. This paper combines the nuScenes open source database to test the authenticity of the synchronous simulation data results. The results show that the mean SSIM of the synchronous simulation image data and the real data is 0.71684, indicating that the simulation data has high authenticity. Based on yolov4, the perceptual function of the simulated data is verified. The average value of the SSIM of the simulated image data and the real data recognition frame is 0.984504795, and the perceptual recognition results are similar. The synchronous mapping result of the marked 3D-BOX box to the simulation data space is correct. Camera simulation data can well meet the needs of autonomous driving development and testing in perception and recognition. It can provide data support for autonomous driving simulation test.

articleTitle: Online Data-Driven Model Predictive Control in Variable Noise Environment Based on Neural Network and Gaussian Process Regression
abstract: This paper investigates model predictive control in variable noise environment. A modeling method based on neural network and online Gaussian process regression is proposed, and the corresponding model predictive control algorithm is designed. Compared with the common data-driven model predictive control, this paper uses neural network to replace the traditional mathematical model, which reduces the workload of measuring parameters in modeling. In addition, Gaussian process regression is used for online learning to improve the performance of agents under noise interference. A simulation experiment is designed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. Finally, the experiments on a real quadrotor are conducted and the results show that the proposed algorithm remains feasible in the real world.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Experimental Platform for Small Unmanned Airship
abstract: With the commercialization of multi-rotor UAVs, UAV technology is constantly improving. As a typical automatic control object, small unmanned airship has the characteristics of many variables and high complexity. It is very suitable as an experimental platform for automatic control theory and improves students' practical ability. In order to improve the students' engineering practice ability, a small unmanned airship experimental platform is designed. Taking the small unmanned airship as the research object, it integrates many theoretical courses such as machinery, automation and electronics to solve practical engineering problems. The design scheme of the experimental plane, and the development of the experimental project based on the small unmanned airship. Students can master the design principles and methods of automatic control systems through theoretical research, assembly experiments and flight operation experiments, mathematical modeling experiments, and control algorithm design and parameter tuning experiments.

articleTitle: Star image processing method of star sensor based on star points prediction
abstract: Star image processing method based on star point prediction is proposed, to solve the problems of large storage space of star image data, large computation of star point extraction and fake stars that cannot be used for attitude determination in traditional star sensor in this paper. According to the attitude prior information, the navigation star library is used to predict the position of stars in the detector and the stripe information of stars. Under the constraints of the total number of pixel rows and the total number of stripes, only the stripes with more stars are reserved for the design of the detector driver by clustering merging. At the same time, the scan line seed filling method is used to extract stars only in the predicted star window region, which greatly reduces the image storage space and star image extraction time consumption. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional full image processing method, the star sensor image processing method based on star point prediction has great advantages in star point extraction stability, storage space and time consumption.

articleTitle: Off-load Semantic Terrain Classification Using 3D LiDAR Data
abstract: Off-load environment understanding is an essential component of autonomous driving technology and plays an important role in trajectory planning and self-navigation. In the last decade, huge number of researches on this topic had been done for urban environments. However, the algorithms are limited on off-load environments. Different from the structured urban environments, the off-load environments are more complex which lead to the challenges to transfer the algorithms designed for urban environments to off-load environments. For off-load navigation task, an accurate traversability map is more important than detecting the specific obstacle types. Previous work on offload environments, mainly understanding the environments with the labels of positive obstacles, negative obstacles, traversable area, etc., which is not convenient for trajectory planning compared with traversability map. In this paper, we propose an algorithm for off-load semantic terrain traversability classification using 3D LiDAR data. We classify the points from LiDAR into 3 classes(traversable, risk, untraversable) according to their height and normal vector features. For the convenience of trajectory planning, we project the labeled points to a BEV grid map to generate the traversability map. We evaluate our algorithm on open dataset RELLIS-3D and our own dataset and achieve convincing performance.

articleTitle: Stuck Pipe Prediction Using Adaptive Nero-Fuzzy Inference System Based on Feature Analysis
abstract: In the process of underground drilling in coal mine, there are some cases of drilling resistance but not stuck pipe. The method of data training model to predict stuck drilling will often lead to a high false alarm rate and reduce the prediction accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved adaptive nero-fuzzy inference system prediction method based on feature analysis (ANFIS-FA). The rotational speed with the strongest correlation was selected as the feature analysis object through principal component analysis, and then the sliding window was used to extract the amplitude change to construct the penalty factor, so as to improve the prediction results of ANFIS. In this paper, the actual drilling data are used for experiments. The results show that ANFIS-FA reduces the false alarm rate and improves the prediction accuracy, which has certain guiding significance for practical drilling.

articleTitle: CFCNet: A coarse-to-fine cascade network for retinal vessel segmentation
abstract: In this paper, a new retinal vessel segmentation method is proposed to study the early symptoms and prevention of certain eye diseases. There are still no effective algorithm for existing automatic vessel segmentation methods to obtain precise results by reason of the complexity of retinal vessels and therefore a coarse-to-fine cascade network named CFCNet is formulated and aiming at improving the accuracy of retinal vessel segmentation. Here, two U-shaped sub-networks are contained in the proposed network. Vessels are coarsely segmented by the first sub-network (Net1) and then refined by the second sub-network (Net2). To enrich features, Cross-Level Connections are introduced in the CFCNet. Res-ASPP and CBAM are further implemented for the sake of extracting the multi-scale features and enhancement, respectively. Two databases of DRIVE and STARE are then employed in several experiments for the purpose of evaluating te proposed network. The results show that the proposed CFCNet achieves more competitive effect for retinal vessel segmentation than the existing networks and is of great clinical significance.

articleTitle: Profile Tracking Control of High-speed Trains With Event-triggered Communication*
abstract: Well designed control strategy and communication mechanism can help to improve the performance and efficiency of high-speed trains during their operation. This study investigates the tracking control of high-speed trains in the context of unknown resistance coefficients and event-triggered communication. We at first transformed the train control system into a second-order uncertain strict feedback control system with the control input transmitted/refreshed discretely. Then, by the adaptive and co-design method, a new event-triggered control law, involving an adaptive law and an event-triggered mechanism, for the high-speed train is proposed. By this controller, the desired profiles of the train, composed of position and velocity, can be tracked into a small adjustable steady-state error. At last, the proposed results are verified by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation of A Serpent-like Bronchial Surgery Robot Design and Control
abstract: In this paper, a new serpent-like bronchial surgery robot is proposed. The structure uses a three-layer structure and a combination of rigid and flexible bodies. This structure meets the requirements of flexibility and rigidity of instruments during surgery. The control method of the bronchial surgery robot is also explored based on this structure. The motion control model of this structure is established by combining the motion theory analysis with the screw theory. A virtual simulation model of the bronchial surgery robot is constructed to verify the accuracy of the model. After the comparative motion control test, the overall shape position deviation and attitude deviation of the robot are within the controllable range. Therefore, the feasibility of the model was verified.

articleTitle: Dual-stream multidimensional network for aluminum electrolysis process superheat identification
abstract: Superheat identification is very important in aluminum electrolysis industry. In order to realize the real-time identification of superheat, this paper proposes a novel dual-stream multidimensional network (DM) model, which is composed of an efficient stream and an accuracy stream. In efficient stream, a mobilenet is equipped on Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) devices to achieve quick superheat identification as normality or abnormality. In accuracy stream, a two-stream information sharing 3D residual network is equipped on a cloud computing service to achieve accurate identification through abnormal frames. Experiments are conducted on the aluminum electrolysis datasets, and the results verify that our DM model can realize efficient and accurate identification under resource saving condition.

articleTitle: Propagation attenuation detection of pulsed laser by multi-scaled cloud particles
abstract: The optical properties of scattering and attenuation of cloud drops are the key factors affecting the precision of laser guided weapon. Based on the beam propagation properties, The scattering propagation model of laser in cloud was established, the influence of optical characteristics of different clouds on the scattering was analyzed, and the attenuation of laser scattering under different cloud types was calculated. It was concluded that the laser attenuation strengthened with the increase of the concentration of cloud particles and scattering coefficient. As well the photon distribution on the receiving surface was more dispersed, and the spot diameter increased. With the multi-sized particle backscattering model presented here, some theoretical basis and test method for the precise guidance of laser-guided weapons can be provided.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on Clustering Assistance
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is a key technology to achieve natural human-computer interaction. The development of SER is significantly influenced by the scale of the sample. In recent years, the study of SER has been intensified by introducing data augmentation methods. However, most of these methods directly augment the sample data scale, neglecting the rational analysis and utilization of the feature distribution of samples. In this paper, we propose a new framework for SER based on clustering assistance, which can utilize the feature distribution information of the sample data directly and effectively. It considers the sample proportion of each emotion category in the clusters obtained by clustering, converts it into a probability score, which is called the clustering emotion probability score, and fuses it with the emotion probability score from the simple classification model according to different fusion weighting factors. We evaluated the proposed method with the baseline model on the IEMOCAP dataset. Experimental results show that our method achieves better results than the baseline model in terms of both weighted and unweighted accuracy.

articleTitle: Distributed Finite-time Consensus-Based Economic Dispatch Using Event-triggered Mechanism
abstract: A distributed finite-time consensus-based economic dispatch algorithm is proposed for smart grid using event-triggered mechanism. The scheme is implemented based on a multi-agent system structure, which only depends on the local communication and computation among neighboring agents. For smart grids without generator constraints, distributed event-triggered controllers are built to achieve the finite-time consensus of the incremental cost. Then a projection operator is used for each generator to deduce the power output when its generating capacity is limited. Simulation example is given to test the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Terminal Impact-angle-constrained Guidance Law of Miniature Munition Based on High-order Fully Actuated System Approach
abstract: Aiming at the terminal impact-angle constraint in the interception of large maneuvering targets by munition, this paper proposes a three-dimensional(3D) maneuvering target interception guidance law combined with the high-order fully-actuated (HOFA) system theory based on biased proportional navigation guidance (BPNG). First, a complete second-order nonlinear model with fully-actuation is built for munition-target relative motion without the small-angle assumption. Second, the nonlinear system of the munition-target relative motion is transformed into a quasi-feedback system, and a HOFA model is developed for the system. A BPNG law with the linear relationship of the line-of-sight angle is introduced to transform the closed-loop system into a linear time-invariant closed-loop system with the expected characteristic structure. Finally, target maneuver information is taken as the model compensation and adopted as the external input of the closed-loop system together with the remainder of the guidance law; thus, the channel coupling of the nonlinear three-dimensional system is eliminated. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Sampling-based event-triggered aperiodic intermittent control for stabilization of continuous-time dynamical systems
abstract: In this paper, we study the sampling-based event-triggered aperiodic intermittent control (S-EAIC) for the stabilization of continuous-time dynamical systems (CDS). The comparison was given between S-EAIC and the recent proposed event-triggered aperiodic intermittent control (E-APIC) with state-based control widths (SCW). The results show that compared with E-APIC with SCW, S-EAIC has the best control performance with the least amount of control computation and the least number of control times. Finally, a Chua’s system is taken as an example to verify the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent monitoring and dynamic early warning system for geological hazards
abstract: Intelligent monitoring system is crucial to the process of geological disaster prevention and control, and plays a vital role in improving prevention and control efficiency and early warning accuracy. An intelligent monitoring and dynamic early warning system for geological hazards is designed. First, four main functional requirements of data fusion and visualization, single landslide dynamic warning, regional landslide susceptibility evaluation and risk level inquiry are analyzed in detail. Then, the system network architecture is analyzed and a six-layer software framework is designed. Finally, a new online data architecture is proposed. The designed system provides a feasible solution for geological disaster prevention and control.

articleTitle: Intrinsic and Extrinsic Calibration of Roadside LiDAR and Camera
abstract: LiDAR-camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters calibration is a prerequisite for LiDAR-camera sensor suite in the cooperative vehicle-infrastructure system or autonomous driving system. However, the calibration of LiDAR-camera is not trivial in some special scenes such as traffic scenes since the traditional target-based calibration methods are subject to the road condition. Moreover, the changing intrinsic parameters of the camera owing to focusing also pose unique challenges to such calibration tasks. Hence, a novel targetless method that jointly performs the intrinsic and extrinsic parameters calibration of LiDAR and camera sensor suite is proposed in this paper. The 2D and 3D features are collected from color images and point cloud respectively. The distance transform image is obtained from a 2D feature map and used as a reprojection error energy function for optimization. Alternatively, the observability of intrinsic and extrinsic parameters in our calibration system is theoretically verified, and the proposed method is tested in simulation and real-world scenes. Experiment results show that the method has better robustness and accuracy than other targetless calibration methods.

articleTitle: Agile and Intelligent Control based on Geometric Motion Primitives for Robotic Arms
abstract: Human motion control systems are complex and highly refined, which have the properties of self-organizing, self-learning, and self-adapting. The excellent motion characteristics can provide biological inspirations to control strategies for manipulators. In this paper, we draw on the control theory based on biological motor primitives which can represent the fundamental geometric invariant properties. Then the trajec-tory planning based on motion primitives is employed, which can reduce the computational effort and greatly improve the performance of agile control. In this paper, we propose a modeling method for motion primitives based on geometric invariants, and construct three styles of boxing motion primitives including straight punches, uppercuts and swing punches. Then, a deep neural network-based approach for boxing primitives is presented, which can represent geometric primitives as neural network models. Finally, the experiments are carried out on simulated and real robotic arms.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection for Internet of things Using Self-supervised Pre-training on GRU
abstract: Intrusion detection is crucial in the Internet of Things (IoT) due to the scarcity of computing resources and the variability of the network environment when it is used in smart buildings, smart factories and other scenarios. Current intrusion detection solutions are mostly applicable to a single environment (or a single dataset) and require large amounts of labeled data for supervised training methods, which are not applicable to variable IoT network environments. In this paper, we investigate the recognition effect of GRU networks on the packet sequences made up of IoT network packets and suggest a self-supervised pre-training method based on GRU networks. In order to improve the effectiveness of supervised training in the following fine-tuning phase, the unlabeled data is utilized in the pre-training of this method to find sequence data correlations in the data flow and deeper representations of the data. The proposed model is evaluated on datasets such as TON-IoT, and it is observed that our method can significantly increase the model detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Composite Hierarchical Anti-Disturbance Control for Nonlinear Polynomial Systems with Applications to Active Suspension Control Systems
abstract: In an effort to deal with multiple disturbances in the existence of practical nonlinear polynomial systems,, a novel composite hierarchical anti-disturbance control (CHADC) scheme is presented by integrating disturbance-observer-based control (DOBC) with mixed stabilizing control. The H<inf>∞</inf> mixed stabilizing controller within the nonlinear parameter- varying (NPV) framework is constructed separately from the nonlinear disturbance observer. The H<inf>∞</inf> mixed stabilizing control suppresses the external disturbance of the system and ensures the transient and steady-state performance, while DOBC is to attenuate parametric disturbances and modeling errors. Then, based on SOS, the H<inf>∞</inf> mixing stability. At the end of the paper, the new method proposed in this paper is applied to the active suspension system, and the experimental results show that the performance of CHADC is better than other methods..

articleTitle: Unsupervised frequency domain information guided generative adversarial networks for pan-sharpening
abstract: Pan-sharpening of multispectra images aims to obtain an image that contains both high spectral and spatial resolution by fusing multispectral(MS) and panchromatic(PAN) images. In practice, unsupervised deep learning methods can be trained using raw full-resolution images and have particular advantages over supervised methods. However, since unsupervised methods cannot rely on labels to learn explicit mapping, it is hard to preserve and utilize the spectral and spatial knowledge in full-resolution images. To solve this problem, we pay special attention to frequency decoupling and utilization of input full-resolution images by unsupervised generative adversarial networks. The new generator network not only extracts spatial details in the high-frequency domain but also focuses on the interaction of sub-bands with sufficient low-frequency knowledge. At the same time, the new discriminator network also innovatively integrates the prior information of frequency enhancement. The qualitative and quantitative experimental results on Quickbird and Gaofen-2 datasets demonstrate that the challenging pan-sharpening task can be effectively performed by focusing on decoupled high and low-frequency information in both generator and discriminator networks.

articleTitle: Prediction of High-entropy Alloy Hardness Based on Ensemble Learning Combination Algorithm
abstract: Compared with traditional alloys, the number of high-entropy alloying elements and the diversity of microstructure lead to complex synthesis, tremendous theoretical calculations, large differences in synthesis time and performance, and hinder the development of high-entropy alloys. Machine learning, as a hot technology in recent years, is also changing all aspects of human life, and various fields are also undergoing unprecedented changes due to the application of machine learning. In recent years, the material science community has begun to use machine learning tools to help solve problems in the development of high-entropy alloys. This paper uses an ensemble learning-based method to predict the hardness of high-entropy alloys, compares and screens the six widely used algorithms in Bagging and Boosting algorithms to obtain algorithms with better performance. Then, the optimal combination model is found through model combination, and finally, the combination model is evaluated. The results show that the combined model has high accuracy and is suitable for the exploration and prediction of high entropy alloy materials.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Event-triggered Time-varying Formation Control of Linear Multi-agent Systems
abstract: Formation control problem for general linear multi-agent systems is studied in this paper. Based on the observed information of agents’ states, an event-triggered control scheme, which is dependant of the combined observed information at triggering time instants and some formation compensation signals, is put forward. A sufficient condition on the realizability of the desired time-varying formation is presented in terms of some inequality techniques. Moreover, the triggering time sequence is free of Zeno-behavior. A simulation example shows that the theoretical results are valid.

articleTitle: Multi-metric Depth Pyramid and Bilateral Segmentation Based Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo
abstract: An efficient and efficient Pyramid Multiview Stereo (MVS) network, which is a 3D Bilateral Network (3D Bisenet), is presented to reconstruct the dense point cloud accurately and completely. First, a multimetric depth map pyramid is introduced, which can be used to reconstruct the shallow missing features by efficiently aggregating the depth estimates at the different layers. Then, a 3-D bipartite segmentation network is presented to keep matching pairs in all views and to enhance the detail properties of the model, so as to recover the lost scene. Furthermore, the high resolution and precision of the scene model can be obtained by combining the rapid down-sampling and the semiu-Net-type context paths. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves an excellent performance on DTU data sets, and significantly improves performance.

articleTitle: Short-term Gas Load Prediction with STL and Hybrid Neural Network
abstract: Accurate prediction of gas load is critically important to ensure stable gas usage and accurate dispatch. In the literature currently available, the extensively used model-based methods are limited by their low prediction accuracy. In addition, data-driven approaches have low prediction accuracy because they are difficult to extract time series features directly from the original data. To resolve the above issues, a seasonal trend decomposition procedure based on loess (STL) has been developed to realize short-term gas load prediction with a hybrid neural network (HNN). Firstly, the original time series is divided into seasonal, trend, and residual components using STL. Especially, the trend is fitted with the least squares method, then both the new trend and residual components can be obtained. Secondly, the hybrid neural network is composed of a one-dimensional convolutional neutral network, a bidirectional gated recurrent unit, and a dilate gated recurrent unit, which are foused to extract temporal features for new residual component prediction. Finally, gas load prediction experiments are chosen to verify that STL-HNN outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Studies of short-term load forecasting model based on LSTM-NBEATS
abstract: Due to the current rising in oil prices and energy scarcity, the role of short term load forecasting is critical in basic functioning and scheduling of power systems. The forecasting accuracy of a single model always has its limitations. Therefore, the LSTM-NBEATS model, a combined model combining LSTM and NBEATS by a MAPE (mean absolute percentage error) weighting method is proposed. This model is easy to realize and train, and does not rely on complicated feature engineering. It is applied to hourly load datasets from three European countries, Macedonia (MK), Latvia (LV), and Poland (PL). In this paper, experimental results show that in short term load forecasting the model proposed performs effective.

articleTitle: Multi-Object Tracking Method for Aerial Images Based on ReID-Byte
abstract: Aiming at the problems of ID Switch and track fragment caused by the ground target occlusion in aerial video tracking, a multi-object tracking(MOT) method based on ReID-Byte is proposed. This method introduces the ReID model on the basis of the Byte algorithm to extract the appearance feature of the targets. This paper uses the multi-task learning method to train the YOLOX detector and the ReID model, and the detection confidence is used as the measure to separate the detection results to the high-scoring boxes and the low-scoring boxes for inter-frame target association processing. The appearance-motion model is used to match the trajectory with the high-scoring targets, and the motion model is used to match the trajectory with the low-scoring targets. The test results of the UAV aerial dataset show that the method proposed in this paper improves the tracking accuracy and can effectively handle the ID Switch and track fragment problems caused by the target occlusion.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Setting Value Optimization of Cement Combined Grinding System based on NSGA-II
abstract: In order to solve the problem of setting value optimization for stability control of cement grinding system, this paper proposes the optimal set value optimization of energy consumption based on NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm. The setting value of the system stability controller determines whether the optimal energy consumption is achieved during the cement grinding system, and it is also one of the more important concerns in cement optimization. Under the actual data of cement grinding system, the NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm uses the main circulating fan speed, bucket current and powder separator speed as the variable of making decision, ≤45um cement content, ball mill current and average cement output as the target value. The relationship between the decision variable and the target value is approximated by BP neural network. The simulation results of the multi-objective optimization algorithm show that the optimal target value is in line with the set value of the actual system stability control.

articleTitle: Window based Dynamic Scheduling Algorithm in Time Sensitive Networks
abstract: No specific implementation methods of traffic scheduling have been defined in the Time-Sensitive Network (TSN) protocols. Most research on traffic scheduling algorithms in TSN is for static network traffics. In this paper, a window based scheduling algorithm adaptive to network traffic fluctuations is proposed. An optimal period for Gate Control List (GCL) is firstly derived to guarantee the schedulability of control traffics. Then a dynamic window adjustment algorithm is proposed to maximize the bandwidth of best effort traffics. A simulated network is implemented based on OMNeT++/NeSTiNg simulation framework to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed scheduling algorithm significantly improves the delay and jitter performance under dynamic traffic configuration. The time-sensitive services can be guaranteed even when the traffic changes dynamically.

articleTitle: Multiple Harmonics Disturbance-observer-based Containment Tracking Control of Multi-agent Systems with Asymmetric Data Packet Dropout
abstract: This paper studied a formation containment tracking control algorithm of a discrete-time dynamics multi-agent system (MAS) subject to multiple harmonics disturbance and asymmetric data packet dropout. A MAS consists of the unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) containment tracking problem is considered. Firstly, to confirm the practical engineering, the external disturbance composed of many time-varying harmonics is estimated by a designed multiple harmonics disturbance observer. Secondly, according to the different data packet dropout probability between any two agents in the containment tracking task, an asymmetric packet dropout compensation strategy with the topology matrix is proposed for the disturbance-observer-based distributed containment tracking control scheme designing. By figuring out a series of linear matrix inequalities, the disturbance observer and containment tracking controller gains are obtained. Finally, simulation shows the effectiveness of the theoretical method.

articleTitle: Research and design of mobile monitoring system for muilt-section Succulent Plants cultivation
abstract: In order to achieve checking the state of the foster Succulent plants at any time and implement the accurate positioning of the mobile camera, this paper designs a mobile monitoring system with a camera. The mechanical part of the movable monitoring system consists of a linear guide rail, a mobile slide equipped with a camera, and a servo motor drive system. Siemens 1200 series PLC is used as the controller of the system, and Panasonic MHMJ022G1U servo motor and Panasonic A5 series MADHT1507E02 driver are used as the power supply of the system. Input the sample sending area that the customer needs to view through the HMI simulation client side, and the mobile camera can complete the precise positioning of the foster care area under the control of the control system, and open the camera in the designated area for image acquisition and transmission. Through the application analysis of the mobile monitoring system, this paper verifies the accuracy and stability of the system. This design system can be widely used in the fields of Succulent lants partition sampling, Succulent plants positioning and planting, etc.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis for a novel fractional-order malware propagation model system with time delay
abstract: The rapid development of network information technology, individual’s information networks security has become a very critical issue in our daily life. Therefore, it is necessary to study the malware propagation model system. In this paper, the traditional integer order malware propagation model system is extended to the field of fractional-order. Then we analyze the asymptotic stability of the fractional-order malware propagation model system when the equilibrium point is the origin and the time delay is 0. Next, the asymptotic stability and bifurcation analysis of the fractional-order malware propagation model system when the equilibrium point is the origin and the time delay is not 0 are carried out. Moreover, we study the asymptotic stability of the fractional-order malware propagation model system with an interior equilibrium point. In the end, so as to verify our theoretical results, many numerical simulations are provided.

articleTitle: Generator Set Load Balancing Control Using the Knapsack Algorithm
abstract: The factory test and maintenance of the generator set are essential for ensuring that the generator runs smoothly. A generator test is frequently required to determine the generator set's rated capacity. A range of test loads must be varied to fulfil the test criteria during the test. Traditional load switching systems are inefficient, simple to misuse, and use load resources imbalanced. Because of these issues, this study provides a solution for load matching and balancing control of generator unit tests based on the knapsack algorithm. Combining the knapsack problem model with multiple combinatorial optimization algorithms allows for simulated comparison and analysis. In the actual test, the optimal control technique obtained is compared to the traditional approach. The results reveal that the knapsack algorithm, which is based on a combination of the knapsack problem model and the discrete binary particle swarm algorithm, can more accurately match and apply the test load, successfully overcoming the old technique's issues causes. Simultaneously, test efficiency is enhanced, and the whole test load's service life is extended.

articleTitle: An analysis of mission command in modern cooperative engagement
abstract: At present, in the mobile Internet, big data, Internet of Things, cloud computing and other new doctrinal technologies, military intelligence has become the core driver of a new round of military change, profoundly affecting the seizure of power, the mechanism of victory, and combat theory, combat form. Especially in modern contract combat, as combat units face a wider area, the pace of combat is more rapid, the transformation of the offensive and defensive situation is more rapid, the need for interface and cooperation between the various combat nodes and combat elements is also closer, will require commanders at all levels to have a stronger battlefield initiative to seize the fleeting opportunity to promote the development of the battle process in our favor, so as to obtain the battle The "mission" that this paper will discuss is the "mission" of the Army. The "task-based command" discussed in this paper is a way of command that allows commanders at all levels, especially at the grassroots level, to maximize the use of information technology command tools and fully control the initiative on the battlefield.

articleTitle: A multi-neighborhood search algorithm for orthogonal packing of identical rectangular items within arbitrary convex regions
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient heuristic algorithm named the multi-neighborhood search (MNS) algorithm for the problem of packing orthogonally identical rectangles within random convex regions, which is a global optimization problem with many important applications. The problem involves the discrete and continuous optimizations and is shown to be NP-hard. To deal with the discrete and continuous aspects of problem, the proposed global optimization algorithm integrates two neighborhood search methods and the limited-memory BFGS method. Moreover, the algorithm employs a Metropolis acceptance criterion to accept a neighborhood solution as the current solution. The performance of proposed algorithm is assessed on a number of benchmark instances widely used in the literature. Computational results show that the proposed algorithm is quite efficient compared with the existing algorithms in the literature. Particularly, the proposed MNS algorithm is able to find the best known solution for all the tested instances and the computational time is short compared to those of existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Coordination Method for Voltage Improvement in Active Distribution Networks
abstract: To improve bus voltage in active distribution networks (ADN), coordinated power compensations of power electronic equipment such as inverter and converter are widely used. As they are limited by frequent communication or non-optimal coordination, how to design a method to facilitate optimal coordination while reducing communication is of significance. Hence, this paper designs a new hybrid coordinated voltage regulation method. Specifically, we propose an event-triggered algorithm firstly to divide all runtimes into trigger and non-trigger types. Then, a centralized proportional coordinated power compensation method is introduced to reduce bus voltage offset level for ADN operating at trigger instant. A decentralized local coordinated power compensation method is additionally used to suppress violating voltage fluctuation at non-trigger instant. Finally, the obtained results are presented to show the performance.

articleTitle: Swing Suppression and Accurate Positioning Control for Overhead Cranes Based on Preview Predictive Functional Control
abstract: In view of the problems of safety and rapidity in the anti-swing control of overhead cranes, a novel predictive control technique is presented founded on the concept of preview control. For the established model of an overhead crane, a preview controller is designed using linear quadratic regulator principle. And then, the output prediction in the predictive functional control is corrected by the feedforward compensation term of the preview control. The simulation results show that the designed controller not only makes the system have fast response, but also has strong robustness to uncertainties.

articleTitle: Memory-Enhanced Gated Graph Attention Network for Next Point-of-Interest Recommendation
abstract: The recommendation of the next Point-of-Interest (POI) has become an essential component of location-based social networks (LBSNs). Its purpose is to advise users' undiscovered POIs based on their check-in record. However, the existing work mainly regards the long-term interest of users as a periodic and stable change, but ignores the dynamic change. Besides, sparse POI-POI transformation limits the ability of the model to effectively learn contextual information in local views. We present a memory-enhanced gated graph attention network (MEGGA) in this paper. In order to effectively capture context in a local view, a gated graph attention network (GGAN) is designed, where category information is introduced to alleviate sparsity. In the long-term module, combined with the advantages of RNN and memory network, users' interests are dynamically captured by constantly updating user sequence while processing sequence information. Moreover, we use the attention layer to integrate multiple interests and learn the degree of users depending<sup>1</sup> on different interests. Two public datasets were used in experiments to confirm MEGGA efficacy.

articleTitle: Space Launch Sites Infrastructure Intelligence Monitoring and Maintinence
abstract: As mankind becomes more adept at utilizing and exploiting space resources, space launch activities are becoming more frequent.As a result, launch site infrastructure management and operation face new challenges. In traditional monitoring systems, the sensor measurement point is the primary unit. Analyzing, diagnosing, and acquiring data are all based on independent measurements. As a result, irregular and inconsistent data is collected by the monitoring system, making it difficult for applications to analyze it. Moreover, the algorithms of the intelligent alarm and fault diagnosis are tightly integrated with the monitored object. In addition to being difficult to reuse, this restricts the functionality of the monitoring system. An intelligent monitoring and maintenance system for space launch site infrastructure based on equipment models is presented in this paper. New generation information technology is used to design and develop the system, which include Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and the industrial internet. The functions and main technologies of the system in data acquisition, storage, analysis and visualization are introduced. The system has been applied in a launch site.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Four-wheel-Differential-Drive Vehicles Based on Modified Active Set Algorithm
abstract: Since the automatic guided vehicle (AGV) can replace human in warehousing or logistics, the trajectory tracking of the AGV has attracted lots of attentions for decades. Among the understudy tracking algorithm, the MPC-based is very popular at present. We thus consider the trajectory tracking of a four-wheel-differential-drive vehicle by MPC. However, solving the MPC is time-consuming. To this end, we propose a modified active-set algorithm to solve the involved MPC problem. The algorithm only needs solving two subproblems. The first subproblem is the one with the most and independent equality constraints. The second subproblem is obtained via neglecting all constraints with negative Lagrange multiplier of the first one. The results of the simulation illustrates that the time consumption of the modified active-set algorithm is less than that of the interior-point algorithm and the active-set algorithm due to the reduction of calculation times.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning Method of Autonomous Vehicle in Road Scene
