To address the multiple types of anomalies in bridge monitoring data, nine features that fit the bridge data situation are constructed using high-frequency acceleration data, and anomaly detection is performed using a pattern recognition LSTM neural network that is sensitive to time series, and run in real time by Flux in the Ganjiang Special Bridge monitoring system. The experimental results show that this scheme achieves a high level of accuracy for each category of anomaly detection, with a 4.53% improvement in accuracy compared to the PRNN neural network scheme. The overall detection time of real-time samples in practice is about 1.10s, and the overall anomaly detection accuracy reaches 99.65%, which meets the need for timeliness and accuracy of bridge anomaly detection system in practice.

articleTitle: Robust identification of input nonlinear block structure systems
abstract: A robust identification algorithm is presented for nonlinear systems with disturbance, which is fitted by Hammerstein block structure model. A hierarchical least squares method is proposed to estimate model parameters and track disturbance in combination with auxiliary modelling strategies and separable techniques. The multi-innovation technology for error updating is used to augment the dimension of the innovation matrix, in order to reduce the estimation error variance and enhance the convergence stability of the algorithm. The time-varying disturbance is still tracking by a single innovation strategy. Two adaptive forgetting factors are proposed to enhance the system parameters' convergence characteristics and to improve the track ability of time-varying disturbance. An example is applied to validate the benefits of the proposed algorithm. The established model can facilitate controller design and system operation monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on High speed and high precision visual detection Method for Surface defects of photovoltaic cells
abstract: This paper mainly studies the photovoltaic battery high speed and high precision surface defect visual inspection method, considering the monocrystalline silicon solar cell production process, defect characteristics, such as machine vision imaging system, discussed several common defect detection system, and in view of the photoluminescence and electroluminescence images three defect detection method is proposed, Using MATLAB and PYTHON programming, the image is preprocessed and the adaptive algorithm is found to extract the feature values, so as to achieve the purpose of defect detection.

articleTitle: A Stable Task Allocation Method Based on Insertion Operation in Ridesharing
abstract: In recent years, ridesharing based on mobile Internet has played an important role in public transport services. Ride-hailing platforms have been developed rapidly because of their fully resource utilization of vehicles. In this paper, we propose a task allocation method that satisfies stable matching in ridesharing scenarios, and experiments with real data are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the method. We also compare the effectiveness of this method with the FCFS method.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithm for Mobile Robots based on A* Algorithm with Adaptive Search Strategy
abstract: Path planning is one of the core functions of autonomous navigation. A* algorithm is widely used in the study of path planning for robots. Traditional A* algorithm is limited by the direction of node expansion. In some cases, it would generate some unnecessary bends, which makes the path not suit the motion characteristics of the robot and results in bad affection on its path. An improved A* algorithm with search strategy is proposed. The strategy of neighborhood point searching for A* algorithm is presented, so that A* algorithm has a more reasonable node search direction in a wider area. To further solve the unfavorable bending problem, the heuristic function takes the turns of the path into account in the cost function, which can reduce certain types of path turning that affect the robot’s motion. Finally, the improved A* algorithm is verified under simulation environment. Comparison tests with traditional A* algorithm, the path length of the proposed algorithm is reduced by 13.0 %, and the number of turns is reduced by 42.9 %. Compared with Dijkstra algorithm, the total time cost of the proposed algorithm is shortened by 12.3 %.

articleTitle: Levitation Control of Maglev Systems Based on Cascade Control
abstract: We address the levitation control of the single-point levitation system for maglev train by using the cascade control strategy in this paper. The levitation system is divided into two subsystems, i.e., electromagnetic system and motion system. In order to stabilize the levitation system more faster and roust, we design the sliding mode controller and fuzzy Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) controller, which constitute the cascade control, to control the electromagnetic system and motion system, respectively. The effectiveness and robustness of the cascade control are also verified in the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism-based Feature Extractor for Unsupervised Glass Surface Defect Detection
abstract: The high-quality glass is in high demand in the market, so it is of great importance to inspect the quality of glass quickly and accurately. However, the process of imaging the glass is susceptible to the surrounding environment interference, making it difficult to acquire glass surface data. In addition, glass surface defects are generally small and randomly distributed. To detect glass surface defects efficiently, we employ three imaging methods to obtain glass surface images and construct a glass surface defect dataset (GSDD). At the same time, we propose an unsupervised defect detection method based on the similarity of embedding vectors with the attention mechanism. By introducing an attention mechanism, the network can focus on the features of the defect without being affected by other features, which makes the feature embedding vector more representative. With the well-designed attention mechanism, our method achieves superior performance for both detection task and localization task. On the challenging dataset GSDD, our method achieves a 97.6% AUROC in detection task and a 99.6% AUROC in localization task, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art method.

articleTitle: The fixed-point landing of the quad-rotor UAV based on YOLOv5
abstract: This study proposed a method for realizing a fixed- point landing of a quad-rotor UAV based on YOLOv5. The experimental equipment contained a quad-rotor UAV and two edge-computing devices, and an intelligent connected vehicle (ICV) was used as the landing platform; the data transmission between experimental equipment was realized by local area network technology through a Wi-Fi module. The quad-rotor UAV was developed independently, including the UAV frame and flight control module, co-processing module, airborne camera and gimbal stabilizer, GPS locator, barometer, and power supply system. Real-time target detection was performed on the UAV's shooting pictures on an edge-computing device, and the detection results were sent to another edge-computing device. Another edge- computing device controlled the movement of the UAV according to the detection result, to realize the fixed-point landing of the quad-rotor UAV. Finally, the experimental results showed that the YOLOv5 target detection method can meet the real-time and accuracy requirements of the quad-rotor UAV for fixed-point landing.

articleTitle: Angle Measurement Method of Ice Hockey Elbow Pads Based on 3D LiDAR Point Cloud
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to accurately measure the movable angle of ice hockey elbow pads with non-contact equipment, an angle measurement method based on 3D light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point cloud is proposed. Firstly, when the small arm is rotating, for the problem that the traditional conditional filtering can only extract the point cloud of the small arm thin rod at a fixed angle after setting parameters, the semi-circular ring conditional filtering algorithm is proposed to intercept the point cloud at different angles. Secondly, for the problem of large operation and large error margin of linear regression by least squares method directly, the column-based clustering method is proposed to extract key points, simplify the operation of point cloud data and improve the accuracy of linear regression. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Interval Type-2 Fuzzy-Neural Sliding Mode Control for WWTP with External Disturbance
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive interval type-2 fuzzy-neural sliding mode control (AT2FSC) method using a disturbance observer is developed for wastewater treatment process (WWTP) with unknown external disturbance. Firstly, to overcome the modeling complexity of WWTP, a simplified interval type-2 fuzzy neural network (IT2FNN) is used to approximate the uncertainty dynamics of WWTP. Then, the network update parameters are reduced while ensuring the modeling accuracy. Secondly, the nonlinear disturbance observer is designed in AT2FSC to estimate the unknown external disturbance. Then, the robustness of AT2FSC under the influence of external disturbances can be guaranteed. Thirdly, the adaptive sliding mode gain is designed to achieve stable control of WWTP. The Lyapunov theory has finally demonstrated that the proposed AT2FSC approach can guarantee system stability. The outcomes of the simulation demonstrate the ability of the proposed AT2FSC approach to provide efficient control performance and suppress external disturbances in WWTP.

articleTitle: End-to-End Reduced-Reference Quality Assessment for Single Image Super-Resolution using Convolutional Network
abstract: Single image super-resolution (SISR) reconstructs high resolution (HR) images from a single low resolution (LR) image and has been widely studied in recent years. However, the evaluation of SISR images remains a problem worth exploring. In this paper, we propose an reduced-reference method to assess the SISR images based on an end-to-end model. The proposed image quality assessment (IQA) metric takes the LR image as a reference and exploits the structure and texture information of images to quantify the degradations of SISR images, and predicts the quality of SISR images by a regression network. Experimental results on two public SR-IQA databases show that our method obtains the best evaluation results compared with other methods, which indicates the superiority of our method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Dispatching of Converter Gas in Steel Industry based on Dual Critic Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: An optimal scheduling for converter gas is the key to realize energy savings and intelligent manufacturing in steel industry. Considering the traditional predictive optimization approaches are usually affected by prediction accuracy, reinforcement learning (RL) technology is adopted here to obtain dynamic dispatching strategies of the converter gas system. In view of the data of steelmaking process are with intermittent fluctuation characteristics, it would be a difficult task to establish a learning model simply using time domain data, which may thereby affect the RL process. In this study, a feature extraction method is employed to construct the state space of RL using frequency domain information. In order to improve the convergence of the policy network in RL, an improved dual critic proximal policy optimization (PPO) is further proposed, which combines the dual critic mechanism into the PPO algorithms. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, practical data come from the converter gas system of a domestic steel company are utilized to conduct our experiments. The results show that the proposed method achieves a better convergence performance and a lower economic cost compared with expert experience and other classic RL approaches.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control for ball mill load based on prescribed performance
abstract: To solve the problem of mill current fluctuations caused by sudden input changes in the cement combined grinding system, this paper built a mathematical model of the ball mill load and designed a sliding mode control for ball mill load based on prescribed performance. The prescribed performance formula is introduced into the controller to guarantee the error of mill current can quickly astrict according to the preset curve. Next, the sliding mode surface of mill current error is defined and controller is solved. Through simulation, and by comparing with model-free adaptive sliding control strategy, the designed control strategy can stabilize mill current, reduce adjustment time, and the effectiveness and robustness are verified.

articleTitle: Explicit Dynamic Analysis of Ice Hockey Shin Guard Based on ANSYS/LS-DYNA
abstract: In order to verify the protective performance of ice hockey shin guards, a dynamic analysis method of ice hockey shin guards based on ANSYS/LS-DYNA was proposed to solve the problem of using simulation technology to verify the process of impacted stress after the collision. Firstly, to decode the problem of large workload and low precision in modelling objects with complex surfaces, a strategy for modelling using 3D scanning was proposed. Secondly, a simulation analysis method based on usage scenarios was proposed to solve the problem that the reliability of simulation results is challenging to grasp. Based on the actual collision scene of ice hockey shin guards for dynamic analysis to improve the accuracy and reliability of the simulation results. Finally, the stress change curve under multiple working conditions and parameters is analyzed to verify the model’s validity and protection performance of the ice hockey shin guards, which provides a reference for further research on the ice hockey shin guards.

articleTitle: Application of Support Vector Machines Model in the Classification of Knee Joint Angle
abstract: In the control of lower limb exoskeletons, joint angles are very important information. At the same time, obtaining information on all joint angles of the lower limb exoskeleton requires multiple wearable sensors. However, the large number of sensors means that the placement and calibration of wearable sensors present a significant challenge. This study proposes the use of data from the waist and the thigh to classify the knee angle of the human body by using Linear-Support Vector Machines (L-SVM) and Radial Basis Function-Support Vector Machines (RBF-SVM), with the algorithms achieving a correct rate of 89.7% and 91.8%. The experimental validation shows the presented model achieves high accuracy, solving the complex calibration problem of multiple sensors while obtaining more information about the joint angles. The model can be useful for the future development of lower limb exoskeletons in terms of design and angular information extraction.

articleTitle: Attitude Feedforward Compensation Control for Multistage Satellite with Scanning Mechanism
abstract: In this paper, a multi-step prediction feed-forward compensation attitude control method based on the conservation of angular momentum is designed for multistage satellite with a two-dimensional scanning mechanism. Firstly, the dynamic model of multistage satellite with a scanning mechanism is established by the Newton-Euler method. Secondly, a multi-step prediction feedforward compensation method based on the conservation of angular momentum is proposed for the discrete multistage control system to solve the control period mismatching and the measurement delay. Finally, the numerical simulation shows that the control method proposed in this paper improves the attitude stability and pointing accuracy of multistage satellite by 3-4 times.

articleTitle: Design of printer data senseless acquisition device
abstract: Under the strong impact of the Internet, the operation of traditional shopping malls has become more and more difficult and urgently needs to be reformed. What can help the reform of shopping malls is the massive sales data generated in the long-term operation. However, because the cashier systems of merchants are independent of each other, it is difficult for shopping malls to acquire and audit the sales data reported by merchants in a unified manner. Therefore, a printer data senseless acquisition device is designed and completed. Subsequently shopping malls can use the merchant sales data acquired by the device to collect rent and optimize the types of merchants. In this paper, without affecting any function and printing process of the cash register printer, a data acquisition device is connected in series between the cash register and the printer. The device is plug and play, compatible with USB ports and serial port micro printers. For a cash register, the device is simulated as a printer; for a printer, the device is simulated as a cash register, which completes adaptive simulation (without configuration) and transparent transmission functions and can realize network data transmission or SD card temporary storage.

articleTitle: An image encryption algorithm based on multi-level discrete wavelet transform and hyperchaotic system
abstract: An encryption scheme based on multi-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and hyperchaotic system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, several random key streams are produced by a 4D hyperchaotic system. Secondly, the multiple wavelet transform is applied to obtain wavelet coefficients that carry the approximate information of the image. Thirdly, the wavelet coefficients are encrypted using the random chaotic sequences and then converted to an image via multi-level inverse discrete wavelet transform (IDWT). Finally, a diffusion process is applied to the pixels to enhance the randomness in the cipher image. The security analysis results show that our scheme is highly secure and has good statistical properties.

articleTitle: Robust Human Motion Estimation for Human Robot Collaboration
abstract: Accurate prediction of human motion trajectory is a key factor to ensure the safety of human-machine collaboration. To improve the safety and effectiveness of human-robot collaboration, the robot must make accurate intention prediction in the early stage of human motion and realize active robot behavior. This paper proposes a robust human upper limb end trajectory prediction algorithm, which can effectively Improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. The basic framework can be described as follows:1) According to the complex characteristics of human upper limb motion patterns, a robust Gaussian mixture model (RGMM) is proposed to model the motion trajectory. It can consider more comprehensive parameter information in the optimization process, and reduce the impact of traditional algorithms that are sensitive to initial values, easy to fall into local convergence and need a priori clustering value. 2) Gaussian mixture regression (GMR) is used to predict cluster trajectories and obtain statistical values of future trajectories. The experimental results show that the RGMP algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately describe human movement and make predictions, which not only ensures the safety of the human body but also has important significance for improving production efficiency.

articleTitle: Chaos Prediction of Power Oscillation System Based on Deep Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: In this paper, after analyzing the second-order power chaotic oscillation system, the factors of electromagnetic interference and charge interference are analyzed by using bifurcation diagram, Lyapunov exponent and 0-1 test theory. The sensitivity of electromagnetic interference parameters in power system is studied. At the same time, the extreme learning machine algorithm is improved and optimized into the deep extreme learning machine(DELM) algorithm, which is applied to the speed or load prediction of the power system. The experimental results show that the deep learning machine algorithm can achieve the prediction well. It provides reference for power system operation.

articleTitle: Synchronization of A Novel Interconnected Delayed Quaternion-Valued Neural Networks with Mixed Activation Functions
abstract: At present, for the studies of interconnected quaternion-valued neural networks (QVNNs) with time delays, scholars use the same activation functions, but it was limited by its single mathematical functionality. To solve this problem, a novel interconnected delayed QVNNs with mixed activation functions is first proposed in this paper. Synchronization problem for an array of linearly interconnected QVNNs with mixed activation functions is solved. All activation functions are assumed to satisfy Lipschitz condition. For the linearly interconnected QVNNs with time-varying delays and mixed activation functions, the synchronization state is defined as the average of all states. The synchronization between each node in the synchronization state is realized by constructing an appropriate Lyapunov function. Several succinct sufficient conditions are developed to guarantee synchronization of the considered model. Finally, the validity of the obtained theorem is illustrated by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Study on the Azimuthal Angle Remote Calibration &Leveling and Antimagnetic Constant-temperature Protection System for Seismometers
abstract: Zero drift or suspended swaying and acquisition signal interference, etc. may occur inside a seismometer as there is a sharp change in temperature, humidity or electromagnetic environment, because that will have an effect on its mechanical structure and electronic circuits. Meanwhile, the azimuthal angle of a seismometer may have a deviation to some extent due to non-standard erection of seismometer and vibration, etc. we developed an intelligent constant-temperature system. This system can monitor the temperature inside the protective cover on a real-time basis via a temperature sensor and compare it with the set upper and lower temperature limits. Aiming at the problem of azimuthal angle for seismic stations, we designed an azimuthal angle remote calibration system for seismometers, by which we can make azimuthal angle adjustment and seismometer leveling adjustment remotely on a computer. The results show that the we designed protection system, aimed to solve the problem of how to adjust azimuthal angle remotely, at the same time, prevent interference of external temperature and electromagnetic environment to the seismometer.

articleTitle: Research on UUV path planning method based on bidirectional A* algorithm
abstract: The efficient and reliable route planning of unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) is very important for its safe avoidance of obstacles and successful completion of tasks. Aiming at the problem that the standard A* algorithm is easy to fall into local minima, and the planning efficiency is low, which leads to low real-time performance, the bidirectional A* algorithm, which searches the path from the first point and the end point at the same time, is used for UUV path planning. Besides, aiming at the problem that the fidelity of the two- dimensional simulation environment is not high and it is difficult to depict the obstacle information in three-dimensional, the three-dimensional route planning scene is further constructed to test the performance of algorithms. The simulation results show that compared with the standard A* algorithm, the bidirectional A* algorithm can better take into account the efficiency and quality, and the planned path is safe and reasonable, meeting the obstacle avoidance requirements of UUV in three- dimensional space.

articleTitle: Ridge-regression Echo State Network for Effluent Ammonia Nitrogen Prediction
abstract: Echo state network (ESN) is trained by linear regression, which is an effective training method. However, ESN may have the ill-posed phenomenon. To solve this phenomenon, a ridge-regression echo state network (RESN) is given. We use the ridge-regression method to train RESN. The selection of regularization parameter is leave-one-out cross validation. The RESN can well deal with the ill-posed phenomenon. Experimental results show that RESN has high accuracy than some ESNs for effluent ammonia nitrogen.

articleTitle: Global Exponential Stabilization via Adaptive Output Feedback for Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Control Direction*
abstract: This work aims at enhancing adaptive control in terms of convergence rate, and specifically establishes a distinct adaptive output-feedback (OFB) scheme to ensure global stabilization with an exponential convergence rate for planar systems encountering intractable nonlinearities and unknown control directions. For this, a novel dynamic high gain is introduced with time-varying information delicately integrated into its updating law to ensure exponential convergence. Then, we propose a novel adaptive observer-based OFB controller. Particularly, to effectively deal with intractable nonlinearities and unknown control directions, Nussbaum-type function and tuning functions are subtly introduced during the controller design. It turns out that the system and observer states exponentially converge to zero by using this controller. Correspondingly, a distinct analysis pattern is adopted to attain the desired closed-loop stability.

articleTitle: AI-based detection system of resident’s behaviors in automatic trash sorting booths: a background computing-based solution
abstract: In order to track the serious problem of garbage siege, four-categories garbage sorting systems have been increasingly installed and employed in urban communities. However, manual supervision of trash delivery behaviors is costly, inefficient, and unsustainable from the long term. AI-based automated garbage sorting booths based on computer vision technology become an attractive solution. Under the four categories sorting system, the sorting and treatment of perishable or organic waste belong to the most challenging part. For the delivery of perishable waste in automatic garbage sorting booths, the key of AI-based solution is to accurately identify residents’ abnormal delivery behavior using object detection models. The composition of organic waste is extremely complicated, making it difficult to employ the object detection model in real applications. Therefore, this paper proposes a solution to use the YOLO model to identify non-organic objects such as garbage bags in the perishable barrels. The proposed solution in this study adopts the backend computing architecture and employs the multi-scale YOLOv4 model as the core, which can effectively identify the abnormal delivery of perishable waste. This system has been applied in dozens of intelligent waste delivery booths in Yiwu City, and has achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Simulation of synchronization control for ships in waves based on hydrodynamic forces
abstract: In the course of maneuvering between two ships, a certain distance must be kept between the leading ship and the following ship to avoid collision. In order to simulate the synchronous maneuvering control between two ships, the hydrodynamic model test and modeling simulation of a single ship were carried out at first. Then, based on the interaction force between two ships, the synchronous control simulation of two ships under wave conditions was completed. Finally, the effectiveness of the synchronous control method for two ships in waves was verified by simulation. Hydrodynamic interaction and wave force are the main factors affecting the navigation control and safety of the two ships.

articleTitle: Intelligent compensation prediction of leaching process based on GRU neural network
abstract: The intelligent modeling technology is applied to build a predictive model of leaching system, analyze the process characteristics, and provide scientific foundation for the engineering development and application of the new process. Based on the reaction principle and the theory of mass conservation, a mechanism model is established, which mainly includes gold conservation equations, cyanide ion conservation equations and related kinetic reaction velocity equations. The gated recurrent units (GRU) neural network is set up to compensate the prediction errors caused by the unmolded dynamics of mechanism model, and a parallel hybrid model is established. The hybrid model has the dual benefits of high accuracy of data model and excellent generalizability of mechanism model. The superiority and practicability of the hybrid model are also verified by practical test.

articleTitle: Molecular dynamics study of electroporation of phospholipid bilayer membranes containing KCSA protein
abstract: A phospholipid bimolecular membrane model containing the KCSA protein was developed in this study, and the bipolar pulse of 3ns and 0.4V/nm with 10ns phase spacing was applied to investigated the electroporation of the above model, based on all-atom molecular dynamics method. The simulation results showed that water molecules turn to change in moving direction with the switching of the polarity of the pulse, and phase intervals have a significant elimination effect on electroporation. Furthermore, the model state after the end of the interval affects the formation time of electroporation during negative pulses. The research results have strong guiding significance for the application of electroporation in various fields.

articleTitle: A Fast Solution Method for Large-Scale Unit Commitment Based on Virtual Power Boundary
abstract: This paper investigates the fast solution difficulty for large-scale unit commitment (UC) problems. The UC problem is a typical puzzle in the scheduling of power systems. Lagrangian relaxation (LR) and mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) are the two most widely adopted methods. However, in the LR framework, constructing feasible solutions and updating Lagrangian multipliers are two major challenges, and the efficiency of MILP methods is restricted by the scale of UC problems. To this end, this paper proposes a new fast solution method for large-scale UC based on virtual power boundary. Specifically, first, an initial trial solution is obtained based on the established state transition diagram. Second, a feasibility test model based on virtual power boundary is established to check the feasibility of trial UC solutions effectively. Third, the updating strategies for UC solutions are proposed based on the feasible gap solved by the feasibility test model. The procedure is implemented until a good feasible UC solution is obtained. Numerical results implemented on IEEE 24-bus, IEEE 31-bus, IEEE 118-bus, and Polish 2383-bus systems show the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Dilated Causal Convolutional and Transformer Attention Prototype Network with Cut Feature Map for ECG Classification
abstract: Deep learning is an important means of artificial intelligence, and ECG classification has received extensive attention in the field of data mining. Dilated causal convolution can handle long-term dependencies with exponentially large receptive fields without computational explosion. Transformer is a neural network that improves model parallelism through an attention mechanism, which breaks the limitation that recurrent neural networks cannot be parallelized, and has powerful feature extraction capabilities. We innovatively propose a novel Transformer neural network based on cutting multi-channel feature map for ECG classification. After the raw univariate ECG is modeled by dilated causal convolutions, cut the feature map into some non-overlapping patches and encode the patch set as a sequence of tokens. Correlations between patches are obtained in parallel, and prototype learning is used to improve model performance. We conduct experiments using ECG datasets selected from the well-known UCR archives and achieve the best accuracy compared to several baselines.

articleTitle: Application of Composite Control Algorithm in Photovoltaic MPPT
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional single peak MPPT cannot track the maximum power point under complex illumination conditions, a composite algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization and sliding mode layer extremum seeking is proposed. First, the probability criterion in simulated annealing algorithm is improved and added to particle swarm optimization algorithm ; improving the change law of inertia weight ; the disturbance parameters are added to the learning factor, and then the sliding mode extremum search algorithm is used to continue to optimize the suspected optimal value obtained by the particle swarm algorithm, and finally the maximum power point is found. The simulation results show that the composite control algorithm can quickly search the maximum power point under complex illumination conditions. Compared with other algorithms, the tracking speed and tracking accuracy are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 network method for remote sensing image objects detection
abstract: Aiming at the problems of missed detection and poor detection due to variable scale and complex background of remote sensing images, this paper proposes a network to enhance residuals and attention based on YOLOv5 model, named ERA-YOLO. The framework focuses on strengthening the feature representation capability of the backbone network. First, a Res2block module is designed in conjunction with the idea of res2net network structure to enable the network to represent multi-scale features at a finer level of granularity. Then, a coordinate attention module is inserted in the improved backbone network for improving the model's power to locate targets while suppressing the interference of background information. Experiments on a number of publicly accessible datasets demonstrate that the average detection accuracy is effectively improved compared to the original YOLOv5 and existing typical target detection models.

articleTitle: 3D Hand Pose Estimation Based on Deep Learning and Ensemble Learning
abstract: A 3D hand pose estimation method is proposed based on ensemble learning for fixed hand postures. First, a data set with 3D attitude angle tags for fixed hand posture is constructed; Then, a single convolutional neural network is used to fit the hand image and the corresponding 3D attitude angle label; Finally, two different ensemble learning strategies are proposed to improve the performance of a single CNN hand pose estimation model. The experimental results verify the effectiveness and practicability of this hand pose estimation method.

articleTitle: Random Errors Compensation method of Autoregressive Adaptive Kalman Filter based on MEMS Gyroscope
abstract: For the low precision problem of MEMS gyroscopes, an adaptive Kalman filter method based on the autoregressive AR model is applied to compensate MEMS gyroscopes in time series modeling. The Allan variance analysis principle is used to obtain various random performance indicators of the gyroscope. The collected non-stationary data are preprocessed and converted into stationary, zero-mean random drift data. Then the model and parameters of the time series are selected for Autoregressive modeling using the AIC criterion. Finally, the adaptive Kalman filtering method is used to compensate for random drift data. Comparing the performance indicators before and after compensation, this method is indeed more effective than Kalman filter in suppressing the random error of gyroscope

articleTitle: Output feedback tracking control for switched nonlinear systems with unknown output function
abstract: For switched nonlinear systems with unknown parameters, unknown output uncertainties, and external disturbances, we develop an adaptive output feedback controller based on dynamic high-gain technique to track the reference signal under arbitrary switching scheme in this study. To be specific, the developed output feedback controller may ensure the boundedness of all closed-loop system signals by selecting the appropriate common Lyapunov function, while the tracking error converges to an arbitrarily tiny residual set. A numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Structural damage detection method of CFRP plate based on SSA, LPP and K-Means algorithms
abstract: The damage detection technology of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) structure is of great significance for timely and accurate detection of structural damage and to ensure the safe service of the structure. In this paper, a structural damage detection method for CFRP based on SSA, LPP and K-Means was proposed. Firstly, the Lamb wave response signal of CFRP structure was analyzed, and a damage feature extraction method based on singular spectrum analysis (SSA) and locality preserving projection (LPP) was proposed. On this basis, a damage detection method based on K-Means clustering was proposed to cluster the normal state samples. Then the clustering distance boundary of the normal state samples was obtained to realize damage detection. Finally, a simulation case was designed to verify the proposed method. The results showed that for 150 groups of test samples, the method proposed in this paper was correct. This paper provided a feasible method for structural damage detection of CFRP plate.

articleTitle: Robotic medium and thick plate welding planning based on laser vision
abstract: For the problems of positioning deviation and poor welding quality in the welding of medium and heavy plates [1] by robot [2], a robot medium and heavy plate welding system [3] based on laser vision is introduced, and a multilayer and multi-pass welding method [4] which can be used for different angles and multiple passes is proposed. The robot and computer are connected through PLC [5]. After the laser sensor [6] collects the weld information, the computer generates the welding plan through algorithm processing, and uploads the relevant information to the robot to realize the welding of the weld [7]. The results show that this method can realize the welding of multiple welds with different angles and directions, and has a good application prospect.

Author Keywords: welding of medium and heavy plates

articleTitle: A Benchmark for Multi-UAV Task Assignment of an Extended Team Orienteering Problem
abstract: A benchmark for multi-UAV task assignment is presented in order to evaluate different algorithms. An extended Team Orienteering Problem is modeled for a kind of multiUAV task assignment problem. Three intelligent algorithms, i.e., Genetic Algorithm, Ant Colony Optimization and Particle Swarm Optimization are implemented to solve the problem. A series of experiments with different settings are conducted to evaluate three algorithms. The modeled problem and the evaluation results constitute a benchmark, which can be used to evaluate other algorithms used for multi-UAV task assignment problems.

articleTitle: A Decoding Model of Upper Limb Movement Intention Based on Data Augmentation
abstract: With the aging of the population, the application of brain-computer interfaces(BCIs) in the neural decoding of upper limb motion direction is becoming more extensive. However, how to improve the recognition accuracy of neural decoding is one of the key problems given limited training samples. In this paper, we proposed a neural decoding method of upper limb motion direction based on data augmentation. We used the deep convolutional generative adversarial networks(DCGANs), which is a data augmentation algorithm to generate more data to expand the training set to improve the accuracy of the model. We completed analysis on different numbers of real training data across eight subjects. The analysis results show that after using data augmentation, the average decoding accuracy given small amounts of training samples significantly increases, showing that the DCGANs algorithm can indeed improve the accuracy of the neural decoding model, and help to improve the practical application of BCIs in decoding upper limb motion.

articleTitle: Event Trigger Mechanism-Based Robust Control for Cyber-Physical Systems under DoS Attack
abstract: In this paper, the event trigger mechanism-based robust control problem is investigated for cyber-physical systems under denial of service attacks and disturbances. The effects of DoS attacks are regarded as a type of data packet loss. An event trigger mechanism is introduced into the control scheme design to effectively compensate the packet loss data. The robust attenuation technology is composited into control scheme to reduce the impact of disterbances. Then, by modeling the cyber-physical systems under denial of service(DoS) attack as a class of bounded sequential switching system, and constructing the corresponding Lyapunov function, the stability of the system is verified and analyzed. Finally, simulation experiments are given to verify the correctness of the above theoretical results.

articleTitle: Energy-based Swing-up Control with Parameter Optimization for a Rings Gymnastic Robot
abstract: In this paper, we study a ring gymnastic robot, which is a planar robot with three links moving in the vertical plane with only the last joint activated. First, we use the energy-based strategy to study the swing-up control task of the rings gymnastic robot, and obtain the sufficient and necessary condition for non-existence of singularities in the energy-based controller. Second, we derive the invariant set approached by the closed-loop system. Third, we propose an optimization algorithm to obtain the parameters of the energy-based controller to swing up the rings gymnastic robot into a close neighbourhood of a desired equilibrium point. Fourth, we check on the feasibility of the devised controller and parameter optimization algorithm through simulation.

articleTitle: Predefined-time control for robotic manipulators based on fully actuated system approaches*
abstract: The problem of the predefined-time velocity tracking maneuver for robotic systems is investigated in the current work. The velocity tracking error system is first established for the robotic manipulator system. Then, a predefined-time controller is developed through the fully actuated system approach for stabilizing the established error system. It is proven by the Lyapunov theorem that the velocity tracking error for robotic manipulator error systems converges into the neighbor of zero with a predefined time. Finally, by comparing it with an existing controller, some simulation examples are provided so as to illustrate the advantages of the developed predefined-time control approach.

articleTitle: Multimodal Feature Fusion Target Classification Based on Autonomous Driving
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor accuracy of existing image-based target classification and detection tasks due to the two-dimensional space limitation of vehicle camera image data, a multimodal feature fusion model based on lidar and monocular camera is proposed. Through the establishment of point cloud feature extraction branch and image feature extraction branch, 3D point cloud data are inputted into PointNet++ network to extract point cloud features, image numbers are input into ResNeXt model to extract graph features, and linear weighted fusion using logSoftmax is used to obtain multi-modal fusion output. Through testing in kitti data sets, target classification and detection is realized. Compared with the MV3D fusion-based target detection method, the fusion method improves the accuracy of target detection by 17.16% in urban scenes.

articleTitle: Retinal Vessel Segmentation Network Based on Improved U-Net
abstract: To solve the difficult segmentation problem in the division of retinal vascular due to blurred vessel contours and complex vessel peripheral details. In this article propose a double residence network DRANet. It contains an attention structure. DRANet is an improvement to the U-Net network. In case of gradient inflation and gradient vanishing due to network deepening, a double residual module is inserted in the encode and decode stages. The Double Residual Spatial Attention Structure (DRSA) is added at the bottom of the networks to capture more signatures. At the same time, DropBlock is introduced to alleviate the overfitting of the network. Besides, a channel attention block has been added to the skip link to suppress the expression of unnecessary features and produce higher accuracy. Achieved better segmentation results on the communal retinal blood vessel data sets DRIVE and CHASE_DB1.

articleTitle: Ordinal Regression - Extreme Learning Machine based Apple Grading Method
abstract: In view of the fact that the traditional apple quality grading without making full use of the ordinal class label information between apple quality grades. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of the near-infrared technical grading model, this paper applies a combination of ordinal regression and an extreme learning machine to apple grading. In this paper, Yantai Red Fuji apples were classified into three classes according to their quality and applied to the ordinal regression extreme learning machine model. Firstly, a near-infrared spectral detector is used to detect the spectral information of apples, and the spectral feature information is extracted using principal component analysis and mahalanobis distance method. Secondly, the soluble solid content of apples was detected using a sugar meter, and apples were classified into classes based on the soluble solid content values. The extracted spectral information and the rank labels of apple classification were used as sample information input, and the ordered labels of apple classification ranks were used as prediction results output. The results showed that the grading accuracy of the ordinal regression extreme learning machine model was higher than that of the traditional grading model, and the grading accuracy reached 92.5%, which provided a research basis for non-destructive testing and grading of internal quality of apples.

articleTitle: Control Variable Parameterization-based Optimization of Clinical Drug Scheduling for Cancer Chemotherapy with Daily Treatment
abstract: With the deepening of research on the combination of cancer chemotherapy and optimal control theory, the consistency between theoretical research and actual clinical treatment is becoming more and more important. Treatment cycle and administration time are two key factors in cancer chemotherapy. In order to meet clinical practice, this paper proposes an improved optimal drug scheduling model for cancer chemotherapy with a shorter treatment cycle than in previous studies. Besides, an improved optimization method of time scaling-based control variable parameterization (CVP) is applied, and the anticancer drug is administered at equal time intervals, so as to match the actual clinical treatment. The homologous simulation experiments are implemented to validate the availability of the improved model and solution method. The simulation results display that the improved model can achieve the goal closer to the actual clinical treatment, and the results are better than those of previous studies.

articleTitle: HK-FDSA based Performance Optimization Strategy for Steam Generator Level Control System of Nuclear Power Plant
abstract: A steam generator (SG) is an essential piece of equipment between a nuclear power plant's primary and secondary loop. Hence, the steam generator level control system (SGLCS) is of great significance to nuclear power plants safe and economical operation. The SGLCS is generally constructed based on PID controllers with fixed parameters. However, traditional parameters tuning methods are experience-based, cumbersome, and time-consuming. This study proposes a prior model data-driven finite difference stochastic approximation hybrid knowledge-informed model-free optimization method (HK-FDSA) to tune the controller parameters. Firstly, with the help of a rough model for the relationship between control system performance and control parameters, the HK-FDSA could estimate the rough gradient at every current iteration point. Thus, it could obtain a gradient without online experimental calculation based on the finite differencing algorithm, which reduces the gradient estimation cost during the optimization. Secondly, to reduce the gradient estimation error of the model, the iterative point data would be brought into the prior historical data, and the model would be updated dynamically. Finally, an intelligent termination control mechanism has been integrated into the method to accomplish optimization progress control. The simulation results demonstrated the effectiveness and efficiency of the HK-FDSA based method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis of Diabetic Kidney Disease Based on Heterogeneous Data
abstract: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a complication of diabetes, with high incidence rate, low prevention rate, and low cure rate. The diagnostic process for DKD is difficult and most of the screening techniques for DKD are invasive. In this paper, we try to use the non-invasive heterogeneous data consisting of fundus images and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) to develop a deep learning method to diagnose DKD. More specifically, we design an image feature module to extract the image information from fundus images while creating a biochemistry feature module to extract the information from UACR. After concatenating the two kinds of information, we propose a decision module to classify DKD or non-DKD. We apply the method to the heterogeneous dataset, where the results show that our method has 82.4% accuracy, 85.7% area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), 87.2% sensitivity, and 12.8% false negative rate (FNR). The results prove that the method we proposed helps diagnose DKD by using non-invasive heterogeneous data, such as fundus images and UACR. Besides, the ablation experiments indicate that fundus images contain much information about DKD and can be an important reference for diagnosing DKD.

articleTitle: Small defect detection on the surface of automobile differential housing based on FSSD and large receptive field
abstract: Due to the limited number of identifiable features that can be extracted, existing methods for detecting small defects on the surface of automobile differential housings have difficulty balancing detection speed and accuracy. This paper proposes a lightweight feature fusion single multibox detector with a larger receptive field (RFSSD) algorithm to improve the performance of small defect detection. Firstly, the model replaces VGG16, the backbone network of the feature fusion single shot multibox detector (FSSD) algorithm, with a lightweight MobileNet network to create a more practical feature fusion structure consisting of depthwise separable convolution. Subsequently, the improved receptive field block (RFB) module is introduced into the RFSSD model’s shallow layer of a feature pyramid structure. Finally, the size of the default box is modified for the target defect’s actual size. According to the experimental results, the mAP of the RFSSD model is 96.7 percent, up 12.4 percent from before the improvement. The detection speed of 158FPS and the model memory of 25.3MB outperform many state-of-the-art object detection models. Our model can detect various small defects of differential housings surface in real-time and accurately.

articleTitle: Distributed consensus for multiagent systems with unknown nonlinearities and unknown disturbances via continuous time-varying method
abstract: We investigate multiagent systems with unknown nonlinearities and unknown external disturbances To capture these unknowns, we design continuous distributed time-varying consensus protocols. Under designed conditions, we achieve finite time consensus.Finally, we give an example to verify the validation of the protocols.

articleTitle: Research on Dual Extreme Learning Machine Based on Residual Structure and its application to process modeling
abstract: In order to deal with the high dimensional and high complex process data, a residual structure based dual extreme learning machine model (R-DELM) is proposed. This method proposed in this paper uses dual ELM model: one ELM model is used to establish the process model, which can be viewed as a primary regression model; another one is used to compensate the first ELM model by establish residual-ELM model, which can be viewed as a secondary regression model. In the proposed method, the Kendall correlation coefficient (KCC) is firstly utilized to select the relevant process variables for soft sensor modeling, then the proposed R-DELM model is utilized to compute the key quality output. A real-world production process called Purified Terephthalic Acid (PTA) is applied to investigate the model performance of the R-DELM based soft sensor model. Compared with some other machine learning models, simulation results indicate that R-DELM has the characteristic of high modeling accuracy.

articleTitle: A Robust Motion Planning Algorithm Based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Path planning is the basis for robots to perform all kinds of intelligent tasks. In this paper, we proposed a path generation algorithm based on reinforcement learning. It first uses the A algorithm, searches for an initial trajectory, generates a series of sub-target points, and then obtains a safe and smooth trajectory based on the SAC reinforcement learning algorithm. Compared to existing trajectory generation algorithms such as DWA, it is possible to adapt to more complex scenarios because it does not need to set the loss function manually. In this paper, simulation experiments are used to prove the practicability of the algorithm. And the proposed algorithm can generate safe and continuous trajectories in real-time.

articleTitle: Event-based Fixed-time Leader-following Control of Second-order Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems
abstract: In this thesis, for second-order multi-agent systems with nonlinear kinetics, the event-triggered fixed-time consensus problem is researched. Firstly, we give the state error between agents, and design the control protocol by using the event-triggered mechanism. Under this protocol, the system can not only reach a consensus in the fixed-time, but also reduce the communication cost between agents. Then, a Lyapunov function is adopted to verify the convergence of algorithm and under the event-triggered function the Zeno-behavior will not occur. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Energy and Exergy Analysis of Parabolic Trough Concentrating Solar Power System under Multiple Operation Modes
abstract: The multivariate, strong-coupling and variable-structure characteristics of parabolic trough concentrating solar power (PTCSP) system bring challenges to its optimization and control. In view of insufficiencies of existing research, this paper analyzes the structural features and parameter relations of PTCSP under major operation modes, building system-wide energy and exergy analysis model based on mechanism modeling. Then the loss distribution of the system and the influence of input variables on operation parameters and system efficiency are discussed. Results explain the effects of coupling and switch of operation modes and indicate the major influence factors of system efficiency, providing active guidance for the operation optimization of PTCSP.

Author Keywords: parabolic trough concentrating solar power system

articleTitle: Model predictive control of event triggering in silicon single crystal growth processes
abstract: In this paper, the control issue of the semiconductor silicon monocrystalline growth process is studied through an event triggered model prediction approach. Firstly, a state-space model of silicon monocrystalline growth process is developed to describe the energy conversion and the dynamics and the geometry of the isodiametric stage silicon monocrystalline via the Czochralski method. Secondly, a small perturbation linearization is used to obtain a linear continuous model, which is translated into a linear discrete model under zero-order retainers. Finally, an event triggered model prediction controller is established to decrease the calculation of model prediction in the rolling optimization process. Based on experimental results, the event-triggered model prediction control algorithm is confirmed to be an effectively control scheme for the silicon monocrystalline growth process.

articleTitle: Deep learning assisted mat-type triboelectric nanogenerator for personnel monitoring
abstract: With the development of sensing technology and artificial intelligence, the smart system has attracted increasing attention in personnel security for the perception and acquisition of various information of personnel. However, high cost, huge computing resources,and personnel privacy concerns restrict the traditional camera-based monitoring system applied in smart buildings. Here, a triboelectric smart mat system based on deep learning (DL) for personnel status monitoring, identification, and positioning is proposed. The smart mat unit comprises the fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP) membrane and flexible conductive sponge electrodes with different filling rates. Meanwhile, the special connection of the smart mat unit leads to a higher resolution. The minimal structure smart mat system combines real-time sensory data analysis to extract gait-related information, allowing accurate and comprehensive personnel perception. Thus, this smart mat system develops a new field for researching artificial intelligence-assisted Internet of Things (AIoT) and smart buildings.

articleTitle: Study on Projectile Impact Point Prediction Based on BP Neural Network
abstract: Impact point prediction is the basis of trajectory correction and projectile hit accuracy promotion. Using the artificial neural network to predict impact points has the advantages of timely information output and avoiding error accumulation. In this paper, projectile impact point prediction is studied based on the BP neural network. Projectile flight dynamic phenomena are described through the six-degree-of-freedom rigid body trajectory equation set. The Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm is used to train the BP neural network. Projectile flight state parameters are set as network input, and the impact point position is set as network output. Horizontal components of projectile centroid acceleration are added as network input nodes, which is verified by experiments to be able to improve prediction performance effectively. The traditional method of exerting constant wind disturbance is improved, program structure simplified and data size reduced, which is verified by experiments to be able to meet the requirements of prediction accuracy. Experiments are designed to analyze the effect of data normalization on network performance, which shows that cancelling data normalization is helpful to improve prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: IK-SMOTE based data enhancement method for scene classification
abstract: In autonomous driving scenarios, the perception performance of perception cameras is one of the key factors in determining the performance and safety of autonomous driving. However, there are a variety of distractions during driving, such as plastic bags, mud and leaves. If the perception camera is occluded, the perception field of view of the perception camera will be greatly reduced, which can lead to traffic accidents. Therefore, the occlusion detection function of the perception camera is a key factor in ensuring the safety of autonomous driving. We propose a method called Inner K-means SMOTE (IK-SMOTE) to solve the problem of mismatching of occlusion scenes and normal driving scenes. This method significantly improves the performance of detecting model.

articleTitle: A Combined Method for Model Identification and Gross Error Detection Using Historical Data
abstract: For chemical process, data reconciliation is an effective technique in providing accurate and consistent value. However, the presence of gross errors (wild values) can severely bias the reconciled results. In this paper, we propose a PCA-MT (and IPCA-MT) combined method for gross error detection and data reconciliation at the same time. In this method, the principal component analysis (PCA) is used for data reconciliation and model identification at first. In the second, this approach is combined with an improved Measurement test (MT) method, proposed in order to generate gross error candidates while data rectification. Simulation results show that the method is effective especially in a model unknown problem.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Maximum Power Point Tracking based on Model Predictive Control
abstract: Among the many algorithms of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) technique, the perturb and observe (P&O) algorithm has already been utilized and studied a lot in industry due to its simple idea and easy implementation, but the traditional P&O algorithm usually sets the step size small in order not to miss the maximum power point (MPP), which will inevitably lead to long tracking time. To overcome the above drawbacks, this paper proposes an improved and elevated P&O algorithm combined with model predictive control (MPC) for wind energy conversion systems (WECS). The innovations in this paper are as follows: after the voltage reference value is calculated by the MPPT module, it is sent to the MPC module. The MPC module calculates the optimal control input, i.e., the control signal of the DC-DC booster converter circuit thyristor, to speed up the optimization searching process. In this paper, firstly, a real WECS is established, then a controller is designed, and finally the performances are tested with MATLAB/Simulink. The algorithm proposed in this paper tracks the MPP in 0.2s compared to 0.5s of the conventional P&O algorithm.

articleTitle: A Complex Heterogeneous Network-based Analysis Approach for Exploring Railway Operational Accidents
abstract: Railway operational accidents are caused by a variety of related hazards’ interactions, which can be shown in the form of a complex network. By analyzing the topological characteristics of such a network, we can understand the causes of the accidents more deeply and make effective countermeasures. In this paper, a new analysis approach to understanding railway operational accidents based on a complex heterogeneous network is proposed. Its originality is to analyze accidents through topological indicators which are more suitable for heterogeneous networks and to design the targeted analysis process based on these indicators. Besides, the causality between other hazards or accidents directly related to one hazard in the network is quantified, which can describe the causal relationship in the network more accurately. This analysis approach provides a decision-making basis for ensuring the safety of railway operations. This paper takes the British railway operational accidents as a case study. The results show that this approach can effectively determine the key factors affecting the accidents and give a feasible decision-making basis.

articleTitle: Consensus Tracking for Fractional-Order Multi-Agent Systems by Distributed Event-Triggered Control
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed event-based controller to deal with the leader-following consensus tracking problem of linear multi-agent systems with fractional-order dynamics. By designing effective distributed event-triggered mechanism, every agent determines when to send local status information to its own neighbors, to relieve the communication burden of network. Given by the impact of fractional-order dynamics, we use the fractional Lyapunov method to obtain a sufficient condition, which guarantees that each follower can keep up the designated leader. Besides, the feasibility of control strategy is guaranteed by providing a positive lower bound on the triggering interval, which excludes the Zeno behavior. Lastly, a numerical simulation is presented to validate proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Requirement Analysis and Design of a New Hyprsonic Aerodynamic Standard Model
abstract: The development status of Chinese hypersonic aerodynamic standard model was described in this paper, the current development hotspot of hypersonic vehicle was summarized. The aerodynamic layout and characteristics of hypersonic aerodynamic standard model were briefly analyzed, and its deficiencies and limitations were also analyzed. The design requirements of hypersonic aerodynamics model were put forward, which can meet the development of aircraft at present and in the future. The wind tunnel test requirements of the new hypersonic aerodynamic model were analyzed, and two types of hypersonic vehicle model designs were identified. A new supermodel was designed which can reflect the typical characteristics of hypersonic vehicle such as aerodynamic layout, flow phenomenon and basic aerodynamic force.

articleTitle: Load Probabilistic Prediction for Household PV Customers Based on EEMD-DeepAR
abstract: In recent years, the scale expansion of distributed PV, particularly household photovoltaic (PV), has created new fluctuation characteristics for load consumption. In order to study the differences between the household PV customers and the common customers, an analysis is carried out from statistical indicators such as frequency distribution with data harvested from smart meters, and an improved probabilistic forecasting method EEMD-DeepAR (deep autoregressive) is proposed to improve the performance of probabilistic forecasting by reconstructing the high and low frequency parts of the original load signal. It can be found that household PV not only significantly weakens the residential power load quantitatively but also has a significant impact on the time series’ frequency characteristics (smoothness). The results demonstrate that the EEMD-DeepAR can significantly increase the accuracy of probabilistic forecasting compared with DeepAR in the given datasets.

articleTitle: Tail-Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares Technique for Compressed Sensing
abstract: Inspired by the iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) algorithm with 1 ≤ q ≤ 2, a tail-IRLS algorithm is proposed to solve the ℓ<inf>q</inf>(1 ≤q≤ 2) minimization problem. Detailed derivation of the tail-IRLS algorithm is provided. Reweighted least square method enables ℓ<inf>q</inf>(1 ≤q≤ 2) minimization to possess some limited sparse selection capabilities. Tail-IRLS greatly enhances the sparse recovery capacity. One significant characteristic is that there is analytical solution at each iteration. Numerical simulations show the tail-IRLS algorithm is far superior to IRLS algorithm and many state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of voltage sag meters with power system topology variation considered
abstract: In order to monitor voltage sag of whole power network considering its topology variation, an optimal configuration technique of monitoring points is proposed, which can observe the whole network under the power grid topology variation. Firstly, the sag observation matrix under various short-circuit faults is constructed by using the solution of the analytical expression. Secondly, the power system topology variation is defined, and the sag observable matrix considering power system topology variation is constructed. Thirdly, the minimum number of monitoring meters is taken as the objective function. And meanwhile, the constraint condition is that each node of the whole network can be observed when considering the topology variation. Thus, the optimal allocation model of monitored meters is established. Finally, discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed for optimization model solution. The correctness and effectiveness of this method are proved by the verification of IEEE 39 bus test system.

articleTitle: Quality prediction method for electric porcelain under sample expansion
abstract: Porcelain insulators are widely used in the power industry, and with the introduction of the ’Industry 4.0’ plan and the development of smart grids, higher requirements are being placed on the production of porcelain. In the actual manufacturing process of electric porcelain, the quality of the product is not high due to the complexity of the process, and the quality data of the production process is multidimensional and multi-characteristic, while the existing data samples are not enough, which makes it more difficult to accurately predict the quality of electric porcelain. For the above problems, there is not a complete solution. To this end, this paper proposes a method for predicting the quality of electric porcelain under the condition of sample expansion, which consists of two parts, first using Auxiliary Classifier GAN(ACGAN) to expand the dataset, then using an Attention mechanism and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory(BiLSTM) method to predict the qualification rate of electric porcelain products. After comparing multiple regression methods, our proposed method performs better.

articleTitle: Data-driven Modeling based on Expert Knowledge for Transition Mode of Tilt Trirotor UAV
abstract: Focusing on the high cost and complex operation in establishing the transition mode model of tilt trirotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), combined with a fuzzy modeling method based on TSK fuzzy model. Firstly, the flight data of UAV are collected through simulation. Secondly, the membership function of TSK fuzzy model is designed according to the expert experience, and constant variable mass and moment of inertia is added to the data set of the neural network for Supervised learning and rapid convergence. Finally, the predictive control law is designed. Based on simulation platform, the off-line model is simulated under a fixed tilt curve which prove the effectiveness of the method. The experimental results show that this method can solve the flight state variables, such as attitude, altitude and speed, more quickly and accurately, and this method greatly reduces the cost of model identification.

articleTitle: Radar point cloud synchronization and simulation method under multi-condition constraints
abstract: When conducting multi-source sensor collaborative sensing simulation tests for autonomous driving, it is an important step to achieve sensor data time synchronization. In order to provide high-quality time-synchronized radar point clouds for the full-cycle sampling data of multi-source sensors, this paper takes the sensor’s sampling data nodes as the target nodes, and then proposes time alignment mechanism for continuous nodes from radar point clouds to multi-source sensor data. Taking speed and RCS as key constraints, the radar point clouds are filtered to achieve multi-objective classification. Radar point clouds are divided into four categories: traffic obubjects with velocity, background with velocity, stationary traffic objects and background. By bi-directionally offsetting the most adjacent point cloud data before and after the target node and clustering with the RCS value, the time-synchronized radar point cloud simulation data is generated. We combined the nuScenes open source database to test the authenticity and perception ability of the synchronous simulation data results. The results show that the average similarity of the generated time synchronization simulation data to the traffic subject point cloud is 71.3%, and the average of the overall point cloud similarity is 57.2%. The average generation time of a single synchronization data is about 1ms. Taking the annotation in the dataset as the perception target, the average difference between the simulated data and the real data point cloud in the annotation frame is -0.087, and the two have a high similarity in perception ability. Through radar time synchronization data simulation, radar data assistance can be provided to sensor sampling nodes of the full perception cycle to strengthen the meaning of autonomous driving perception data.

articleTitle: The Challenge of Environment Perception System for Mobile Robot Based on Comparison Between Wheeled and Legged Robot
abstract: Mobile robots can be divided into wheeled robots and legged robots. Wheeled robots have strong stability and low complexity, whereas legged robots have strong adaptability to terrain, both of them are the focus in the field of robotics research at present. With the deepening of research on mobile robots, the research focus has gradually shifted from mechanical structure design to improving the robot’s adaptability to the external environment, that is, the ability to autonomously perceive and interact with the external environment. The perception of the external environment relies on sensors. Currently, the research on single sensor detection has been relatively mature, such as single visual SLAM and laser SLAM. However, how to fuse the information from the different sensors to improve the accuracy and stability of detection is still a research hotspot. In this paper, a fusion scheme of vision and laser SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is proposed to fuse the information of the above two sensors, and experiments are carried out on wheeled and legged robots respectively. Finally, the experimental results were compared and the possible optimization measures were proposed.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Slurry Transportation Process with a Standby Pump
abstract: The stability and reliability of a slurry transportation sytem with a standby pump are studied in this note. The system is considered as a repairable system with variable repair rate. The system operator is proved to be an infinitesimal generator of a C<inf>0</inf> semigroup by cofinal theory. So the existence and uniqueness of the system solution are guaranteed. Moreover, based on resolvent positive operator and perturbation theory, exponential stability of the system is proved, which is a major contribution of this paper. Then the transient performance of instantaneous availability is investigated by numerical simulation. The results show that instantaneous availability is always greater than the steady-state availability.

articleTitle: Non-singular Fuzzy Time-varying Global Sliding Mode Control of Robotic Manipulators*
abstract: In this paper, a non-singular fuzzy time-varying global sliding mode controller is designed for a manipulator in the presence of model uncertainties and external disturbances, which enables the system to converge rapidly and reduce the torque. A time-varying sliding mode based on fuzzy control is proposed to adjust the sliding mode parameters adaptively, and a global sliding mode guarantees the whole-process robustness. The control law is obtained by designing the reaching law of the sliding mode variable, and stability is proven based on the Lyapunov stability theorem. Simulation demonstrates the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Robot Autonomous Following System based on ROS
abstract: We constructed an autonomous pedestrian target following system based on the ROS (Robot Operating System) platform, including building a mobile robot simulation environment, deep image processing, and differential motion control. And we proposed a deep learning-based re-detection tracking method for pedestrian target tracking, based on loading the YOLOv3-Tiny model and screening the target frame with the highest DIoU value to re-initialize KCF and update the target frame when the KCF algorithm fails to track. We tested the accuracy of the tracking algorithm and the feasibility of implementing it on a mobile robot experimentally. Finally, we designed a pedestrian following an experimental scenario and compared the angular and linear velocity values of the robot at different distances, which demonstrated the stability of the autonomous pedestrian following.

articleTitle: The Structural Features and Hot Spots of Electromagnetic Protection Research
abstract: Electromagnetic protection is widely applied in various consumer, automobile, communication and other electronic fields. How to carry out effective protection against electromagnetic radiation pollution has become an important issue. In this study, we analyze the structural features and hot spots of the related studies in electromagnetic protection based on bibliometric analysis method. We analyze the various characteristics of electromagnetic protection research such as annual publication volume, prolific authors, and cooperation network of prolific authors. Furthermore, we analyzed the research hotspots in electromagnetic protection by using the keyword co-occurrence and keywords clustering maps. Finally, we present the research conclusions and future research trends.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control Strategy For PMSM Based on Improved Reaching Law
abstract: The sliding mode control method with double power exponential reaching law is proposed for the unstable factors such as chattering vibration and overshoot in the sliding mode control of permanent magnet synchronous motor. The method combines the advantages of the traditional reaching law, which enables the motor to approach the sliding mold surface quickly and smoothly from the initial state, and realizes the speed tracking. And the continuous function is chosen to instead of the sign function, which suppresses the chattering phenomenon of the sliding mode control. Comparing the designed new reaching law with the traditional reaching law in simulink, it can be clearly seen that the time from the system movement to the sliding surface is significantly shortened. And at the same time, in the case of uncertain disturbance, the motor can adjust the motion state faster, indicating that the new reaching law has better stability and tracking performance than the traditional reaching law.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Feature Combination for Basic Taste Sensation Recognition Based on Facial Electromyography
abstract: Taste sensation recognition is valuable for developing virtual taste and the early diagnosis of taste system disorders. Electromyography (EMG) can characterize the information of taste sensation and have the advantages of a high signal-to-noise ratio and easy acquisition. This paper presents feature extraction and feature combination methods for taste sensation knowledge based on facial EMG. The time domain features, frequency domain features, time-frequency domain features, and entropy features are extracted as individual feature sets after data pre-processing. Combinations of different features are performed to acquire multivariate feature representations. Machine learning methods are used to predict taste sensation categories. The combination of the frequency domain, time-frequency domain, and entropy features as feature set and Random Forest method as classifier obtain the highest recognition accuracy. The results provide a reference for feature extraction and selection for basic taste sensation recognition.

articleTitle: A DCGAN image generation algorithm based on AE feature extraction
