abstract: Current image generation algorithms have problems such as excessive noise in the generated images, poor image clarity and slow convergence of the generation network. To address the limitations of traditional image generation methods, we propose an image generation algorithm by combining an autoencoder (AE) and a deep convolutional generative adversarial network (DCGAN).The method first uses the feature representation capability of the AE to encode the training images, with the aim of compressing and downscaling the image to obtain an efficient data feature representation of the image. This has significantly less dimension than the original image and carries important features of the original image. This feature representation is then combined with random noise and used as the input to the DCGAN network after data processing. In the recognition phase, the network is continuously adjusted to optimize the model by using gradient descent and receives feedback from the discriminator. Experiments show that the network can generate images with better results to the extent that the human eye cannot separate them from the real data. The advantages of the proposed method are highlighted by comparing it with traditional generative networks.

articleTitle: An anti-jamming ship positioning method based on beam adjustment
abstract: In this paper, based on the surveying and positioning system based on laser scanning network, the positioning error characteristics of the system in different construction stages are studied in depth according to the requirements of the surveying and positioning task of ship construction in complex interference environment, and the coordinate measurement methods suitable for different construction stages are proposed. A series of key technologies, such as integrated rapid calibration method, anti-random vibration interference positioning method and anti-ship rocking interference positioning method, are broken through to achieve high-efficiency and high-precision positioning under the interference of complex environment.

articleTitle: Study on Regional Traffic Sub-Area Division Based on Improved Louvain Algorithm and Correlation Degree
abstract: Aiming at the sub-area division problem of complex traffic network, with the goal of optimizing coordination and control, this paper proposes a sub-area dynamic division method of an improved Louvain algorithm based on an improved correlation degree model. Firstly, by introducing the traffic flow dispersion coefficient and the periodic coefficient of adjacent intersections, optimizes the traditional Whitson model. Comprehensively considering the influence factors such as road properties and saturated traffic flow density, this paper proposes a model of improved correlation degree. Secondly, uses the size of the module degree as the criterion, this paper improves the Louvain algorithm, make it is able to dynamically divide the sub-areas of the regional road network in different time periods more effectively. This study selects an actual regional road network for the simulation experiment, the results of the comparison experiment and the verification experiment are show that the proposed improved division method can better combine the traffic flow characteristics, and realize a more reasonable sub-area dynamic division for the regional road network.

articleTitle: Self-supervised Lightweight Line Segment Detector and Descriptor
abstract: Image line segment features can be used as a complement to points for geometric computer vision tasks. Previous deep learning-based line segment feature extraction is difficult to perform real-time inference in environments with limited computational resources due to the huge model size and computational cost problems. In this paper, we introduce the joint detection and description of line segments using lightweight networks in resource-constrained environments. We use a lightweight backbone as an encoder and design a top-down architecture to fuse multi-layer features, which is split into three branches for different tasks. Moreover, thanks to the self-supervised training scheme, our model can be trained on dataset without ground-truth line segments. In the experiments, our approach achieves competitive performance with the fastest model inference speed.

articleTitle: Hi-Speed Visual Servo Docking for Multicopter UAV based on Velocity Control Mode
abstract: This paper focuses on airborne recovery control of multicopter systems. System architecture and a new control strategy based on the velocity control mode are presented for the multicopter. This control method outputs the velocity control signal directly and does not necessitate re-tuning the inner loop controller. The multicopter tilt motion is also considered in the controller design. RTK GPS works together with an onboard RGB-D camera for accurate docking operations. Both simulation and field test results are presented to validate this method.

articleTitle: Robust Point Set Registration Based on Gaussian Mixture Clustering Method
abstract: Point set registration, which aims to seek correspondence between multiple point sets, is an important and key technique in image processing and point cloud processing. However, the current point set registration algorithms still have many shortcomings, such as the sensitivity to the initial position and high computation load. In this paper, a novel method is proposed to deal with this problem, called RPR-GMC. Different from the traditional point-to-point correspondence, the proposed algorithm uses the Gaussian mixture clustering method, and fits the Gaussian mixture probability distributions to the data point set through the maximum likelihood. The proposed algorithm improves the sensitivity to initial position and reduces the time complexity. Compare with current the most advanced methods, RPR-GMC shows better accuracy and lower computation load, especially in large-scale data.

articleTitle: Research on Blood Glucose Regulation of Type I Diabetes Based on Adaptive RBF Network
abstract: A backstepping control algorithm based on an adaptive RBF neural network is proposed for the glucose regulation problem in type I diabetes. Firstly, the complex mechanism of glucose-insulin action in human body is described based on Bergman minimum model; secondly, the RBF neural network are used to approximate the nonlinear functions in Bergman’s mini-mum model, then the adaptive rate of the proposed algorithm is derived and the controller is designed based on the backstepping method to ensure the stability and convergence of the whole system; finally, the validation are performed by MATLAB and compared with the results of blood glucose control in recent years. The final results show that the controller has the advantages of fast convergence, insensitivity to external interference and small control quantity.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent diagnosis system for SBLOCA in nuclear power plant
abstract: The small break loss of coolant accident (SBLOCA) is one of high frequency incident types in Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), which becomes the focus of research in recent years. The SBLOCA have not only caused primary loop pressure drops, but also produce heat damage of fuel element as the reactor core exposed for a long time at high pressure. The severity of SBLOCA varies between break size, break location and initial state, so how to diagnose accident types accurately and quickly has received tremendous attention, therefore, this paper design and implement an intelligent diagnostic system for SBLOCA. The accident data sets are collected to create parameters database firstly, then implement dignosis modeling based on SVM by Matlab, and then the process are integrate to B/S prototype by Django with a nicer interactive interface.

articleTitle: Efficient object detection of non-perishable in smart garbage sorting booths using the Efficient-Net model
abstract: For object detection in garbage sorting applications, the YOLOv4 model have been employed in the detection of abnormal objects during waste sorting. YOLO models have been proven as an effective solution with stable performance and accuracy. In the deployment, YOLO models usually consume considerable computational resources of GPU, which limit wide application of YOLO-based monitoring system. In addition, mobile terminals such as smart cameras have limited computing resources, and conventional AI models face difficulty in deployment on mobile terminals. In this case, it is of high practical significance and application value to carry out the research on the lightweight of the recognition model. The key point to realize the lightweight of the object recognition model without loss of recognition accuracy. This study designs and implements a lightweight object detection model based on the EfficientNet architecture, which can identify non-organic wastes in the perishable buckets of intelligent garbage sorting booths, thus performing monitoring of residents’ inappropriate garbage delivery behavior.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Grid-connected Optimal Operation of Wind-Solar-Storage Microgrid Considering Multi-objective Programming
abstract: In view of the current policy of energy conservation and emission reduction and "Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality" goals in China, at the same time, improving the economy of wind-solar-storage microgrid, a multi-objective programming model for the operation economy, environmental protection and energy discard rate of distributed grid-connected operation of wind-solar-storage microgrid is proposed. Model using short-term scheduling to build long-term operation. Using NSGA-II algorithm to optimize and solve the example, and pareto optimal solution set using TOPSIS analysis method combined with weight for decision. The final optimization results show that focusing on economic can reduce the energy discard rate to 0.11 % at most but increase carbon emissions, focusing on environmental protection can reduce carbon emissions but increase costs. The established programming model can reliably plan and optimize the capacity configuration for the actual operation of the wind-solar-storage microgrid.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Integral Sliding Mode Tracking Control of Aero-Engines Based on LPV Models
abstract: A tracking control problem of LPV aero-engine models by designing an event-triggered integral sliding mode controller in which a time-varying triggering threshold is used to provide a flexible control scheme is studied. The event-triggered mechanism(ETM) is designed to eliminate the Zeno behavior, which proves the feasibility of the mechanism. Since the controller is not updated at each sampling point, and the data is only transmitted at the time of event triggering, the event triggering reduces the control cost. By applying the designed controller, the ultimate boundedness of the error system can be guaranteed. The tracking performance is verified by applying the designed controller to an aero-engine model.

articleTitle: Curved Text Detection Based on Graph Convolution Context Enhancement
abstract: Text detection in industrial scenarios faces a major challenge: how to design smaller models while maintaining high detection accuracy. We propose a curved text detection model based on graph convolution context enhancement. By using the lightweight backbone MobileNetV2 to reduce the parameter count, and using the graph convolution context module to enhance context modeling ability. The target scene of this paper is the detection of painting characters on steel coils in the production process. Experiments on the Total-Text and the steel coil painting characters dataset show that the proposed method can maintain the optimal detection results with fewer parameters. Graph convolution context module makes the F-measure of this model on the Total-Text test set optimal among the methods based on lightweight networks such as ResNet18 and smaller networks. On the steel coil painting characters dataset, the F-measure of our method is also ahead of PAN and PSENet, and achieves real-time performance.

articleTitle: A new method for monitoring the state of drivers-occupant based on infrared 3D camera
abstract: In the field of transportation, such as aircraft and automobiles, certain states of the driver and occupants are important factors for safe driving. Monitoring the state, movement and behavior of pilots, car drivers and occupants can greatly reduce the occurrence of accidents. This study proposes a new method of driver-occupant state monitoring based on infrared 3D camera and deep learning to achieve dangerous state monitoring of drivers and occupants, mainly including multi-parameter fusion of driver multi-degree fatigue detection, MobileNetV1-based driver distraction detection, and YOLOv3-based in-vehicle driver-occupant prohibited behavior detection, considering both driver and occupant states. Experiments show that the driver-occupant state monitoring system can effectively identify all three hazardous states and has high environmental robustness, with detection accuracy of 92.18% in daytime and 88.68% in nighttime.

articleTitle: Value-Decomposition Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: We explore the policy-based approach for the newly well-liked centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) mechanism’s multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) job. Multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) achieved optimal effect in multiple multi-agent cooperative tasks. However, it performs poorly in more complex multi-agent cooperative tasks because it does not solve the problem of credit assignment. To deal with this issue, we combine the method of value decomposition in value-based reinforcement learning with policy-based MAPPO, and propose a new actor-critic algorithm, namely value-decomposition multi-agent proximal policy optimization (VDPPO). VDPPO uses value decomposition to provide different rewards for agents to distinguish their contributions and train the policy network using the advantage function. To determine the effectiveness of our algorithm, we modify the multi-agent particle environments (MPE) and carry out experiments on it. The experimental findings demonstrate that our suggested method is more advantageous compared to several baseline algorithms and is suitable for more complex multi-agent cooperative tasks.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-Objective Real-Time Optimal Scheduling of Residential Energy Considering the Investment Benefit of Light Storag
abstract: Due to the advantages of new energy systems such as wind and light , many domestic and foreign residential users choose to establish hybrid energy systems independently. However, after the development of hybrid energy, how to optimize the day ahead predictive power scheduling of hybrid energy system to meet the requirements of reducing the system operation cost, lowering the light rejection rate, and improving the economic benefits of users remains to be studied and solved. Therefore, this paper proposes a day ahead predictive power scheduling strategy for household energy systems by using ACPSO algorithm. Firstly, establish a photovoltaic power generation prediction model. The investment cost and kilowatt hour cost model of optical storage system are both established at the same time. Secondly, the algorithm is designed to optimize the power scheduling of household energy management system. Finally, the simulation optimization results are summarized and analyzed. The results show that the optimized energy management system can better reduce the energy cost and improve the economic benefits of the family when considering the investment cost and kilowatt hour cost of the optical storage system.

articleTitle: Output feedback for nonlinear stochastic systems with uncertain terms and arbitrary switching
abstract: In this paper, the control issue under the uncertainties and the unknown switching law for a family of stochastic systems with utilizing output feedback design. Firstly, conversion of coordinates is adopted to handle the time-varying control gains. Secondly, in virtue of the conversion, we design a robust observer to address unknown switching law and uncertain terms. Then, by using the observer state and constructing a common Lyapunov function, an output feedback design method is obtained. With using the designed controller, the trajectory of the closed-loop system is bounded in probability.

articleTitle: Optimized control strategy for concentrate copper grade in copper flotation process based on data mining and NSGA-II
abstract: The optimized strategy for the copper flotation industrial process is studied in this paper, a key constituent in the mineral processing concentrator plant. To predict the concentrate copper grade accurately in the copper flotation industrial process, a nonlinear compensation strategy is adopted to eliminate the characteristics of nonlinear, strong coupling and time-delay that the copper flotation process can be approximated as a linear process. To discover valuable operational experience and rules, it could be meaningful to apply data mining to the data collected from field data of flotation industry. Moreover, knowledge based non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (KNSGA-II) is proposed that it is more efficient when incorporating mining knowledge. The proposed method is considered desirable through the copper flotation industrial process.

articleTitle: Rotor Position Detection of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors based on Improved High-Frequency Signal Injection
abstract: PMSMS with its advantages of succinct architecture, strong load capacity and fast dynamic response, are widely used in household appliances, rail transportation. This paper proposes the sensorless control system of SPMSM based on improved HF signal injection method. Chebyshev filter is for extracting the rotor position instead of Butterworth filter used in traditional method. The experimental results show that the use of the Chebyshev filters improve the estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research And Application Of Thermal Power Generation Remote Monitoring And Diagnosis Based On Big Data
abstract: The generic thermal power unit system has the characteristics of large-scale and wide fluctuation parameters and the data is highly nonlinear. The development of big data technology has brought new opportunities for thermal power generation. This paper based on the running characteristics of thermal power unit briefly introduced the fault diagnosis criteria and diagnosis process on the basis of fault diagnosis research both in China and abroad. And then it raises a remote monitoring diagnosis platform based on the technology of data mining. Big data of remote diagnosis on thermal power unit is not only an important thermal power intelligent measure and also a means to promote the development of power industry. This technology reform will drive for coal-fired power plants.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Management Software Based on New Platelet Analyzer
abstract: The new platelet analyzer adopts the master-slave structure between the management machine and the control machine. The master-slave machine transmits commands and data through the communication interface. Management computer software is divided into four layers based on hierarchical architecture. This paper mainly introduces the design and implementation of important modules of service layer in detail. The detection and control module adopts finite state machine asynchronous method to realize reliable and stable detection process. In the data management module, cold and hot database migration strategy is added to realize the normal performance of software in the process of reasonable data migration. The precision control module realizes two modules of calibration and quality control to ensure the accuracy of data.

articleTitle: Design of Privacy Mechanism for Cyber Physical Systems: A Nash Q-learning Approach
abstract: This paper studies the problem of designing optimal privacy mechanism with less energy cost. The eavesdropper and the defender with limited resources should choose which channel to eavesdrop and defend, respectively. A zero-sum stochastic game framework is used to model the interaction between the two players and the game is solved through the Nash Q-learning approach. A numerical example is given to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Acquisition Method of Container Lock Pin Model Based on Point Cloud Data
abstract: In order to improve the automation degree and container loading and unloading efficiency of quayside container cranes, an automatic container lock pin unloading method based on 3D point cloud data processing -was proposed. The target object is scanned by the line laser sensor to obtain the point cloud structure, and the optimized filtering algorithm is used to denoise the point cloud data. The actual test data shows that the algorithm can analyze the key point coordinates of the locking point cloud in about 2s, and the key point coordinates of the locking point cloud can be analyzed in about 1.5s. The center coordinates of the keyhole at the bottom of the container are analyzed left and right, and the accuracy of the analysis is 98%. It is proved that the scheme has certain advancedness and practicability, and provides ideas for the specific implementation of the fully automated quayside container crane.

articleTitle: Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Crack Identification for Building Wall
abstract: Aim at the problem of low detection accuracy caused by irregular crack shape and complex background in wall crack detection scene, an improved particle swarm optimization image segmentation algorithm is proposed to identify the crack images. In the first place, the threshold segmentation problem is solved by using improved dynamic inertia weight and mean position update method. At the same time, Otsu algorithm is combined with filtering and morphological processing in our new algorithm. Experimental results show the algorithm proposed in this paper has well effect on the detection of wall cracks that compared with genetic algorithm and the other two particle swarm optimization algorithms. Not only that, but the experiment also shows the proposed approach has well segmentation results for other images.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Sliding Mode Guidance Law with All-Aspect Attack Capability
abstract: In this paper, a three-dimensional sliding mode guidance law is proposed, which can complete the all-aspect attack against the target. The proposed guidance law is effective for any initial lead angle. First, the three-dimensional mass-point dynamics of the missile and the target are established, the dynamic of the line-of-sight(LOS) angles is derived and its decoupled form can be obtained by the ideas of compensation. Then, we design a sliding mode impact-angle-control guidance law, its extension for large lead angle are investigated. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted in different scenarios to validate the performance of the proposed guidance law.

articleTitle: Co-design of Dual-side Event-Triggered Dynamic Output Feedback for Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: We investigate the issue of a co-design event-based scheme and dynamic output controller for the H<inf>∞</inf>-stabilization of cyber-physical systems with network delays and packet loss. In particular, we are interested in the way to transmit information in dual-side transmissions, i.e., measurement and control channels, which have their own dynamic event-triggered sampling rules to construct dual-side mechanisms. The co-design conditions are boiled down to a class of bilinear matrix inequality problems, using a successive convex optimization method to overcome the non-convex problem and obtain the design parameters simulta-neously, which can get the desired control performance while reducing the data transmission stress. Finally, the validity of the proposed methodology is illustrated by a numerical case.

articleTitle: A Practical Contouring Control Strategy Based on Accelerated Iterative Contouring Error Estimation
abstract: Aiming at the problem of improving the contouring control performance of the multi-axis system when performing periodic extreme contouring machining tasks such as high-speed and large-curvature contour, this paper proposes a contouring control strategy based on accelerated Newton iterative contouring error estimation algorithm (AccNewton-ILC-NTSMC). Firstly, a non-singular terminal sliding mode controller (NTSMC) is designed as a single-axis feedback controller to reduce the contouring error as much as possible. Then, an accelerated Newton iterative (AccNewton) algorithm with fourth-order convergence rate is designed to estimate the contouring error of the multi-axis system, and its convergence is proved theoretically, which is faster than the general iterative search method. Finally, an iterative learning controller (ILC) based on the estimated contouring error is designed as a contouring controller to achieve high-precision contouring control, and its stability is proved theoretically, which is more easier to implement than the conventional contouring control strategy. In this paper, comparative experiments are designed and carried out on a dual-axis linear motor platform to verify the proposed contouring control strategy. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed contouring strategy greatly improves the performance of contouring control compared with traditional strategy, especially when performing extreme machining curves. Moreover, the proposed AccNewton algorithm is faster, which makes the Accnewton-ILC-NTSMC strategy more suitable for multi-axis systems with high control frequency.

articleTitle: A Gait Generator for Guiding Knee Joint Motion During Overground with a Exoskeleton Robot
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the lower limb exoskeleton robot technology has been further developed. However, due to the complexity of the perception system and the uniqueness of human gait patterns, it is difficult for the exoskeleton to achieve good coordination with the wearer, which is challenging for the wide application of exoskeleton robots. We develop a neural network model based on inertial sensor data to estimate gait trajectories in real time. First, using the Butterworth filter to remove high-frequency noise from the inertial signal. Then, the designed network model is applied to establish the nonlinear mapping between the motion features and the motion trajectory of the knee joint. Experimental results show that it can adapt to dynamic speeds from 0.8 to 2.4 km/h. The model’s predicted gait patterns closely matched the subjects’ actual joint trajectories, with a Pearson correlation coefficient as high as 0.963. Compared with the LSTM method, the threshold absolute deviation and mean absolute deviation are reduced by 73.41% and 63.45%, respectively. Our study validates the feasibility of using a deep learning model based on IMU sensor data to accurately predict the wearer’s gait trajectory and improve the wearable comfort of the powered lower limb exoskeleton robot.

articleTitle: Accelerated Spark Streaming based on FPGA
abstract: Most of the big data computing frameworks run on the CPU. For compute-intensive tasks, CPU has high latency and cannot meet the real-time demand. Therefore, adopting hardware accelerators to improve the performance of big data computing framework has attracted a lot of attention. This paper proposes to accelerate Spark Streaming system based on FPGA (ASSF), uses PCIe technology and the OpenCL standard of heterogeneous systems to achieve lightweight integration of the system, optimizes the data transmission process through pointer mapping and batch transmission, and optimizes OpenCL programming framework and kernel functions to enhance the parallelism of the FPGA. Finally, the experimental results demonstrate that in the case of matrix multiplication, the delay is greatly reduced, the throughput is improved, and the CPU occupancy rate is reduced. Therefore, the method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the overall performance of Spark Streaming system, and has strong generality.

articleTitle: A Feature Extraction Method Based on Two-branch Sparsity and Manifold Regularized Temporal Convolutional Network for Chiller Fault Diagnosis
abstract: Fault diagnosis of chiller is of great significance for saving energy and maintaining indoor comfort. Deep neural network (DNN) has been extensively studied for fault diagnosis of chiller due to the excellent feature extraction ability from fault data. However, the neglect of redundancy among the fault features of chiller degrades performances of these DNN in fault diagnosis of chiller. In this paper, a two-branch sparsity and manifold regularized temporal convolutional neural network (TBSMRTCN) is used for fault diagnosis of chiller. Firstly, a two-branch architecture is applied to TBSMRTCN to improve the result of fault diagnosis. Secondly, a sparsity regularization method is applied to the TBSMRTCN that it ensures TBSMRTCN to filter out some features to reduce the redundancy of extracted fault features. Finally, a manifold regularization method is applied to the TBSMRTCN, which enhances the generalization performance of TBSMRTCN. According to the dataset of American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers (ASHRAE), the results show that the feature extraction method proposed in this paper improve the fault diagnosis rate (FDR) of chiller. The overall fault diagnosis rate of TBSMRTCN reaches 97%.

articleTitle: Optimization of trains dynamic wagon-flow allocation based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Currently, most of the wagon-flow allocation optimization processes are based on constant break-up time and marshalling time. Consequently, it is difficult to implement in practice. According to the field trains operation data, the operation time is fitted by linear regression with the number of operation hooks. Taking the total dwell time of trains at stations as the objective function. Comprehensively considering trains break-up time, marshalling time and continuous wagon-flow, a dynamic wagon-flow allocation optimization model is established. The simulation results show that using the improved genetic algorithm can reduce the total dwell time of trains by 37%. Estimating the break-up time and marshalling time can reduce the total dwell time at stations by 25%.

Author Keywords: break-up time and marshalling time estimate

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Service-oriented Advanced Avionics System based on Stochastic Evolutionary Game
abstract: Service-oriented advanced avionics system(SOAAS) is a complex network system with different stakeholders. Stake-holders are irrational behavior and may take aberrant behaviors in advanced avionics system. Different behavior will lead the avionics system to different states. In order to accurately predict the development trend of SOAAS and grasp its dynamic characteristics, stochastic evolutionary game theory is applied to study and analyze SOAAS in this paper. A multi-party game model is constructed to describe the behaviours of participant, and Ito stochastic differential equation is established based on stochastic theory to break through the limitation of replicator dynamics equation. The stability problem of SOAAS is effectively analyzed, and sufficient conditions of system stability are given. Simulation results show the correct and practicable of the established game model and analysis method.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Optimal Anomaly Detection Model Selection in Power Data
abstract: Power data is complex and diverse. Different data types correspond to different power anomaly monitoring models. How to use a variety of feature combinations to automatically screen the optimal power anomaly detection model in the scenario of unsupervised power data anomaly detection is an urgent problem to be solved. First, extract the complex power data features into seven types of eigenvalues. Then, using the selection algorithm for unsupervised anomaly detection models based on the METAOD method, the optimal selection results of anomaly detection models under various power data sets are used to generate a selection database. Finally, divide the seven types of features into different combinations and use the reward principle and the corresponding abnormal detection results to combine and screen the optimal feature combination and the optimal power abnormality monitoring model for the existing data.

articleTitle: Infrared Target Detection Based on the Fusion of Mask R-CNN and Image Enhancement Network
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the problem of the infrared image detection. Aiming at the problem of the low contrast of the infrared images, an adaptive gamma transformation algorithm (AGT) is established to intelligently improve the contrast of the infrared images. Aiming at the problem of the weak edge information of the infrared images, an improved Sobel operator edge enhancement algorithm (ISOEE) is designed to enrich the edge features of the infrared images. In order to solve the problem that the traditional infrared image detection algorithm relies on expert experience, the fusion infrared images detection model AIE-Mask R-CNN based on Mask R-CNN, AGT algorithm and ISOEE algorithm is proposed. This fusion model can realize accurate and intelligent detection for the infrared images. The experimental results show that the fusion model AIE-Mask R-CNN improves the detection accuracy of the infrared images.

articleTitle: Control Process Modeling and Execution Based on ECA Rules and Process Decomposition*
abstract: The variability and uncertainty of modern industrial control make the software framework of control system pay more attention on the design and re-engineering of control process. Establishing a reasonable control process model is essential to carry out re-engineering of control process components, which can describe control-related information and relationship. In order to ensure that the model can be correctly interpreted and implemented by the control software framework, a novel control process model based on ECA rules and process decomposition is proposed. The model mainly focuses on the execution dependencies between control flow activities and proposes the concepts of sequence dependency, data dependency, trigger dependency and resource dependency. In addition, the proposed process decomposition model can effectively support the hierarchical design and management of the control process. The successful application of this model in large laser facility indicates its reliability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Gas Pressure Regulator with Temporal Convolutional Network and Fedrated Learning
abstract: Gas pressure regulators are essential equipments in gas transmission pipelines, which is indispensable for the safety in gas utilization. However, to accurately detect operation failures of gas pressure regulators, the conventional deep learning-based fault diagnosis model is not enough. This paper proposes a novel federated learning and temporal convolutional network (TCN) based model for fault diagnosis. Firstly, sensitive features are extracted from the three-dimensional signal of a gas pressure regulator using TCN. Secondly, the two-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to learn robust features and enhance the classification performance of the model using the margin loss function. Finally, to attain a reliable classification model, the privacy protection of federated learning is integrated. To conclude, the proposed fault diagnosis model works efficiently in various complex working conditions and can be used in practice.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Model of Flexible-Jointed Space Manipulator Based on Gaussian Process
abstract: Establishing an accurate dynamic model is the key to realize the high-precision motion and control of manipilator. The space manipilator is always affected by various uncertainty problems, so the dynamic model often deviates as a result. Therefore, this paper takes the floating-based flexible jointed space manipilator as the object, and carries out the research of manipilator dynamic modeling algorithm for the uncertainty problem of dynamic modeling, focusing on the analysis of the parameter-based space manipilator dynamic modeling method and the Gaussian process-based space manipilator dynamic modeling method. On this basis, proposes a semi-parametric dynamic modeling method combining the two models, and the three algorithms Simulation experiments and comparative analysis were conducted to verify the feasibility of the Gaussian process-based dynamic modeling method for solving the dynamics uncertainty problem.

articleTitle: Improved Genetic Algorithm and Its Application in Electric Distribution Network Reconfiguration
abstract: The electric distribution network can effectively reduce the network loss by network reconfiguration. In this paper, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed for the structure of distribution networks. By linking the parameters of the genetic algorithm to the overall fitness of the population, a nonlinear crossover (p<inf>c</inf>) and variation (p<inf>m</inf>) probability adaptive scheme is proposed, which can not only ensure the convergence speed of the algorithm in the early stage, but also improve the efficiency of the later stage of the search for the best solution by different designs of pc and pm. To reduce the generation of infeasible solutions, a lion group crossover strategy is proposed to accelerate the convergence speed. A loop-based decimal coding strategy is also used in the paper to simplify the distribution network structure to reduce the chromosome length. Finally, the algorithm is verified to be feasible and effective by IEEE 33-node.

articleTitle: A resource scheduling algorithm in edge computing for smart factory applications
abstract: Resource scheduling is essential to improve the efficiency of edge computing. This paper studies the resource scheduling problem for smart factory applications. Considering the task execution is constrained by the strict production process in plant field, the resource scheduling problem is formalized taking both task execution time and resource balance as the optimization objectives. Then an improved NSGA-II algorithm is proposed and deployed in Kubernetes tools. The simulation results based on the simulation microservice of sock shop factory showed that, compared with the baseline algorithms, the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the task execution time and improve the resource balance between edge nodes.

articleTitle: Task Offloading based on Deep Reinforcement Learning with LSTM for Mobile Edge Computing
abstract: Mobile devices may offload computationally intensive tasks to edge servers for processing in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC), thereby improving the quality of experience. Heuristic algorithms are feasible for MEC offloading decisions and resource allocation, but they are not suitable for high real-time MEC systems, ignoring the impact of channel dynamic changes on the computational offloading problem. In this paper, we construct a MEC system in a time-varying fading channel scenario and propose a deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on LSTM (DR-LSTM) to solve the joint optimization problem of task offloading decision and resource allocation. The DR-LSTM is combined with an order-preserving quantization algorithm to generate offloading decision, and a linear relaxation method is used to solve the resource allocation problem. Finally, it is verified through simulations that the DR-LSTM can effectively solve the task offloading and resource allocation problem under this model.

articleTitle: Consensus-based Distributed Augmented Lagrangian Method for Nonconvex Optimization with Coupled Constraints
abstract: Abstract: In this paper, we study the nonconvex optimization problems with consideration of globally coupled constraints. The constrained optimization problem is converted into an augmented Lagrangian function, and a distributed primal-dual algorithm is exploited in the context of finite-time consensus for solving such a problem. Particularly, we do not require the globally coupled constraints to be separable. Instead, we introduce some local variables for estimating the constraint violations. Under some mild assumptions in the research of nonconvex optimization, we prove the convergence of the presented algorithm to a KKT point of the problem. The numerical experiment verifies the correctness and the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Event-triggered distributed fusion estimation for multisensor multirate systems with correlated noises and fading measurements
abstract: An event-triggered (ET) distributed fusion (DF) estimator is proposed for the multirate multisensor systems with uniform observation sampling rates, correlated noises and fading measurements. In the multirate sampling scheme, the state is updated uniformly and the state update rate is the positive integer multiple of the observation sampling rates. Moreover, the measurement noises of different sensors are correlated and also correlated with the process noise at the same time step. In order to improve the network resource utilization, a variance-based ET mechanism is adopted to determine whether the local estimates are transmitted to the remote fusion center. The matrix weighted optimal DF estimation algorithms is obtained based on the proposed local estimators and cross-covariance matrices. A simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Fusion of Improved A* Algorithm and Dynamic Window Approach for Path Planning
abstract: Path planning is an important technique for mobile robots, which can effectively map out a safe path, whether in an open field or in a complex and changing environment. To address the problems of many inflection points and irregular routes in traditional path planning algorithms for mobile robot, this paper proposes a path planning approach that incorporates the improved A* algorithm and the dynamic window approach. First, the algorithm is based on the jump point search algorithm, which extends path finding by finding jump points, thus reducing unnecessary nodes and ultimately achieving the effect of shortening path finding time. Then, the generated paths are smoothed using the gradient descent method to make them smoother and more natural; finally, the improved A* algorithm and the dynamic window approach are fused. This makes the planned path smoother and the obstacle avoidance more accurate, which not only reflects the good path planning ability of the mobile robot, but also meets the practical needs of the mobile robot.

articleTitle: SiamITO: A Lightweight Siamese Network for Infrared Tiny Object Tracking
abstract: Siamese networks have developed rapidly and achieved great results in the field of object tracking. However, most Siamese-based trackers focus on tracking generic object and little research has been done on tracking infrared tiny object (ITO). ITO has very few pixels in the infrared image and lacks appearance information, which makes ITO tracking a challenging task. To track single ITO, we propose an efficient Siamese-based network, dubbed as SiamITO. SiamITO contains three mainly modules: feature extraction backbone, feature fusion module and multi-attention module. Feature extraction backbone contains several convolution layers and residual connections to ensure the effective extraction of features and retention appearance information. Feature fusion module uses multiple layers of output to integrate multi-level information. The multi-attention module computes self-attention of ego-branch and cross-attention of each-branch to learn contextual information for better distinguishing the object from background. To demonstrate the effectiveness of SiamITO, some experimental analyses have been carried out in a series of real ITO video sequences. Compared with many SOTA methods of single generic object tracking, the proposed method significantly improves tracking accuracy of ITO while maintaining high inference speed.

articleTitle: A Coherent DOA Estimation in Alpha Noise
abstract: Direction of arrival estimation (DOA) of coherent sources is one of the important research in the fields of signal processing, especially in alpha noise which do not have a probability density of closed-form expression. Combining with the Fractional low order moment (FLOM) and subspace smoothing technique (SS), a framework which applicable to Sparse methods was proposed to deal with coherent sources in alpha noise. In order to improve the performance of the estimation, the subspace fitting technique (WSF) was proposed. In order to improve the computation speed of sparse recovery algorithm, combining with unitary transformation method, a sparse recovery model is proposed. Compared with the current algorithm, the proposed algorithm has obvious advantages in root mean square error and estimation success rate.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Model via Long Short Term Memory for Voltage Sag Location in Sparsely Monitored System
abstract: Voltage sag has already been recognized as a critical power quality issue in power system. In fact, not only economic loss but also social impact has been produced due to voltage sag. And hence, voltage sag location is of great importance to taking effective measures, evaluating power quality level, dividing responsibility and constructing harmonious power supply and consumption environment. And hence, a deep learning method via Long Short Term Memory for voltage sag location in power system, which is sparsely monitored is presented. In detail, for the presented model, the input is measured voltage through limited sensors in a sparsely monitored power system, and meanwhile, the output is the detailed line in the whole network. In this study, the data is collected via Matlab software and the algorithm is conducted through TensorFlow tool. The test results through IEEE 30-bus system illustrate that the accuracy of voltage sag location can be achieved with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Integral Robust Control of Electro-hydraulic Force Servo System Based on ESO
abstract: Electro-hydraulic servo forced control system is a nonlinear control system with nonlinear compound disturbances such as unmodelled friction force and parameter uncertainty. But the traditional linear control can not meet the performance requirements of this system. Aiming at the above problems, taking the electro-hydraulic servo force control system as the research object, a nonlinear model of the electro-hydraulic servo force control is constructed, and an integral robust control method based on the extended state observer (ESO) is designed based on Lyapunov theory. Firstly, the nonlinear unknown disturbance in the system is estimated and compensated online by using the extended state observer (ESO). Secondly, based on the estimated value of the output of the extended state observer, an integral robust controller is designed, and its stability is analyzed. Finally, to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm, the proposed algorithm is simulated by using Matlab, and the results show that the algorithm has good robustness and tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: A Sliding Mode Control of the Water-Cooled PEMFC System Based on Disturbance Observer
abstract: The stability of the stack temperature in proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) system is of vital importance for its safe operation. Suppression of interference can improve the stability of temperature control, and consequently enhance the efficiency and lifetime of PEMFC. In this work, a non-linear thermal model based on the coupling of coolant temperature and fuel cell (FC) temperature is built to facilitate the control design. Then, a dual-loop integral sliding mode controller based on a reduced order extended observer (DLSMC-RESO) and a sliding mode controller based on an extended state observer (SMC-ESO) are studied to maintaining the stack temperature during disturbance dynamical changing by regulating the coolant water flow rate. The numerical simulation results show that the proposed controllers have a great anti-disturbance ability, and the DLSMC-RESO has faster response speed and smaller steady-state error than SMC-ESO.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Key Positioning Method Based on Bluetooth Low Energy
abstract: The development of Bluetooth technology and mobile communication technology makes it possible for smartphones to replace traditional car keys. In order to achieve high-precision positioning and accurate identification of smartphones in the vehicle environment, this paper adopts a location fingerprint method based on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology. In the stage of offline fingerprint database construction, a fusion filtering algorithm based on moving average and Kalman filtering is used to obtain more stable data. In the phase of location and identification, a binary K-means clustering based on the similarity of position coordinates combined with weighted K-nearest neighbor (WKNN) algorithm is proposed to locate and identify smartphones. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the recognition accuracy of smartphones by 8.8% compared with the K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm, and reduces the positioning error from 1.56m to 0.41m.

articleTitle: Optimal Setting of Cement Calciner Outlet Temperature Based on Energy Flow
abstract: Whether the adjustment of cement calciner outlet temperature setting value is timely and reasonable will affect the stability of cement raw material pre-decomposition process. In order to solve the current problem of untimely and unreasonable calciner outlet temperature regulation, this paper proposes a thermal efficiency optimization strategy based on energy flow and thermal energy transition model. Firstly, the main factor affecting the thermal efficiency is found by analyzing the energy flow of the system. Secondly, the optimization formula is established by using the thermal energy transition model. Finally, the outlet temperature of calciner is automatically set by particle swarm optimization. The simulation result shows that the optimized calciner outlet temperature is more in line with the process requirements, and effectively reduce the preheater outlet exhaust gas sensible heat and the amount of coal injection at the end of the kiln.

articleTitle: Deep Particle Swarm Optimization on Fault Power Flow Diagnosis
abstract: The particle swarm optimization (PSO) method is designed on the principle of bird flock foraging, which can be effective in constrained multi–objective optimization problems. In the classifier design, the applications of PSO make the results obtained from the training process with higher confidence. In this study, a deep PSO (DPSO) is proposed. The PSO is combined with the Bayesian classifier, and the feature learning structure is further optimized by using the gcForest algorithm to obtain the DPSO classifier. The DPSO improves the reference value of the training results and can overcome the overfitting phenomenon in the training process to a certain extent. This paper concludes by comparing the DPSO classifier, Bayesian classifier and gcForest algorithm for the identification of data on IEEE 30–Bus system fault power flow, and verifies the effectiveness of DPSO, whose judgment accuracy is improved by about 5% compared with the other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on integrated algorithm strategy of UAV intelligent image matching and target recognition and tracking
abstract: Aiming at the design problem of the integrated algorithm of autonomous location and target recognition and tracking of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) in the complex environment without satellites and unknown. In this work, we propose an integrated algorithm strategy of UAV intelligent image matching and target recognition and tracking. Based on the idea of the hybrid control system, and intelligent image matching algorithm, we combined the analysis results of the UAV target recognition and target tracking algorithm, and presented the integrated algorithm scheme of intelligent image matching and target recognition and tracking for UAV. Finally, in the aerial photography test scene of the S1000 six-rotor UAV, the superiority and feasibility of the proposed algorithm are verified. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve autonomous positioning in a complex environment and track specific targets for a long time without relying on an external navigation system.

articleTitle: High-Order Fully Actuated System Approach for Quasi-Linear Time-Delay Systems
abstract: High-order quasi-linear time-delay systems are studied through the high-order fully actuated (HOFA) system approach in this paper. Based on the high-order generalized Sylvester equation (HGSE), the uniform parametric solution is established. The proposed approach makes the closed-loop system a linear constant system with the desired eigenstructure. Finally, a example is presented to demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive robust attitude tracking control of multi-stage spacecraft with friction disturbance
abstract: To achieve the high-precision attitude stability for the multi-stage spacecraft with friction disturbances. This paper introduces a discontinuous projection-based adaptive robust control to attitude control, combined with the friction observer. Firstly, based on the modified LuGre model, the disturbance observer is designed to estimate the different nonlinear effects of the unmeasurable state. Then, apply an online parameter update algorithm to reduce the parameter uncertainty in the friction model. Finally, we have obtained the overall control structure and corresponding simulation results to verify the efficacy.

articleTitle: Process of alarm system for RF-driven negative ion source at ASIPP
abstract: A radio-frequency(RF)-driven negative ion source based neutral beam injector(NNBI) is under commissioning at Institute of Plasma Physics, Chinese Academy of Science(ASIPP). The control system of RF-driven NNBI is a distributed system based on Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System (EPICS). An alarm system, integrating key parameters of multiple subsystems has been developed for the test of production and extraction of negative ion. The design of alarm system provides an effective scheme for the construction of Comprehensive Research Facility for Fusion Technology(CRAFT) neutral beam injector system with huge subsystems. The alarm system is developed based on the Phoebus. It realizes centralized management of key parameters, real-time monitoring, fault alarm, and fault tracking. This paper introduces the alarm system architecture and development.

articleTitle: Finite-time Dynamic Event-triggered Consensus of Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems
abstract: To improve performance and increase usability, we focus on a solution to achieve dynamic event-triggered finite- time consensus for multi-agent systems under undirected graph. A distributed event-triggered algorithm with a dynamic event- triggered condition is presented to meet the above control objectives and reduce some computation overload. Unlike other static trigger schemes, this dynamic law takes on a dynamic threshold value. Only when this dynamic threshold is violated, the agent has access to new data through topology at the current moment. By choosing an appropriate Lyapunov function, we provide a rigorous proof to show that our multi-agent systems reach consistency. In addition, one counterfactual method is used to verify any possible Zeno behavior will not appear. Finally, two simulations expound the superiority of this dynamic algorithm.

articleTitle: GRU-Based Bridge Monitoring Data Reconstruction Study
abstract: After the completion of the bridge, due to the influence of external factors, the monitoring data of the bridge is finally missing, which has a negative impact on the assessment of the health status of the bridge. Therefore, a new bridge reconstruction method is proposed, which uses the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) to decompose the original bridge monitoring data sequence to obtain the IMF component, and uses the maximal information coefficient (MIC) to analyze the correlation of the IMF component, The false IMF components with weak correlation with the original sequence are eliminated, and the remaining IMF components are combined and reorganized by using the fuzzy entropy (FE) algorithm, and then the new components are linearly integrated through the GRU network to obtain the reconstruction results. After verification, the RMSE, MAE and MAPE of the new model have increased by 45.04%, 44.03% and 46.52% respectively compared with the separate GRU network. This method provides a new idea for the reconstruction of bridge monitoring data.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Agent Round-Up Task Assignment in Dynamic Environment
abstract: Aiming at the problem of multi-agent round-up task assignment in a dynamic environment, an actual-path- distance-based classification-based round-up task assignment algorithm (APDCRTA) is proposed. In the APDCRTA algorithm, the distance from the agent node to each distribution node is calculated based on the optimal path planning result and used to classify the agent node; the distance weighting method is used to calculate the new classification center for the classification result. The algorithm is used to analyze the agent nodes iterative calculation to obtain the results of the round-up task assignment. The experiment verifies the effectiveness of the APDCRTA in solving the multi-agent round-up task assignment problem.

articleTitle: Traffic Analysis of Partially Observable Bearer Network under RouteNet based GNN Model
abstract: The expansion of the bearer network and the massive growth of network traffic data make it difficult to evaluate network performance. RouteNet proposes a graph neural network (GNN) model to solve such problems and achieves good results. Due to the black-box nature of GNNs, the relationship between topology and routing is not clear. This paper proposes a linear fitting model based on Graph Representation to represent the relationship between origin-destination (OD) traffic and link traffic. Based on this model, the paper proposes a traffic analysis scheme architecture for partially observable bearer networks. The architecture can analyze critical links and important OD traffic in the network. Based on this architecture, network node aggregation can also be performed, the network scale can be reduced, and the large-scale network performance evaluation problem can be solved. Numerical tests verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method in the traffic analysis problem of the bearer network.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Convergence Control of Manipulator under time-varying Fault Constraints
abstract: With the wide application of manipulator, the working environment of the manipulator has become more and more complex. The performance of the manipulator is also constrained by parameter uncertainty, actuator fault, and output constraints, etc. However, the control target of the manipulator has higher requirements. The existing control methods have some limitations in dealing with the above problems. It is necessary to consider how to realize output constraint control when the manipulator actuator fault. Therefore, We proposed a fixed-time convergence control framework. In our structure, a new adaptive law of neural network is used to fit the time-varying faults in the actuator. Considering the convergence time, a timing control law is legislated to make the tracking error converge to a tightly closed set, and the control torque changes relatively smoothly. And the barrier Lyapunov function is introduced to guarantee the boundedness of error which is output constraint. Besides, a simulation has done to verify the proposed framework, which has showed the effectiveness of the timing control method.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for IoT Payments Based on BeiDou Free-flow Service Platform
abstract: BeiDou navigation system is considered to be one of the most promising technologies in the era of digital economy, which can provide high precision positioning, navigation and timing services for drivers. Therefore, it has a great potential in combination with IoT payments to improve the traffic efficiency, but it is still in the initial stage to achieve non-stop tolling. Toward this end, in this paper, an innovative method for IoT payments is proposed based on BeiDou free-flow service platform. Firstly, the framework of IoT payments is introduced. Then IoT payments scheme is designed on the basis of the cryptography algorithms and high precision positioning data acquired by BeiDou modules. Lastly, the transactions per second (TPS) is analyzed to test the performance of online transaction. This paper is aimed at providing helpful solutions for future IoT payments in non-stop expressway tolling.

articleTitle: Sampled-Data Semi-Global Practical Tracking for Uncertain Euler-Lagrange Systems
abstract: We investigate a sampled-data tracking control for uncertain Euler-Lagrange systems in this paper. What makes our result interesting is that our system and exosystem encompass some uncertain parameters that belong to some compact domain that can be specified arbitrarily large. To handle the uncertainties in both the Euler-Lagrange systems and the exosystem, we need to resort to not only the adaptive control technique but also the internal model method. By proposing a sampled-data control law, we solve the problem with guaranteed tracking performance, that is, the tracking errors can converge exponentially, by any fast specified rate, to any small specified neighborhood of the origin.

articleTitle: Comparison of Residual Generation under Multilevel Fine Model of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: Existing methods of tiny fault diagnosis based on motor models lead to inaccurate motor models because the fractional order characteristics in the motor system are not considered. The capability and performance of tiny fault diagnosis based on models depend on the accuracy of the dynamic mathematical model of the research object, and the design of an effective state observer to generate residuals is the basis for achieving fault detection. Considering the above problems, this paper establishes a fine model of the motor (integer level, fractional order of 10<sup>−1</sup> level, and fractional order of 10<sup>−2</sup> level) and designs a corresponding multi-level observer. The resulting multilevel residual generation is compared and demonstrated by simulation.

articleTitle: Angular Speed Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Improved Fractional Order ADRC
abstract: In order to improve the response speed and anti-interference ability of permanent magnet synchronous motor, a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) control method based on fractional ADRC is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the fractional order tracking differentiator (POTD) and fractional order extended state observer (POESO) are designed by using the concept of fractional calculus. According to the response speed of POTD and the observation effect of POESO, a new fastest function and a new nonlinear function are designed respectively. Then, a fractional order auto disturbance rejection (POADRC) controller is built based on the new POTD, the new POESO and the nonlinear feedback control law, and the stability is proved. Finally, the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control of a Two-Link Flexible Manipulator Based on Three-Step Method
abstract: For the control performance of a flexible two-link manipulator is susceptible to elastic oscillation, a three-step non-linear control strategy is presented to track the desired trajectory at the end of the manipulator and reject the oscillation of the link. First, the whole manipulator is considered as two independent subsystems and the oscillation is considered as a disturbance of the system. Then, a three-step control law is deduced for the subsystem, including the steady-state-like control law, the reference dynamic feedforward control law and the error feedback control law, which constitute the general control law with the typical structure of PID and make the disturbance (oscillation) is compensated. Finally, the scheme is validated on the platform of Quanser flexible manipulator. The experimental results show that the proposed nonlinear control method has good track tracking effect and oscillation suppression performance under several different sets of reference input signals.

articleTitle: Multifocal Image Fusion Based on Pseudo-Siamese Network and Spatial Frequency
abstract: Focusing on the problem of incomplete edge information in the fusion process of partially focused images, research on multi-focus image fusion methods based on deep learning is carried out. This paper will combine the pseudo twin network with spatial frequency to strengthen the extraction of high-dimensional deep features, which can effectively enhance the edge strength of the obtained result image. In this paper, the network that extracts the deep features in the captured original image is a pseudo-Siamese network, and the original decision-making image is obtained by filtering the extracted deep features through spatial frequency. In this paper, the encoder in the SESF-Fuse model is modified to make the fusion result better in edge strength. Specifically, a pseudo-Siamese network is used as an encoder to capture deep features in captured partially focused images. At the same time, the original SE module is discarded, and the edge information integrity of the fusion result image is improved while reducing the feature parameters. From the final comparison experiment, the following conclusions can be drawn. The improved obtained image is not only better than the existing algorithm in human perception, but also better than the fusion result before improvement in terms of objective indicators.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Thermal Management of Solid Oxide Fuel Cell Stack
abstract: Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) is usually composed of the SOFC stack and peripheral auxiliary subsystems. The SOFC stack is the main part of the battery. Its temperature control, namely thermal management, is the key to the safe, long-term and efficient operation of the battery system.This paper first introduces the system architecture, then lists the general Model equation, and then defines the Control objective. According to the information, the stack is modeled in MATLAB/Simulink environment, and then the Model Predictive Control (MPC) is used to select multiple variable pairs,in order to achieve closed-loop thermal management of the SOFC stack under the output constraints, to ensure that each link of the stack in the appropriate temperature to achieve long-term, efficient operation.The simulation shows that the changes of various temperatures in the system are within a reasonable range through the demonstration of the output waveform, the average temperature in the stack is stabilized at about 1045K, and the inlet temperature of the stack is stabilized at 978K, and the outlet temperature of the stack is stabilized at 1063K, which perfectly achieves the expected goal.

articleTitle: A Lightweight 3D Object Detection Model Based on Stereo Methods
abstract: In recent years, with the development of intelligent video surveillance, robot navigating and automatic driving, 3D object detection is becoming an important field of computer vision. Most methods are based on deep neural networks and use information obtained with sensors such as LiDAR and binocular or monocular cameras. Methods based on binocular images are relatively cheap and less independent on computation device compared to point cloud data from LiDAR, and provide depth information that monocular image does not contain. In this sense, a lightweight detection approach based on stereo images has great practical significance in some scenarios with certain requirements.Based on discussion above, we study on lightweight improvements based on the latest YOLOStereo3D model, and weigh the performance of different lightweight backbones on this task. At the same time, we propose two improvements on the depth feature extraction structure, aiming to reduce the accuracy loss brought with lightweight backbone. Finally, we obtain a relatively lightweight detection model that can maintain sufficient accuracy for certain scenarios.

articleTitle: Optimized PI Control with Tracking Differentiator for Negative Pressure Cabin Control
abstract: To block the epidemics like "Corona Virus Disease 2019(COVID-19)" spreading, an effective isolation of the infected patients during the transportation is an important issue, which makes the negative pressure cabin (NPC) become a key equipment. There exist some practical NPCs in service, whose pressures are mostly controlled using the conventional PID controller with parameters regulated by engineering methods. Until now, there is no report about the model of NPC system from the authors’ best knowledge. In this paper, the model of the NPC system is reported, which is an inherent nonlinear system. Because of the nonlinear nature of the cabin pressure, the conventional PID controller cannot achieve desire performance to balance the transient and the steady state performance, even though the optimized PID parameters are chosen using the on-line optimization based on genetic algorithm. To solve such a problem, Tracking Differentiator (TD) and PI controller are combined to achieve the desire performance using the optimized parameters. The experiment results show the improvement of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Honeypot Active Defense Technology for UAV Cyber Range
abstract: The current research focuses on the physical security of UAV, while there are few studies on UAV information security. Moreover, the frequency of various security problems caused by UAV has been increasing in recent years, so research on UAV information security is urgent. In order to solve the high cost of UAV experiments, complex protocol types, and hidden security problems, we designe a UAV cyber range and analyze the attack and defense scenarios of three types of honeypot deployment. On this basis, we propose a UAV honeypot active defense strategy based on reinforcement learning. The active defense model of UAV honeypot is described of four dimensions: state, action, reward, and strategy. The simulation results show that the UAV honeypot strategy can maximize the capture of attacker data, which has important theoretical significance for the research of UAV information security.

articleTitle: Investigating Walking Characteristics of Passengers in Subway Corridors by Video Processing based on YOLOX and Deepsort Algorithm
abstract: This paper studies the walking characteristics of passengers in the transfer corridor of a subway station. First, passenger detection and tracking are performed using YOLOX and deepsort algorithms, respectively. Then, the density, distance, speed and other characteristics of passengers are calculated. Finally, on this basis, the distribution of passenger speed, the characteristics of fundamental diagram and the relationship between speed and distance are analyzed. The following main conclusions are obtained: (1) The number of passengers with medium speed is more, while the number of passengers with higher speed or lower speed is less; (2) The passenger speed decreases with the increase of the density, but when the density reaches about 3.1 p/m<sup>2</sup>, the speed will increase; (3) The passenger speed has a linear relationship with the passenger distance.

articleTitle: Enhanced ant colony algorithm with dynamic updating mechanism for mobile robot path planning
abstract: This paper is devoted 'to concerning with the path planning problem for mobile robot with dynamic updating strategy. First, the heuristic function is modified to adjust the priority of global searching efficiency and convergence speed with the aid of traditional ant colony algorithm. Then, the dynamic updating mechanism of evaporation coefficient is introduced to make the algorithm exclude the long path and accelerate the process of searching the optimal path. Finally, a simulation example is presented and simulation results are compared to evaluate the efficacy of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Subscription Freedom: Automatic Industrial Data Subscription Based on Recommendation System
abstract: In smart factory, the number of sensors and industrial applications is increasing exponentially. The data transfer relationship between sensor data and applications has also become intricate. Message queuing telemetry transport (MQTT) has become the de-facto standard in the IoT field due to its decoupling of data transfer in time and space. However, even though existing MQTT message servers have been able to reach 100 million connections, the way data is subscribed still relies entirely on manual work. Based on a recommender system, this work proposes an innovative automated industrial data subscription approach to improve the level of automation to better cope with the large-scale dynamic scenarios of smart factory data transfer. This work deploys MQTT broker to the cloud for larger datasets and computing power, and combines OPC UA semantic model to make MQTT publish/subscribe more standardized and automatic. The architecture and algorithm for auto-subscription are proposed, and the corresponding datasets are constructed and obtained on the MQTT broker. The similarity between different subscribers are mined through natural language processing (NLP) model and user-based collaborative filtering. Then the usefulness of the topics is calculated to generate the auto-subscription list. The simulation proves that this work can realize automatic industrial data subscription effectively.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Diagnosis and Predictive Maintenance System for Top Drive Equipment
abstract: The top drive equipment is a typical mechanical, electrical and hydraulic integrated equipment, which requires high technical level of maintenance. Once the top drive device fails, the whole drilling operation will not operate normally. Therefore, it is an unavoidable task for maintenance personnel to quickly and accurately diagnose the failure and find a method to eliminate it. To solve this problem, a new fault diagnosis method is proposed based on the current harmonic characteristics to diagnose the deterioration state of equipmen According to the deterioration degree, a prognotics and health management system (PHM) is designed based on the concept of predictive maintenance (PdM), which can truly prevent the failure before it occurs. The designed PHM has been applied to the top-drive device and achieved preliminary results, which lays a foundation for further research and can support the realization of predictive maintenance and health management of the top-drive equipment.

articleTitle: Correlation and Attention Mechanism based Network for Change Detection
abstract: Change detection has experienced substantial progress in computer vision. Recently, siamese structure based deep neural networks have been successfully applied for change detection problem. Yet, there still exist two obstacles for addressing this problem on bi-temporal images. 1) The compared images are collected on a moving platform like car or other robotics at different times, which leads to the generation of roughly aligned pairs. 2) There exist various type noises like disturbing noise and changing light, which easily lead to rough boundaries and large holes in real applications. Therefore, a change detection framework named dual correlation attention mechanism network (DCAMNet) is designed for this detection task in this paper. Firstly, for the first issue, correlation units are introduced into an end-to-end framework to align the paired images through feature representations. Secondly, for the season changes, noise disturbance, blurred edges problems, spatial-temporal units are designed to provide high-quality shapes and change regions. Finally, extensive experimental results on the "CDnet 2014 dataset" and "LEVIR-CD dataset" show promising performance of our introduced method.

articleTitle: Downhole robot positioning system based on UWB
abstract: In this paper, the positioning of downhole robots is studied, and the Ultra Wide Band(UWB)-based downhole robot positioning method is mainly investigated. There are two main parameters for determining the position of a downhole robot, one parameter is the moving direction of the robot, and the other parameter is the coordinates of the robot. From the study of the two parameters of coordinates and direction, the downhole robot carries a tag, adopts a round frame mechanism to occur the received signal, uses the time difference of sending and receiving information to determine the distance from the base station, and uses the regional determination strategy of DS-TWR to make judgments and determine the base station domain where the robot is located. The DS-TWR regional determination strategy has the advantages of achieving high accuracy and small error, which is useful for realizing the two-dimensional positioning system of the downhole robot The DS-TWR region determination strategy has the advantages of achieving high accuracy and low error and is a theoretical guide for the implementation of a 2D positioning system for downhole robots. Simulation and experiments show that the UWB-based approach can meet the requirement of precise positioning for downhole robots.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Strategy of Limited Electricity Based on Energy Sharing of Multi-microgrid
abstract: In the environment of limited electricity supply in distribution network, due to the limitation of its own power capacity and the uncertainty of new energy output, there will be insufficient electricity supply in microgrid, which will affect the economy and comfort of users in microgrid system. Therefore, aiming at the situation of limited electricity supply in distribution network, multi-microgrid system is taken as the research object, and the cooperative game method is adopted to realize the energy sharing of multi-microgrid system, and then the limited electricity optimal dispatching model of multi-microgrid system is constructed to realize the reasonable power distribution for different types of loads. Finally, the simulation results show that this strategy can effectively realize power sharing, reduce outage loss and improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Stabilization Control for a Rotary Inverted Pendulum with Different Types of Disturbances
