Firstly, an improved MobileNetV3 network is introduced for feature extraction. Secondly, CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) attention mechanism is integrated in the refinement stage. Therefore, human pose estimation can be carried out under the condition of reducing the model parameters and computational complexity. Under the same experimental parameters and environment configuration, the experimental results of COCO validation set show that compared with Lightweight OpenPose, MACPose reduces 16.9% in model parameters and 22.2% in computational complexity. The experimental results show that compared with Lightweight OpenPose, MACPose proposed in this paper can still achieve good results in human pose estimation with fewer model parameters and computational complexity.

articleTitle: A New Method for Feature Selection in Pattern Recognition of Statistical Process Control Chart
abstract: Statistical process control chart is an effective tool to monitor and ensure product quality. Feature selection in pattern recognition is very important. It is proposed to use the relative importance of the features generated in the random forest process to select the features of the control chart. After the extraction of all the statistical features and shape features, random forest method is used to get the order of the features according to their importance index from high to low. Then correlation coefficient is used to select features to avoid choosing related variables in order to improve the classification accuracy until the features quantity meet the specified requirements. To compare the difference between this new method with the traditional methods, different classifiers are used including support vector machine, artificial neural network, classification and regression tree, random forest etc. Also ANOVA and LSD analysis are used for significance test. Experimental results show that the new method of feature selection has higher recognition accuracy than the traditional methods. This new method is more suitable for pattern recognition of statistical process control charts.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Stabilization of Markov Jump Systems via a Probabilistic Event-Triggered Strategy
abstract: This paper investigates the finite-time stabilization of a class of Markov jump systems (MJSs). To regulate the limited network resource, a probabilistic event-triggered mechanism (PETM) is initially proposed. Based on the output of PETM, mode-dependent state feedback controllers are designed to obtain the closed-loop system (CLS). A set of novel Lyapunov functional are created to analyze the finite-time stability of the CLS. Afterward, the design algorithm is established to calculate the controller gains. Finally, simulations are provided to verify the proposed results.

articleTitle: Relative Position Controller Design for Spacecraft Formation Flying with Communication Delay
abstract: This study considers the relative position coordinated tracking control of spacecraft formation with time-varying communication delay when the desired information are available for only a subset of spacecraft. Firstly, a controller based on sliding mode is designed to track the desired position without communication delay. Secondly, a distributed observer is developed to get the estimation of the desired position and velocity by using the information with time-varying delay of neighbors. Then, based on the observer, a controller is proposed to realize the expected formation configuration. Finally, numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control law.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resistance Measurement and Contact Ablation Diagnosis System for SF6 Circuit Breaker
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of the existing dynamic resistance measurement method and data processing method, a complete set of SF6 circuit breaker dynamic resistance measurement, analysis and diagnosis of contact ablation degree system is proposed. Its advantage is that the contact ablation degree state can be obtained by dynamic resistance method without dismantling the SF6 circuit breaker arc extinguishing chamber, which provides great convenience for the contact condition maintenance of field circuit breakers. The whole system is composed of dynamic resistance test hardware and contact ablation diagnosis system. The dynamic resistance data of the circuit breaker is taken in the field to obtain the dynamic resistance-stroke curve in real time and analyze it. The contact ablation diagnosis system is optimized to further calculate the contact state diagnosis parameters. The results show that the system has good operability, the dynamic resistance image is stable and controllable, and the overall time is very short. It is suitable for the field to provide accurate information for the ablation state of the circuit breaker contact.

articleTitle: Study on ship attitude estimate algorithm based on MEMS IMU
abstract: Accurate and timely feedback of the attitude of the ship and its multi degree of freedom engineering equipment is the key to ensure the safety of the ship system. In this paper, attitude measurement method based on a low-cost MEMS (Micro Electro Mechanical System) IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) is studied. The acceleration and angular velocity of MEMS are fused by Mahony complementary filter and EKF (Extended Kalman Filter) respectively to obtain the accurate attitude estimation of IMU. An experimental platform is used to simulate the ocean disturbance, the performance of the two methods under different disturbance are discussed, and the influence of different filter parameters on the output is analyzed. The results show that both Mahony complementary filter and EKF filter have good tracking ability, and can track the motion trajectory of different frequencies through reasonable adjustment of parameters.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Sliding Mode Control of Manipulator Based on Improved Reaching Law
abstract: An improved reaching law is suggested in order to address the chattering issue and slow convergence speed in the manipulator’s sliding mode control. The proposed control method speeds up the system’s convergence and reduces chattering when used in conjunction with the nonlinear sliding mode surface. On the matlab and CoppeliaSim, the dynamic model of the six-degree-of-freedom UR5 manipulator is constructed, and the suggested control strategy is tested and validated. The finds indicates that the proposed approach can successfully quicken system convergence and lessen system chattering. Even if the system has disturbances, it can also ensure the system’s robustness while achieving quick and stable tracking.

articleTitle: Basic Taste Intensity Recognition based on sEMG and EEG Signals
abstract: In recent years, brain-computer interfaces based on sEMG and EEG have made progress in taste sensation recognition, but mainly focus on the classification of different tastes. This paper designs and carries out experiments to record the sEMG and EEG signals of different intensities of the five basic tastes stimulus: sour, sweet, bitter, salty and umami. Then time and frequency domain features are extracted for sEMG and wavelet features are extracted for EEG. Various machine learning algorithms are used to regress the intensities of each taste and compare their performance. The results show that different intensities of sour, bitter and salty are easier to be distinguished, while those of sweet and umami can hardly be distinguished. We discuss the possible physiological mechanisms behind this and it may give more researchers a reference.

articleTitle: Scaled Formation Control for Multi-Agent Systems via A Dynamic Event-Triggered Mechanism
abstract: The paper is discussing about scaled consensus control for multi-agent systems (MASs) to form into teams under a modified event-triggered (DET) scheme. Firstly, a DET strategy which is based on sampled data is put forward by presenting a dynamic auxiliary parameter (ADV). In this case, Zeno phenomenon can be avoided. Then, a distributed formation control protocol is proposed where a scalar vector and a formation function are set. By combining formation control with scaled consensus, complex multiple formation control can be achieved without imposing additional constraints on the weighting values of the topologies. The error system is designed to have time-varying network-induced delays. An improved Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) is chosen to analyze the steadiness of the error system. Finally, an example of multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) formation flying is displayed to validate the rationality of the theroems.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Classification Based on Lightweight Network and Pruning
abstract: In recent years, deep neural network has continuously improved the performance of remote sensing image classification. Though The deep neural network model is powerful, it is difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware platforms such as mobile terminal devices and embedded devices due to the large number of network parameters. In this paper, a novel lightweight network (LW-Net) model and a network pruning method are used for remote sensing image classification. This LW-Net model adopts a net block unit to obtain more characteristic graphs with less computational complexity. The proposed network pruning method uses the sparsity regularization on the influence factor in BN layer to automatically identified and pruned unimportant channels to make the model structure simpler. Experimental results demonstrate compared with traditional deep neural networks, the proposed model with the network pruning method can greatly reduce the computational complexity and model parameters with a little accuracy loss.

articleTitle: Wood Broken Defect Detection With 3D Laser Scanning
abstract: Wood broken defects, such as cracks, penetrating dead knots and wanes, will seriously weaken the strength of the wood and destroy the structral integrity of the wood. Therefore, these defects should be inspected and then cut during the production. Although vision-based detection methods have been proposed to detect wood defect regions, they can not detect the defects that change in depth. To solve this problem, this paper focuses on the defect detection by measuring depth difference through 3D laser data. First, the 3D laser data is preprocessed to remove the noise. Secondly, we construct a support profile by multiple mean filtering at the line-level. Next, the residual components are obtained by subtracting the support profile from the profile data and the defect is determined by comparing the residual components and the setting threshold. Finally, we perform merging and filtering operation to determine the final position of defects. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Quantized robust filtering of semi-Markov jump systems with random measurement data dropouts
abstract: This paper addresses the quantized robust filtering problem for a class of discrete-time semi-Markov jump systems with random measurement data dropouts. A random variable obeying the Bernoulli distribution is introduced to describe the data loss phenomenon. Considering the limited network communication, the measurement output is transmitted to the filter through a logarithmic quantizer. Based on this, a Lyapunov function is constructed that depends on both the mode and residence time. The conditions for the existence of the mode-dependent quantization filter are obtained, and the estimation error is guaranteed to be mean-square stable. The effectiveness of the proposed quantized filtering strategy is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Q-learning based traffic signal control method for an isolated intersection
abstract: Traffic signal control strategy plays an important role in determining the traffic efficiency of intersections. In order to increase the capacity of intersections, we propose an improved Q-learning based method for traffic signal control. Firstly, we define a novel reward function consisting of two parts to dynamically adjust the timing plan of an isolated intersection by utilizing the real-time traffic situation of the intersection. In the reward function, the first part is employed to reflect the change of traffic state of each lane, while the second part is essentially employed to adjust the signal timing of each phase. In addition, a vehicle position information matrix is defined to describe the traffic state of the intersection at each time step. Finally, the simulation and experimental results based on VISSIM demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Indoor Wi-Fi Fingerprint Localization Based on SDAE and MLP with Self-attention Mechanism
abstract: For received signal strength (RSS) fluctuations, multipath and data redundancy issues based on Wi-Fi fingerprinting, this paper proposes an indoor localization system (SSMLoc), which combines stacked denoising autoencoders (SDAE) and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) with self-attention mechanism (SAM). The system uses SDAE to generate a deep robust representation of RSS data, which is subsequently used to build a localized fingerprint database. A simplified SAM reassigns various weights to the internal properties of deep Wi-Fi fingerprints, allowing the MLP network to better capture the critical features of Wi-Fi fingerprints. The performance of the SSMLoc system using the public dataset UJIIndoorLoc is validated in this paper, and the experimental findings reveal that the system has great robustness and enhances positioning accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: A nested constraints based anti-disturbance collision-free formation control scheme for multi-mobile robot systems
abstract: This paper investigates distributed formation control of multi-mobile robot systems with collision avoidance. A novel nested constraints based anti-disturbance formation control scheme is established, which contains two parts. In the first part, a formation signal generator is constructed on the communication network by using proper distributed cooperative control approaches and artificial potential field-based methods, such that it "completes" the desired formation control task in its outputs. In the second part, by combining proper disturbance estimations, some nonlinear tracking controllers are designed for the robots to track the corresponding outputs of the generator asymptotically. A "nested constraint mechanism" is put forward accordingly and applied to limit the generator’s outputs and the robots’ tracking errors. In this way, the studied multi-mobile robot systems realize the formation control goal with collision avoidance. Compared with existing results, the proposed method has a better plug-and-play feature to deal with the tight encapsulations of the practical robot products, and has better convergence performances with the existence of disturbances. Some experiments are given to validate the effects of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: A Distributed Path Planning Algorithm via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Recently, Q-Learning has gained increasing attention in path planning, due to its model-free feature and adaptability to dynamic environment. However, it requires vast storage space and suffers from slow convergence speed as the scale of planning space increases. In order to solve these problems, a kind of cooperation scheme is introduced. We divide the planning space into several sections and each section is equipped with a robot. Each robot is responsible for exploring the local space and sharing a small amount of local information with its neighboring robots. Asynchronous communication is considered in algorithm design, which facilitates the information interaction between robots. Additionally, a table is designed to record the most recent action taken in each state and the corresponding next state, which is used to update the Q-table. Finally, the efficacy of the proposed algorithm is validated in a maze.

articleTitle: Engineering Design of High-speed Vehicle Attitude Control System Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control
abstract: In this paper, a high-speed vehicle attitude control system design method based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) is proposed. In view of the increasingly complex vehicle dynamics model and the problems of slow response and large steady-state error of the PID controller under high-speed and complex environmental conditions, this design method is proposed. Firstly, the attitude controller is designed by the frequency domain design method, and then the ADRC is designed on this basis. The control effect of the two control systems under wind disturbance is compared through 6-DOF dynamics simulation. The simulation results show that the ADRC has faster response, smaller overshoot and smaller steady-state error, and is more capable of reducing the influence of external disturbances on the vehicle system. Hence the ADRC has better robustness and anti-disturbance.

articleTitle: Global Autonomous Positioning Based on Celestial Polarized Light and Starlight Fusion
abstract: It is extremely important for autonomous systems positioning in global navigation satellite system (GNSS) challenged night environment. Nevertheless, nocturnal animals with remarkable visual capability have sufficient visual cues for navigation. Inspired by animals’ navigation scheme, an integrated positioning strategy of combining the moonlit polarization patterns and celestial starlight is presented, which can enhance the autonomous navigation ability of unmanned systems in the GNSS denied environment at night. First, the geometric relationship between geographical position and observed polarization-star angle is modeled. Subsequently, the positioning task can be modeled as a nonlinear optimization problem without priori knowledge of the altitude and azimuth of the celestial body. Further, based on matrix theory, a simplified solution method is derived for solving the observer’s position. Finally, the simulations are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-channel acquisition and data processing based on Labview
abstract: This proper uses USB-3202N data acquisition card as the main hardware, and uses Labview as the development software to achieve four-channel data acquisition. The system can realize multi-channel data acquisition and real-time display, storage and other functions, and at the same time for the data obtained three-dimensional map. Compared with the traditional acquisition technology, this design has simple program design and simple interface. It is applied to the well drilling ultrasonic logging Instrument (ULISSD), which can solve the problems encountered in the ultrasonic transducer at the present stage and lay a certain foundation for the upgrade of the next generation.

articleTitle: Reentry Attitude Control of Hypersonic Vehicle based on Sliding Mode Active Disturbance Rejection
abstract: Aiming at the attitude control problem of hypersonic vehicle in reentry phase, this article puts forward a control scheme based on the integration of hypersonic super-twisting sliding mode control (STSMC) and active disturbance rejection control (ADRC). Considering the uncertainty of the model and the external disturbance, a 6-dof dynamic model of hypersonic vehicle is established. Based on the linearization of model feedback, evaluate the uncertainties and disturbances by an extended observer, and a control law based on super-twisting sliding mode was designed to replace the state feedback control law in the traditional ADRC method. The control moment is distributed to each actuator by generalized inverse control allocation method. Simulation consequence proved that the Sliding Mode Active Disturbance Rejection controller (SMC-ADRC) has good attitude control ability, faster convergence and stronger anti-interference performance.

articleTitle: 3D Path Planning of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Improved Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm
abstract: Aiming at the problem of unmanned aerial vehicle’s(UAV) path planning in complex battlefield environment, this paper proposes an improved grey wolf optimization algorithm (IGWO). UAV path planning is to plan the flight path from the starting point to the target point under the conditions of ensuring the best performance and satisfying different constraints. Based on the traditional GWO algorithm, this paper proposes two improvements: adjusting the decay form of the convergence factor, and re-updating the location according to weighted sum of ϕ, φ, χ. Furthermore, under the consideration of various constraints, a 3D path planning strategy for UAV based on IGWO is constructed to obtain the UAV path with the optimal comprehensive performance. Finally, the comparative simulations with three other algorithms are carried out. The simulation result shows that IGWO can be implemented for achieving optimal UAV path planning, and IGWO outperforms the other three optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Combined calibration method for large field of view multi-camera system
abstract: In the calibration process of multi-camera system with large field of view, aiming at the problem of self occlusion in the plane calibration method and the problem of low calibration accuracy of one-dimensional calibration methods, a calibration method of multi-camera system based on the combination of plane target and one-dimensional target is proposed. Firstly, a mathematical model of multi-camera calibration is established with pin-hole model and rigid body transformation theory; the internal parameters and distortion coefficients of each camera are calibrated by two-dimensional plane target; on this basis, analyze the uncertainty of imaging error of circular feature points, cost function of random sample consensus algorithm(RANSAC) is improved. Using the camera imaging model, the essential matrix between cameras is estimated, and the initial value of camera external parameters is decomposed and determined; lastly, multiple nonlinear optimization algorithms are used to refine and obtain the camera matrix, The simulation and actual experimental results show that the multi camera system combination calibration method proposed in this paper can realize the parameter calibration of four camera measurement system, and the measurement space is 2000mm×2000mm×2000mm, the 3D reconstruction error is less than 0.15mm. Compared with the traditional calibration method, it has more accurate calibration accuracy.

articleTitle: H∞ filtering for discrete-time Markov jump systems with time delays by adaptive event-triggered scheme
abstract: This paper concentrates on the H<inf>∞</inf> filtering issue for Markov jump systems, which the controller parameter variations are considered to be happened in a random situation. Therefore, we need describe such a randomly occurring situation, mutually independent Bernoulli distributed white sequences which is mutually independent are adopted. Meanwhile, the event-triggered control scheme is proposed to preserve communication network source and preserve the system performance. By utilizing the Lyapunov function and matrix inequality, an H∞ filter design method was developed for underlying systems. Ultimately, the validity of design method are illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: Path Planning for a Greener Air Traffic Operation using RRT-based Algorithm
abstract: Due to population explosion and immoderate industrialization, the impacts of the greenhouse effect are intensifying. To reduce emissions, the administration, air traffic management (ATM) institutions, airlines, and aircraft manufactures are committed to finding a more efficient and greener air traffic operation mode. The high precision trajectory-based operation (TBO) which puts forward the requirements of capability matching and coordination between aircraft and ATM systems has great potential. In this paper we present a RRT-based algorithm for the greener flight course planning. Algorithmic structure of the RRT is firstly introduced. We then illustrate the 3D workspace, constraints of the large civil aircraft, and obstacles in the path planning task. A 3D RRT algorithm is particularly developed for the path planning mission. Experimental tests using both simulated and real weather data are performed, which justifies the effectiveness of the RRT-based path planning algorithm developed in the paper.

articleTitle: Non-Fragile H∞ Controller Design for Networked Systems Under False Data Injection Attacks and Consecutive Packet Dropouts
abstract: In this paper, the non-fragile H<inf>∞</inf> controller design problems for the networked control systems with false data injection attacks and packet losses are investigated. A non-fragile H<inf>∞</inf> controller is utilized to render system tolerant or insensitive to external disturbances or random factors. First, the controlled system is converted into a discrete-time system by discrete-time approach. Subsequently, with the stochastic analysis technology and the law of total expectation, the stability condition of the networked control system is derived. Then, the desired non-fragile H<inf>∞</inf> controller is obtained, with which the controlled system is exponentially mean-square stable with a desired H<inf>∞</inf> performance. Finally, a numerical simulation and an aircraft flight control system are exploited to confirm the validity and practicability of the designed approach.

articleTitle: Safety Helmet Monitoring System Based on Improved YOLOv5
abstract: In construction site, it is necessary to ensure that everyone wears helmet. Using object detection methods to do the supervising work is much more efficient than any other ways. First, this paper proposes a new helmet detection method based on improved YOLOv5 that can get better detection results in construction site. Second, this paper designs an automatically tracking and monitoring system to implement the real-time detection of the input. Third, this paper designs a UI interface to show all the details of the detection process. The monitoring system mainly includes the image processing module and the helmet detection module which are based on PyTorch framework and OpenCV image processing library. The dataset that we used for training and validation is SHWD.

articleTitle: Multi-resolution transformer-based point cloud completion network for intelligent manufacture
abstract: Due to the limitations of sensor technology and the material (transparency) of the scanned object, the point clouds collected by 3D scanning sensor such as 3D vision sensors will have problems such as missing point clouds and uneven distribution of data points .However, the point cloud complement technique of the past frequently failed to successfully generate the local characteristics of the point cloud due to the point cloud's general structure being refactored. Therefore ,a transformer-based multi-resolution point cloud completion network is suggested. The entire network structure adopts an encoder-decoder structure. Through multi-resolution domain feature embedding, different range of neighborhood features are fused; Then, through the transformer coding structure of adaptive spatial coding, the global features are obtained. Query object adds spatial location information to enhance the absolute spatial location features; Finally, a complete reconstructed point cloud is generated through the transformer decoding structure The experimental results show that compared with PCT, the experimental effect of this paper is improved, and evidence is provided to support the revised algorithm's efficacy.

articleTitle: Pose Detection of Grasping Targets Based on ShuffleNet v2 with Region Proposal Networks
abstract: When robots are grasping, they often face objects with uncertain poses and irregular shapes, so it is difficult to estimate the grasping pose of the robot accurately. To address this problem, this paper proposes a robot target grasping pose detection method based on deep learning. The method is able to face different target detection with more flexibility and accuracy. This method uses a network model based on ShuffleNet v2 combined with a Region Proposal Networks(RPN) to predict the graspable region of an object. In this networks, classification labels are used to output the angle of the grasping pose, and the location parameters of the grasping are predicted using a regression method. The model was trained on the Cornell dataset and achieved the accuracy of 91.12% and 91.02% on the instance detection and object detection test sets, respectively. The processing time is within 0.07s per image. The experiments show that the model has high accuracy, robustness, and stability in detecting and locating single or multiple grasped objects in images.

articleTitle: Enhanced receptive field smoke detection model embedded with attention mechanism
abstract: Smoke is an important feature of forest fire early detection. The accuracy of the existing smoke detection model is easily affected by the surrounding environment, and the sampling times of the image center and edge are uneven, which eventually leads to the unsatisfactory effect of feature extraction and low accuracy. In order to solve these problems, a SE_RFB_YOLO fire smoke target detection model is proposed which embeds channel attention mechanism based on YOLOv3 model to improve the anti-interference ability and feature extraction ability of the network; Clustering is used to obtain the a priori frame size that meets the smoke target; The feature map is connected to the RFB-s module to expand the receptive field, and the extracted features are more obvious. Compared with YOLOv3, target detection accuracy of RFBNet model is 86.4%, the recall rate is 89.7%, and the detection speed is 26 fps.The proposed target detection model can better meet the needs of the task and show better detection effect.

articleTitle: A modified-yolov5s model for defect detection of printed circuit board
abstract: Defect detection is an essential part in the preparation of printed circuit boards. In order to achieve automatic detection of PCB,a defect detection approach based on an enhanced yolov5 algorithm was developed in this study. First, replace the original loss function with Quality Focal Loss, and then a prediction layer was added for prediction. Finally, ECA attention mechanism was introduced. Through experiments and comparison, the P, R and mAP of the improved yolov5-ours were 98.7%, 98.9% and 99.4%, respectively improved by 3.2%, 3.4% and 3.7% compared with the original yolov5s.Compared with SSD, yolov3 and EfficientDet, the map of the improved model is worked on by 10.1%, 13.2% , 17.1%, separately.Experimental demonstrate the wat that this technique can detect PCB defects and has certain practicability.

articleTitle: Moving target detection of elevating fire truck based on D-vibe algorithm in vehicular environment
abstract: At present, fire trucks are widely used in various fire fighting and emergency tasks. In order to deal with different situation, fire trucks are equipped with several different rescue tools. It is very important for quickly replace tools of fire trucks for different rescue purpose. In this paper machine vision is utilized for Intelligent recognition and positioning the tools on the long mechanical arm in the process of replacing the tools when the mechanical arm moving in vehicle environment. We acquired the RGB-D image including the pixel mapping relationship between the color image and the depth image. Then filtering algorithms are used to process the depth image. A D-vibe algorithm based on depth image is proposed to get the characteristics of depth image. The spatiotemporal depth information is introduced to construct the depth model for Intelligent recognition and positioning. Experimental results show that our method can effectively eliminate the "Edge Ghost" caused by shaking video and improve the target detection effect.

articleTitle: Asynchronous fusion method of guidance information for strapdown missile swarm
abstract: This paper is concerned with an asynchronous fusion algorithm of guidance information for strapdown missile swarm. Firstly, the strapdown detection model was built by taking the body line-of-sight (BLOS) angle of the strapdown seeker into consideration; Secondly, the filtering equation and the filtering algorithm process were established; Thirdly, the asynchronous fusion algorithm based on error covariance trace minimization was derived. Compared with the non-real-time algorithm, the proposed real-time asynchronous fusion algorithm has higher estimation accuracy, which is of great significance to the design of missile guidance law.

articleTitle: Comparison of system performance optimization by using different evolutionary algorithms for wireless power transfer systems with sliding mode controller
abstract: Many control schemes have been used in wireless power transfer systems. Sliding mode control stands out for its simple implementation, fast response and so on. However, the selection of controller parameters is a significant challenge, which affects tracking time of systems, electronic switch loss, and so on. Traditional trial-and-error method not only takes time but also cannot guarantee the optimal parameters. Therefore, this paper proposed a sliding mode controller design scheme for the wireless power transfer system using four different modified evolutionary algorithms. First, the controller parameter is optimized by using four modified evolutionary algorithms. Then, the performance of these four algorithms is compared in two aspects: solution quality and convergence speed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed optimization scheme is verified by simulation that the controller obtained by using the scheme can improve the system performance.

articleTitle: Distribution network reactive power optimization considering multi flexible controlled resources
abstract: Distribution network reactive power optimization is the basis work to ensure the safety and stability operation of power system. Flexible controllable resources such as controllable load, distributed generation(DG), energy storage system(ESS) will impact the operation of reactive power optimization significantly in the new type power system. A reactive/voltage control method considering multi flexible controllable resources is proposed in this paper. A price driven demand response load flexible control strategy based on the market real-time electricity price, load response cost and user purchase cost is proposed for the load control in the reactive power optimal strategy. ESS is combined with the reactive power compensation equipment to achieve the optimal control between voltage and reactive power flow in distribution network. The simulation result in the improved IEEE 33 system shows that the proposed optimization model comprehensively considers the dynamic characteristics of flexible resources, and it can and improve the reactive power/voltage regulation ability and reduce the active power loss significantly.

articleTitle: Fault classification of proton exchange membrane fuel cell based on convolutional neural network coupled with support vector machine
abstract: The internal structure of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is complex, and the strong coupling between components leads to the difficulty of fault classification, so the fault classification of PEMFC has become an issue. For the traditional multi-classification problems, such as the traditional support vector machine (SVM) and K-Nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithms are weak for data analysis and prone to cumulative errors, so a fault classification method based on convolutional neural network (CNN) coupled with support vector machine is proposed on this basis. The CNN is capable of autonomous learning, by analyzing the data of PEMFC, extracting the data features and then learning the data features through SVM to perform fault diagnosis. By comparing the test results of the simulation, it is found that the results of the fault classification method based on CNN-SVM are better than the CNN classification method, and the fault classification accuracy using CNN-SVM has a high improvement, which has some practical application value.

articleTitle: Model-Predictive Cubature Kalman Filter for Battery Core Temperature Estimation
abstract: Battery core temperature estimation plays a key role in developing efficient thermal management systems. This paper proposes a novel model-predictive cubature Kalman filter (CKF) to obtain high accuracy temperature estimation. Considering the thermal characteristics of cylindrical battery cells, a lumped two-layer thermal model is first formulated. The model parameters are identified offline based on a high-fidelity finite element model combined with particle swarm optimization. Then, the estimation law of model error is developed by the model prediction filter, which is integrated into the CKF to enhance the estimation accuracy. Simulation tests based on two automotive driving cycles are carried out with an initial temperature of 25 °C to verify the estimation performance using model-predictive CKF. And the model- predictive CKF has more accurate core temperature estimation compared to traditional CKF and adaptive CKF.

articleTitle: An Image Recognition Method Based on Multi-Objective Evolutionary Learning for Material Quality Detection
abstract: In complex industrial production processes, it is generally difficult to detect product quality defects online. As the rapid development of computer vision, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been extensively used to solve this problem. In this paper, a multi-objective evolutionary learning method based on EfficientNet is proposed for material quality detection. Moreover, to improve the effectiveness of the model, a multi-objective differential evolution algorithm is used to optimize EfficientNet. To achieve a tradeoff between model accuracy and model complexity, a knee point mechanism is designed to obtain the model structure and hyperparameters. Steel strip surface defect datasets are used to test in computational experiments. The results verify that the proposed method has a higher precision with lower floating-point operations than other comparison methods.

articleTitle: Fractional order controller design for a class of nonlinear systems by high-order fully actuated system approach
abstract: In this paper, a fractional order controller is designed for a class of nonlinear systems by using the high-order fully actuated (HOFA) system approach. First, the original system in an affine state-space form is transformed into a HOFA system model. Second, a state-feedback controller involving the Caputo fractional derivatives is derived based on the HOFA system model. Then, in the framework of close-loop fractional order linear time invariant (LTI) systems, the gain of the fractional order controller is designed via parametric eigenstructure assignment approach. Finally, numerical simulations verify the efficiency of the designed fractional order controller.

articleTitle: An auxiliary learning network for carotid ultrasound image classification
abstract: Carotid plaque classification tasks perform an important part in preventing the occurrence of ischemic strokes. Carotid ultrasound images provide a clear picture of the location and status of plaque which helps the professional doctor in the diagnosis of carotid atherosclerosis. However, existing methods ignore the relevance of different carotid plaque tasks. To exploit the different features of carotid ultrasound images, we propose an auxiliary learning framework. The framework uses carotid plaque classification as the primary task and carotid plaque segmentation as an auxiliary task. The framework uses hard parameter sharing to learn the different features of carotid ultrasound images. The results show that the proposed method is beneficial for improving the carotid plaque classification performance.

articleTitle: A diagnostic model for gear complex faults with deficient data
abstract: As an essential unit of Large Scale NC Machine Tools, the gear faults diagnosis is especially critical. However, due to the deficient data collected from monitoring system, these complex diagnostic issues usually exposing in modern industrial is still intractable. Therefore, a diagnostic model for gear complex faults with deficient data is developed in this study, where a size-variable re-sampling measure is designed to handle the mission and challenges with scarce fault monitoring data. Secondly, a gradual anti-noise recovery scheme is formed to solve the recognition troubles with missing surveillance data. Thirdly, an improved sparse auto-encoder based diagnostic model is built to identify the running state of gear. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed diagnostic model are verified by gears complex faults tests.

articleTitle: Robot trajectory planning based on improved second-order oscillatory particle swarm algorithm
abstract: This study proposes a trajectory planning technique for robots using 3-5-3 polynomial interpolation that is based on an enhanced second-order oscillatory particle swarm algorithm with kinematic constraints like as velocity, acceleration, and jerk. A kinematic analysis of a six-axis industrial robot is carried out, and for trajectory planning, a 3-5-3 polynomial interpolation function is developed. For the issues where the conventional particle swarm technique is prone to local search and local optimality, the improved second-order oscillatory particle swarm approach is proposed. The technique uses time-jerk as the search space to find the best robot trajectory. To guarantee that the robot runs as quickly and smoothly as feasible, any optimization objective that does not satisfy the kinematic restrictions is removed. Trajectory planning in MATLAB for a six-axis industrial robot in joint space demonstrates the algorithm's efficacy under kinematic constraints.

articleTitle: Local Sensing based Multi-agent Pursuit-evasion with Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: In this paper, a problem of multi-agent pursuit-evasion in which multiple pursuers try to round up a single evader as soon as possible in a 2D limited space is considered. A cooperative approach of pursuit strategy through sensing among pursuits is developed under the multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) reinforcement learning (RL) method, which adopts the centralized training and distributed execution to deal with the pursuit problem by a fully distributed approach. Instead of using the communication information, each pursuer is supposed that can only obtain the sensing information of its neighbors and the evader. By introducing the sensing range segment and relative-position average strategy, we allow that the number of the pursuer can be changeable, which is different from some existing results that assume that the number of pursuers is fixed. To demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method above, we implement it in a simulation environment. Simulation results show that the pursuer can learn a highly cooperative control strategy and capture the evader with a high success rate.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Health Assessment Method of Railway Balise Based on E-CRITIC Method
abstract: The deterioration of the health status of railway Balise may lead to the failure of the vehicle equipment to receive effective location information, resulting in emergency braking of the train, and even serious accidents. This study proposes a new comprehensive health assessment method, which includes three layers: signal acquisition layer, data analysis layer and health assessment layer. The signal acquisition layer selects seven up-link signal characteristic parameters as the health indicators of the Balise. In the data analysis layer, normal fitting and linear fitting are used to score individual health parameters, and E-CRITIC method integrating entropy method and CRITIC method is used to allocate the weights of different health parameters. The comprehensive health results of the Balise is obtained in health assessment layer. Different case studies are carried out to verify the availability of the new method. Experimental results show that the E-CRITIC method has the highest consistency with the subjective evaluation results. The deviation of health evaluation results of E-CRITIC method is slightly higher than that of CRITIC method, far less than that of entropy method, and it is acceptable.

articleTitle: Rice pest Detection based on MobileNetv2-YOLOv4
abstract: For the management and conservation of rice, accurate pest identification is crucial. Low pest detection effectiveness and good classification accuracy in rice fields are addressed by the lightweight model MobileNetv2-YOLOv4, which is based on YOLOv4. First, MobileNetv2 is utilized as the backbone network in lieu of CSPDarknet53 in YOLOv4 to minimize the amount of parameters and lighten the model. Second, the model emphasizes the difficulty of recognizing samples during training by balancing the positive and negative samples in the picture using the Focal Loss loss function. The results show that MobileNetv2-YOLOv4 has 90.50% mAP, 51.55 frames per second(FPS), and the model weights of 49.00MB on the 3-type field rice pest dataset. Compared to YOLOv4, the mAP is basically the same, FPS is 206% higher, and model weights are reduced fivefold. The MobileNetv2-YOLOv4 model indicated in this research can be used for field detection of rice pests and diseases, taking into account the accuracy and recognition speed of rice pest detection.

articleTitle: Path Planning Technology of Mars Rover Based on Griding of Visibility-graph Map Direction Search Method
abstract: Based on the Mars surface exploration, this paper studies the autonomous path planning technology of the rover on the Mars surface under the circumstance of the limited computing resources of the Mars Rover. In this paper, the visibility-graph method and the grid method are combined to optimize the grid division method and make the map model more suitable for search processing. On this basis, a direction search method with low computational resource occupancy is proposed to search the established map. Finally, the results of griding of visibility-graph map direction search method are compared with the Dijkstra algorithm. It shows that the griding of visibility-graph map direction search method has less computational time complexity, and can conduct synchronous search during the progress process to obtain a better path. It is a path search algorithm suitable for the process of traveling on the surface of Mars.

articleTitle: Finite Time Sliding Mode Synchronization of Recurrent Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Fractional-Order Hyperchaotic Systems Based on PSO Algorithm Optimization
abstract: The controller with finite time sliding mode surface is proposed, which is to make the hetero-structured fractional order hyperchaotic system fully synchronized. At the same time, RNN estimates the uncertain external interference. By designing an adaptive compensator, the influence of uncertainty is eliminated, and the controlled system achieves asymptotic stability. According to Lyapunov stability analysis, the adaptive law is obtained, and the subsequent parameters of RNN are optimized. PSO algorithm optimizes the control parameters.

articleTitle: Ground Moving Target Tracking with Quadrotors using Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
abstract: In this paper, we provide a method for a quadrotor to track a ground moving target (GMT). The least squares method is used to obtain a series of reference trajectories generated by the GMT. The tracking is accomplished by applying a novel nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) scheme. The nonlinear MPC scheme applied can deal with the dynamic trajectory tracking problem of nonlinear systems by using reference generic terminal ingredients. After obtaining the reachable reference trajectories and calculating the terminal ingredients of the nonlinear MPC problem, the nonlinear MPC problem can be solved online to obtain the control inputs that enable the quadrotor to accurately track the GMT. A simulation experiment is conducted to verify the efficacy of this method.

articleTitle: A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Robust Restoration of Generators in Power System
abstract: In the past decades, cascading blackouts have caused serious damages to power systems and affected the normal operation of society, so it is crucial to quickly restore the damaged power system to normal state. In this paper, a reinforcement learning (RL) approach is developed to achieve the robust restoration of generators in power systems. Firstly, the performance recovery of damaged power system is modeled as markov decision process, and constraints such as line voltage and active power output of generators are considered. Secondly, a RL algorithm is proposed to search the optimal control strategy for generator units recovery. Based on the proposed restoration approach, Q-learning algorithm is employed to obtain the optimal strategy for power supply of generaors in power grids. Finally, numerical simulations are carried out on IEEE 9-bus system under different scenarios of external disturbances and certainties. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Position guidance method of live-working robot based on lidar point-cloud
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid and the improvement of people’s living standards, live-working robot plays a more and more important role in uninterrupted maintenance. In order to solve the problems of parking failure and low space guidance efficiency in live-working robot of substation equipment, this paper proposes a position guidance method of live-working robot based on lidar point-cloud. Firstly, aiming at the problem that the existing lidar has a small view, this paper proposes a large scene 3D scanning method based on lidar and PTZ. Secondly, aiming at the problem that the robot in ground is difficult to realize the one-time stop of the bucket car when the operation target is at a high altitude, this paper proposes an insulator positioning method based on the laser point-cloud in the open scene. The experimental results show that compared with the existing methods, the proposed method can not only effectively realize the three-dimensional reconstruction of the open environment, but also realize the spatial positioning of the insulator, and guide the end robot of the bucket car to move to the front of the target, which is of great significance to the substation intelligent maintenance.

articleTitle: Observer-based Composite Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Control for High-Precision Positioning Servo System
abstract: In this paper, an observer-based composite super-twisting sliding mode controller (STSMC) is designed for fast response and enhanced disturbance rejection ability for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). Towards this aim, a higher-order sliding mode observer (HOSMO) is first employed for the angular velocity and the lumped disturbance estimation. Subsequently, a novel integral-based terminal sliding mode (ITSM) surface is constructed by introducing the estimated information. Finally, a composite sliding mode controller is derived by integrating the super-twisting algorithm and disturbance feedforward compensation technique. The simulation results fully demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Mining Method for IEEE802.1Qbv in TSN System Based on Timed Automata
abstract: Aiming at unknown and potential risks of IEEE802.1Qbv in Time Sensitive Network-based industrial systems, a vulnerability mining method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the protocol architecture of the IEEE802.1Qbv is analyzed and defined, then, the system model and attacker model are designed using Timed Automata, where the IEEE802.1Qbv is the core of work-flow. To verify the correctness and effectiveness of the method, logic test and delay test are carried out. The simulation results show that Man-in-the-middle, Replay and Dos attacks all affect the scheduling, causing logic errors and increasing delay. The Man-in-the-middle attack affects the scheduling by affecting the synchronization. Redundancy mechanism is beneficial to system security, but it has a great impact on operation.

articleTitle: AGV Self-Adaptive Decoupling PID Controller Based on BAS Algorithm
abstract: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV), serving as an important tool for wide industrial applications, suffers many control problems for coupling impacts of rotation and shift moving. We present a decoupling controller to improve the kinematic performance of AGV in the paradigm of PID control. For adaptive tuning of PID, a heuristic optimization strategy, named Beetle Antennae Search (BAS), is employed to generate proper adjustment of parameter estimation. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Modeling method of boiler combustion system based on empirical mode decomposition
abstract: This paper proposes a modeling method of boiler combustion system based on Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD). For the modeling of boiler combustion system, the current mainstream method is based on data-driven modeling method. However, the learning efficiency of the model is not ideal due to the complexity of the boiler system. In this paper, EMD is used to transform complex signals into multiple modal signals with periodic laws or relatively stable trends firstly, so as to reduce the data complexity. Then the Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) is used for data-driven modeling to improve the learning efficiency and prediction accuracy of the model. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed modeling method.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis of a five-degree-of-freedom lightweight Explosive Ordnance Disposal robotic arm
abstract: To address the problems of complex structure, poor flexibility of Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) robotic arm, this paper proposes a five-degree-of-freedom (five-DOF) lightweight EOD robotic arm. Firstly, the basic parameters and workspace of the robotic arm are identified based on the EOD tasks. The workspace of the robotic arm is analyzed by Monte Carlo method to prove that it can satisfy the operating requirements. Secondly, the simulation analysis of the gripping trajectory is carried out by the quintic polynomial interpolation method to verify the rationality of the design parameters and the motion trajectory of the lightweight robotic arm. Finally, by the simulation results in the Matlab, we constructed a robotic arm motion control system, verified the correctness of the control algorithm on the prototype of the robotic arm, and completed the simulated EOD experiment. The experimental results prove that: the lightweight robotic arm can operate flexibly and quickly grab the explosive object, which is suitable for EOD operations.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent Vehicle Traffic Sign Recognition System
abstract: In the field of advanced driver assistance systems, an intelligent trolley traffic sign recognition system based on OpenMV is intended to provide technological support for road tracking. The intelligent car by OpenMV to record road video, the track module controls the driving on the black line road, the front of the traffic sign, the vision module through the LAB color model and template matching algorithm to identify traffic signs, the use of serial port communication to feedback information to the central processor STM32F103C8T6, the main controller classification of the identified data, control motor to make an appropriate response. This system’s traffic sign recognition and intelligent vehicle control have a high rate of accuracy, as demonstrated by several studies in various settings.

articleTitle: Energy-based Control of Three-Link Planar Robot with Last Active Link
abstract: This paper studies the energy-based control for a 3-link planar robot with last active link, for which the angle between the last link and the vertical is actuated. The swing-up and stabilizing task around the robot’s upright equilibrium point (UEP) is investigated. An energy-based controller is derived to control both its overall energy and actuated variable. By presenting a property of the robot that holds under arbitrary physical parameters, this paper proves that almost all initial states converge to an invariant set where the last link is upright and the robot’s overall energy equals its value at the UEP, providing certain requirements on control gains are satisfied. This paper provides simulation verification for the obtained theoretical results, in which a local stabilizing controller is utilized to accomplish stabilization at the UEP.

articleTitle: Edge detection of ghost imaging based on frequency domain filtering
abstract: Ghost imaging is a novel method which can reconstruct the imaging via a single-pixel detector. Compared with traditional edge extraction methods, ghost imaging can be used for edge detection of unknown targets without acquiring the target image. Initially, we applied a ghost image edge extraction method using discrete cosine transform and rectangular window function based frequency domain filter. Then, to eliminate the ringing artifact problem, we proposed a novel ghost imaging edge detection method using the Crone operator and Butterworth filter, which can obtain high-quality edge results of unknown targets at a very low sampling rate. Finally, many simulations were performed to validate the proposed strategy, and the results show that the proposed method can get high quality edge information of an unknown target at a low sampling rate.

articleTitle: VPCNet: Voxel-Point Cascade for 3D Object Detection
abstract: Most current 3D object detectors employ the sophisticated point-voxel fusion mechanisms to obtain high-quality feature representation. However, they rarely consider the hierarchical relationship between points and voxels. We propose a novel detection network, called VPCNet, which fuses voxels and raw points utilizing a cascaded structure to optimize proposals hierarchically. The proposed Hierarchical Head is a two-level detection head, including voxel level and point level. The first level utilizes voxel representation to predict relatively rough boxes. The second level exploits the Corner Point Transformer to model the spatial context relationship between the original points and the previous level boxes to obtain more accurate detection results. A Quadratic Weighted Decoder of Corner Point Transformer is developed with standard transformer decoder to reduces the adverse effect of sparsity on learned features. This design combines computationally efficient voxel-based methods with point-based methods which possess more complete spatial information. Our method outperforms most state-of-the-art 3D object detectors on both KITTI and Waymo Open Datasets.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-based Hierarchical Obstacle Avoidance Strategy for Fixed-wing Aircraft
abstract: Obstacle avoidance is a crucial issue to enhance the safety of aircraft. Aircraft usually need to avoid a drop in altitude and keep a set course while avoiding an obstacle. In this paper, a hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy is proposed to address obstacle avoidance, the drop in altitude, and course keeping simultaneously. The hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy integrates a high-level reinforcement learning-based navigator and a low-level attitude controller. Experiments are conducted in X-Plane, a flight simulator, to evaluate the proposed hierarchical obstacle avoidance strategy.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Soccer Robot Based on Improved Heuristic RRT* Algorithm
abstract: For problems solving the soccer robot path planning in the RoboCup standard platform league, an improved algorithm based on Informed Rapidly-exploring random tree* (RRT*) is proposed. A series of improvements have been made to solve the poor purpose and low efficiency in searching for the initial solution in the Informed RRT* algorithm. Firstly, by estimating the initial states and adopting proper inflation strategy, the heuristic sampling subset is constructed in advance to increase the time proportion of constrained sampling. Secondly, the synchronous growth of bidirectional tree is used to replace the traditional alternating growth to simplify the planning task of single random tree, and a special stage is introduced to accelerate the connection. Finally, we adopt the hybrid cache mechanism to reuse the existing nodes, so as to reduce the calculation scale. A series of experimental comparisons show that the improved algorithm has better real-time performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimized Energy Management Strategy for Fuel Cell/Battery Hybrid Vehicles to Balance both Fuel Economy and Power Sources Durability
abstract: It is of vital importance to realize a reasonable energy management strategy for the stable operation of the fuel cell hybrid electric vehicles (FCHEVs). In order to balance the optimization of the fuel economy and power sources durability of the system, this work designs an optimized Pontryagin’s Minimal Principle (PMP) based EMS. This strategy regards the hydrogen consumption as the optimal objective of the fuel economy. In order to prolong the lifespan of the power sources, the degradation penalty functions of them are introduced into the Hamiltonian function. The proposed method tries to reduce extreme load conditions of the fuel cell and manages the charge-discharge rate, SOC level and the temperature of the battery. Then, the empirical degradation models and fuel consumption models of the system are presented to test the durability and fuel economy of the power sources. The result shows the designed method could reduce power sources degradation and increase fuel economy.
